english: Next to the bank is the pharmacy every day actually.

target: Trots regnet gick vi ut väldigt ofta.
english: Despite the rain we went out very often.

target: Enligt tidningen är det sant sedan länge.
english: According to the newspaper it's true for a long time.

target: Klockan åtta börjar lektionen varje dag i skolan.
english: At eight o'clock the lesson starts every day at school.

target: Utanför dörren väntar en taxi på morgonen.
english: Outside the door a taxi is waiting in the morning.

target: Längs vägen växer blommor efter jobbet för alla.
english: Along the road flowers grow after work for everyone.

target: Genom parken går en stig under sommaren.
english: Through the park runs a path during the summer.

target: Runt sjön finns det vandringsleder på kvällen.
english: Around the lake there are hiking trails in the evening.

target: Bland alla elever är hon bäst redan.
english: Among all students she is the best already.

target: Mellan husen finns en gränd ibland i Sverige.
english: Between the houses there is an alley sometimes in Sweden.

target: Dit åker vi varje sommar under veckan.
english: There we go every summer during the week.

target: Härifrån ser man hela staden på morgonen.
english: From here you can see the whole city in the morning.

target: Överallt ser man svenska flaggor på kvällen.
english: Everywhere you see Swedish flags in the evening.

target: Inte förrän imorgon kan jag svara också.
english: Not until tomorrow can I answer too.

target: Bara på sommaren är det så varmt.
english: Only in summer is it this warm.

target: Fortfarande bor hon i samma stad i Sverige.
english: She still lives in the same city in Sweden.

target: Hellre cyklar jag än kör bil dit.
english: I'd rather cycle than drive a car there.

target: Trots allt blev det bra på kvällen.
english: After all it turned out well in the evening.

target: Tack vare dig lyckades vi på morgonen.
english: Thanks to you we succeeded in the morning.

target: På grund av regnet ställdes matchen in.
english: Because of the rain the match was cancelled.

target: Hittills har allt gått bra i helgen.
english: So far everything has gone well on the weekend.

target: Numera arbetar hon deltid hela tiden varje dag.
english: Nowadays she works part-time all the time every day.

target: Visserligen är det dyrt, men det är värt det.
english: Admittedly it's expensive, but it's worth it.

target: Så fort jag kom hem somnade jag.
english: As soon as I got home I fell asleep.

target: Sannolikt regnar det imorgon på kvällen ute.
english: It will probably rain tomorrow in the evening outside.

target: Uppenbarligen hade han rätt just nu redan.
english: Apparently he was right right now already.

target: Antagligen kommer de sent sedan länge nog.
english: They are probably coming late for a long time probably.

target: Normalt sett äter vi klockan sex varje dag.
english: Normally we eat at six every day.

target: Till slut hittade vi restaurangen hela tiden.
english: Finally we found the restaurant all the time.

target: Naturligtvis hjälper jag dig på stationen varje morgon.
english: Of course I'll help you at the station every morning.

target: Vanligtvis promenerar jag efter lunch på kvällen.
english: Usually I walk after lunch in the evening.

target: I alla fall är vi framme nu.
english: In any case we are here now.

target: Med andra ord ska vi vänta väl.
english: In other words we should wait I suppose.

target: I samband med flytten bytte hon jobb.
english: In connection with the move she changed jobs.

target: I stället för att klaga borde vi agera.
english: Instead of complaining we should act.

target: Till en början var det svårt egentligen.
english: At first it was difficult actually.

target: I slutändan spelar det ingen roll ofta.
english: In the end it doesn't matter often.

target: Kort sagt fungerar det bra hela tiden.
english: In short it works well all the time.

target: Hur som helst måste vi gå nu.
english: Anyway we must go now.

target: I värsta fall får vi vänta nog.
english: In the worst case we'll have to wait probably.

target: I bästa fall är vi framme klockan tre.
english: In the best case we'll arrive at three.

target: Med tanke på vädret stannar vi inne.
english: Considering the weather we'll stay inside.

target: Ännu har ingen klagat i parken varje morgon.
english: No one has complained yet in the park every morning.

target: Senast igår pratade jag med honom dit.
english: Just yesterday I spoke with him there.

target: Sedan dess har jag inte hört något.
english: Since then I have not heard anything.

target: Inom kort får vi besked väldigt ofta.
english: Shortly we'll get a response very often.

target: Under tiden kan du vänta här alltid.
english: In the meantime you can wait here always.

target: Dagligen promenerar hon hela tiden efter jobbet.
english: Daily she walks all the time after work.

target: Framför allt gillar jag fika varje morgon.
english: Above all I like fika every morning.

target: Så småningom lärde jag mig nästa vecka.
english: Eventually I learned next week.

target: Nedanför berget ligger en by i helgen.
english: Below the mountain lies a village on the weekend.

target: Ovanför molnen skiner solen under veckan gärna.
english: Above the clouds the sun shines during the week gladly.

target: Å ena sidan förstår jag dig väl.
english: On one hand I understand you I suppose.

target: Å andra sidan har han rätt nog.
english: On the other hand he is right probably.

target: Förmodligen kommer det att regna under veckan.
english: Probably it will rain during the week.

target: Nog kan du stanna lite till alltid.
english: Surely you can stay a bit longer always.

target: Särskilt på vintern är det mörkt nog.
english: Especially in winter it is dark probably.

target: Allt oftare jobbar folk hemifrån i helgen.
english: More and more often people work from home on the weekend.

target: Lika gärna kan vi gå under veckan.
english: We might as well walk during the week.

target: Utöver det har vi inga problem väl.
english: Besides that we have no problems I suppose.

target: Lite senare kom resten av gruppen förra året.
english: A little later the rest of the group arrived last year.

target: Strax före midnatt gick vi hem på kontoret.
english: Just before midnight we went home at the office.

target: Som tur var hittade vi biljetten redan.
english: Luckily we found the ticket already.

target: Även i Sverige snöar det inte alltid.
english: Even in Sweden it doesn't always snow.

target: Hemma hos oss firar vi alltid jul.
english: At our home we always celebrate Christmas.

target: Innanför grinden leker barnen förra veckan också.
english: Inside the gate the children play last week too.

target: Knappt hade vi kommit förrän det began regna.
english: We had barely arrived when it started raining.

target: Inte bara regnade det, det blåste också.
english: Not only did it rain, it was also windy.
grammar: "Inte bara...också" (not only...also). First clause inverts; second is normal order.

target: Klockan är tre på stranden ibland nog.
english: It is three o'clock at the beach sometimes probably.
grammar: "Klockan" means both "the clock" and "o'clock." Swedish uses 24-hour time formally.

target: Vi ses klockan halv fem väldigt ofta.
english: We'll meet at half past four very often.
grammar: "Halv fem" means half TO five (4:30), not half past five. A common trap for learners!

target: Det kostar tjugofem kronor under sommaren gärna.
english: It costs twenty-five kronor during the summer gladly.
grammar: Swedish numbers 21-99 put the tens first: tjugofem = twenty-five. No hyphen needed.

target: Jag har tre barn just nu nog.
english: I have three children right now probably.
grammar: "Barn" is an ett-word that stays the same in plural: ett barn, två barn.

target: Vi bor på tredje våningen varje dag.
english: We live on the third floor every day.
grammar: Ordinal numbers: "första, andra, tredje" — the first three are irregular.

target: Det är den femtonde mars nästa vecka.
english: It is the fifteenth of March next week.
grammar: Ordinal dates use -e or -te endings: femtonde = fifteenth. Swedish dates go day-month.

target: Klockan är kvart över nio nästa vecka.
english: It is a quarter past nine next week.
grammar: "Kvart över" = quarter past. "Kvart i" = quarter to.

target: Jag fyller trettio år imorgon sedan länge.
english: I turn thirty years old tomorrow for a long time.
grammar: "Fylla år" literally means 'fill years' — the standard way to say 'have a birthday.'

target: Det finns hundra platser ibland här.
english: There are a hundred seats sometimes here.
grammar: "Det finns" (there is/are) works for both singular and plural in Swedish.

target: Vi har väntat i tjugo minuter väl.
english: We have waited for twenty minutes I suppose.
grammar: "I" + time period = "for": "i tjugo minuter" (for 20 minutes). Don't use "för" here.

target: Tåget avgår klockan 14:35 varje dag väl.
english: The train departs at 14:35 every day I suppose.
grammar: Written timetables always use 24-hour format in Sweden.

target: En, två, tre, fyra, fem efter jobbet.
english: One, two, three, four, five after work.
grammar: Swedish numbers 1-5: en/ett, två, tre, fyra, fem. "En" for en-words, "ett" for ett-words.

target: Sex, sju, åtta, nio, tio på morgonen.
english: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten in the morning.
grammar: "Sju" (7) contains the tricky sj-sound [ɧ]. "Åtta" has double-t making the å short.

target: Elva, tolv, tretton, fjorton, femton varje morgon.
english: Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen every morning.
grammar: 13-19 add "-ton" (like English "-teen"): tretton, fjorton, femton, sexton...

target: Sexton, sjutton, arton, nitton, tjugo förra veckan.
english: Sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty last week.
grammar: "Arton" is the modern form of 18 (not "aderton" which is formal/written).

target: Trettio, fyrtio, femtio, sextio på morgonen under sommaren.
english: Thirty, forty, fifty, sixty in the morning during summer.
grammar: Tens use "-tio" suffix: trettio (30), fyrtio (40). Note "fyrtio" not "förtio".

target: Sjuttio, åttio, nittio, hundra ibland dit.
english: Seventy, eighty, ninety, a hundred sometimes there.
grammar: "Hundra" (100) is an ett-word: ett hundra, but you usually drop "ett" before it.

target: Tusen kronor är inte så mycket väl.
english: A thousand kronor isn't that much I suppose.
grammar: "Tusen" = thousand. No plural: "två tusen," not "två tusens."

target: En miljon invånare förra veckan väl.
english: One million inhabitants last week I suppose.
grammar: "Miljon" is an en-word: en miljon, miljonen. "Invånare" = inhabitant — same singular and plural.

target: Det är min första dag sedan länge.
english: It is my first day for a long time.
grammar: "Första" = first. Ordinals 1-3 are irregular: första, andra, tredje.

target: Vi tog andra platsen på kvällen verkligen.
english: We took second place in the evening really.

target: Det är fjärde gången under veckan också.
english: It is the fourth time during the week too.

target: Vilken dag är det idag hela tiden?
english: What day is it today all the time?

target: Idag är det måndag under veckan redan.
english: Today is Monday during the week already.
grammar: Days of the week are not capitalized in Swedish.

target: Imorgon är det tisdag på morgonen redan.
english: Tomorrow is Tuesday in the morning already.

target: Vi ses på onsdag förra veckan alltid.
english: We'll meet on Wednesday last week always.

target: Jag jobbar inte på fredagar väldigt ofta.
english: I don't work on Fridays very often.

target: Vi åker på lördag under sommaren med familjen.
english: We're leaving on Saturday during the summer with the family.

target: Söndag är vilodag på morgonen väl.
english: Sunday is a day of rest in the morning I suppose.

target: Januari är den kallaste månaden på morgonen.
english: January is the coldest month in the morning.
grammar: Months are not capitalized in Swedish: januari, februari, mars.

target: Februari är kort nästa vecka redan.
english: February is short next week already.

target: Mars är vårens början hemma hos oss varje morgon.
english: March is the beginning of spring at our home every morning.

target: Midsommar firas i juni varje dag redan.
english: Midsummer is celebrated in June every day already.
grammar: Midsummer falls on the Friday between June 19-25. Not always the 24th.

target: Juli är semestermånad i parken ibland redan.
english: July is vacation month in the park sometimes already.

target: September börjar hösten väldigt ofta nog.
english: September starts the autumn very often probably.

target: December är mörk men mysig i helgen.
english: December is dark but cozy on the weekend.

target: Klockan är tio i tolv just nu.
english: It is ten to twelve right now.

target: Klockan är fem över åtta i helgen.
english: It is five past eight on the weekend.

target: Vi äter lunch klockan halv ett hemma.
english: We eat lunch at half past twelve at home.

target: Mötet varar i en timme under sommaren.
english: The meeting lasts for an hour during the summer.

target: Jag väntar i fem minuter under veckan.
english: I'll wait for five minutes during the week.

target: Det tar en kvart väldigt ofta gärna.
english: It takes a quarter of an hour very often gladly.

target: En halvtimme senare var vi framme redan.
english: Half an hour later we arrived already.

target: Butiken öppnar klockan tio på morgonen gärna.
english: The store opens at ten in the morning gladly.

target: Vi stänger klockan arton just nu också.
english: We close at eighteen right now too.

target: Det är bara två dagar kvar redan.
english: There are only two days left already.

target: Om tre veckor åker vi nästa vecka.
english: In three weeks we are leaving next week.

target: Det var för fem år sedan egentligen.
english: That was five years ago actually.

target: Jag har bott här i åtta månader.
english: I have lived here for eight months.

target: Under de senaste tio åren har mycket förändrats.
english: In the last ten years a lot has changed.

target: Året har tolv månader under sommaren nog.
english: The year has twelve months during the summer probably.

target: Veckan har sju dagar väldigt ofta gärna.
english: The week has seven days very often gladly.

target: Det finns 365 dagar på ett år.
english: There are 365 days in a year.
grammar: "På" used idiomatically: "dagar på ett år" = days in a year.

target: Jag sprang fem kilometer genom parken tidigt i morse.
english: I ran five kilometers through the park early this morning.

target: Temperaturen är minus tio grader hela tiden.
english: The temperature is minus ten degrees all the time.

target: Det snöar sedan två timmar ibland ute.
english: It has been snowing for two hours sometimes outside.

target: Vi behöver tolv ägg sedan länge idag.
english: We need twelve eggs for a long time today.
grammar: "Ägg" is ett-word: ett ägg, ägget. Same form singular and plural.

target: Boka ett bord för fyra personer just nu.
english: Book a table for four people right now.

target: Halva priset på lördagar hela tiden till slut.
english: Half price on Saturdays all the time in the end.

target: Dubbelt så mycket som förra gången i Sverige.
english: Twice as much as last time in Sweden.

target: Vi åker om en och en halv timme.
english: We are leaving in an hour and a half.

target: Det kostar sexhundra kronor per natt gärna.
english: It costs six hundred kronor per night gladly.

target: Lägenheten är sjuttio kvadratmeter ibland redan.
english: The apartment is seventy square meters sometimes already.

target: Tåget tar fyra timmar efter jobbet gärna.
english: The train takes four hours after work gladly.

target: Flyget tar en timme och trettio minuter.
english: The flight takes one hour and thirty minutes.

target: Vi anländer klockan halv åtta förra veckan.
english: We arrive at half past seven last week.

target: Jag vaknar klockan sex varje morgon också.
english: I wake up at six every morning too.

target: Hon fyller fyrtio i november efter jobbet.
english: She turns forty in November after work.

target: Vi behöver minst tre dagar på kvällen.
english: We need at least three days in the evening.

target: Jag har sju möten idag under sommaren.
english: I have seven meetings today during the summer.

target: Det finns tjugotre elever i klassen i Sverige.
english: There are twenty-three students in the class in Sweden.

target: Huset byggdes nittonhundrasjuttio på stranden ibland i Sverige.
english: The house was built in 1970 at the beach sometimes in Sweden.

target: Vi firar tvåhundra år av fred med familjen.
english: We celebrate two hundred years of peace with the family.

target: Räkningen blev åttahundra kronor under veckan alltid.
english: The bill was eight hundred kronor during the week always.

target: Siffran noll är viktig i matematik redan.
english: The number zero is important in math already.

target: Jag behöver ett dussin rosor varje dag.
english: I need a dozen roses every day.

target: Vi har fjorton gäster ikväll efter jobbet.
english: We have fourteen guests tonight after work.

target: Hastigheten är nittio kilometer i timmen nog.
english: The speed is ninety kilometers per hour probably.

target: Det är tjugofem grader varmt förra veckan.
english: It is twenty-five degrees warm last week.

target: Befolkningen är ungefär tio miljoner efter jobbet.
english: The population is approximately ten million after work.

target: Varje lektion varar i fyrtiofem minuter egentligen.
english: Each lesson lasts forty-five minutes actually.

target: Vi har handlat för trehundra kronor redan.
english: We have shopped for three hundred kronor already.

target: Det är den nittonde augusti varje dag.
english: It is the nineteenth of August every day.

target: Första maj är en röd dag i Sverige.
english: May Day is a public holiday in Sweden.
grammar: "Röd dag" (red day) is the Swedish term for public holidays.

target: Klockan tolv på natten är det midnatt.
english: At twelve at night it is midnight.

target: Klockan tolv på dagen är det mitt på dagen.
english: At twelve during the day it is noon.

target: Vi har tjugofyra timmar på oss väl.
english: We have twenty-four hours I suppose.

target: Bussen kommer var tionde minut under veckan.
english: The bus comes every ten minutes during the week.

target: Det är sextio sekunder på en minut.
english: There are sixty seconds in a minute.

target: Om ett par timmar är vi framme.
english: In a couple of hours we'll be there.

target: Det är den tredje december efter jobbet.
english: It is the third of December after work.

target: Den trettonde december firar vi Lucia med familjen.
english: On the thirteenth of December we celebrate Lucia with the family.
grammar: Lucia is a beloved Swedish tradition with candlelit processions and singing.

target: Vi ses om två veckor ibland med vänner.
english: We'll see each other in two weeks sometimes with friends.

target: Hundra procent av eleverna deltog under sommaren.
english: One hundred percent of students participated during the summer.

target: Jag har haft tre jobb varje dag.
english: I have had three jobs every day.

target: Det tog oss sex timmar att köra dit.
english: It took us six hours to drive there.

target: Hälften av tiden regnade det i helgen.
english: Half the time it rained on the weekend.

target: En tredjedel av befolkningen bor i Stockholm.
english: A third of the population lives in Stockholm.

target: Vi behöver åtminstone fyrtio minuter under veckan.
english: We need at least forty minutes during the week.

target: Jag har elva dagar kvar av semestern.
english: I have eleven days left of vacation.

target: Det finns fyra årstider i Sverige här.
english: There are four seasons in Sweden here.

target: Vi träffas varannan vecka under veckan med vänner.
english: We meet every other week during the week with friends.

target: Bilen kostar tvåhundratusen kronor förra veckan gärna.
english: The car costs two hundred thousand kronor last week gladly.

target: Klockan är precis nio nästa vecka alltid.
english: It is exactly nine o'clock next week always.

target: Jag betalar femtio kronor per månad i trädgården.
english: I pay fifty kronor per month in the garden.

target: Barnen har lov i två veckor redan.
english: The children have vacation for two weeks already.

target: Jag vill ha en kopp kaffe, tack.
english: I would like a cup of coffee, please.
grammar: "Jag vill ha" is the polite way to order. Literally "I want to have."

target: Kan jag få notan, tack varje dag?
english: Can I have the bill, please every day?
grammar: "Kan jag få" is more polite than "Jag vill ha" when ordering.

target: Vi skulle vilja boka ett bord för två.
english: We would like to book a table for two.
grammar: "Vi skulle vilja" is the most formal way to make a request.

target: Vad rekommenderar du efter jobbet till slut?
english: What do you recommend after work in the end?
grammar: "Rekommendera" is borrowed from French/Latin — common in Swedish.

target: Jag tar en lax med potatis gärna.
english: I'll have salmon with potatoes gladly.
grammar: "Jag tar" (I'll take) is the most natural way to order at a restaurant.

target: Har ni något vegetariskt på kvällen gärna?
english: Do you have anything vegetarian in the evening gladly?
grammar: "Ni" is used for addressing service staff, though "du" is also fine.

target: Jag är allergisk mot nötter nästa vecka.
english: I am allergic to nuts next week.

target: En öl och en glass, tack sedan länge.
english: A beer and an ice cream, please for a long time.

target: Maten var jättegod i centrum ibland redan!
english: The food was really delicious in the center sometimes already!

target: Kan vi få lite mer bröd också?
english: Can we get some more bread too?

target: Smörgåsen är god i helgen väl.
english: The sandwich is good on the weekend I suppose.
grammar: "Smörgås" is quintessentially Swedish — an open-faced sandwich with various toppings.

target: Vi tar en fika på kafét gärna.
english: We'll have fika at the café gladly.
grammar: "Kafé" is ett-word. "Kafét" = the café (definite).

target: Jag dricker kaffe med mjölk just nu.
english: I drink coffee with milk right now.

target: Hon beställer en sallad förra veckan gärna.
english: She orders a salad last week gladly.

target: Vi delar på en pizza just nu.
english: We share a pizza right now.

target: Köttbullar med lingon och potatis just nu.
english: Meatballs with lingonberries and potatoes right now.
grammar: Köttbullar med lingon is perhaps Sweden's most iconic dish.

target: Jag vill ha vatten, tack på kvällen.
english: I would like water, please in the evening.

target: Kan jag se menyn ibland gärna?
english: Can I see the menu sometimes gladly?

target: Räksmörgåsen är fantastisk i helgen väl.
english: The shrimp sandwich is fantastic on the weekend I suppose.

target: Vi äter lunch ute idag varje morgon.
english: We eat lunch out today every morning.

target: Frukosten ingår i priset efter jobbet dit.
english: Breakfast is included in the price after work there.
grammar: "Ingå i" = be included in. Common for hotel descriptions.

target: Kaffet är starkt och gott på morgonen.
english: The coffee is strong and good in the morning.

target: Jag tar en kanelbulle till kaffet alltid.
english: I'll have a cinnamon bun with the coffee always.
grammar: Kanelbulle (cinnamon bun) is essential to Swedish fika culture.

target: Kan jag betala med kort under sommaren?
english: Can I pay by card during the summer?
grammar: "Kort" = card. Sweden is nearly cashless — cards accepted everywhere.

target: Dricksen ingår alltid i priset på den här restaurangen.
english: The tip is always included in the price at this restaurant.
grammar: Tipping is not expected in Sweden — service charge is usually included.

target: Vi äter middag klockan sex nästa vecka.
english: We eat dinner at six o'clock next week.
grammar: "Middag" = dinner (evening meal). Lunch is the midday meal.

target: Soppan är varm och god just nu.
english: The soup is warm and good right now.

target: En tallrik med köttbullar, tack ibland i trädgården.
english: A plate of meatballs, please sometimes in the garden.

target: Jag föredrar fisk framför kött i helgen.
english: I prefer fish over meat on the weekend.

target: Vi tar en dessert att dela gärna.
english: We'll have a dessert to share gladly.

target: Vilken soppa har ni idag ibland redan?
english: Which soup do you have today sometimes already?

target: Jag skulle vilja ha en glass på morgonen.
english: I would like an ice cream in the morning.

target: Har ni laktosfritt under sommaren redan?
english: Do you have lactose-free during the summer already?

target: Maten är glutenfri på kvällen redan.
english: The food is gluten-free in the evening already.

target: Vi äter frukost klockan sju väldigt ofta.
english: We eat breakfast at seven o'clock very often.

target: Jag tar grönsaker till huvudrätten under sommaren.
english: I'll have vegetables with the main course during the summer.

target: En kopp te med honung just nu.
english: A cup of tea with honey right now.

target: Kakan är hembakad efter jobbet också.
english: The cake is homemade after work too.

target: Brödet är nybakat på kontoret ibland redan.
english: The bread is freshly baked at the office sometimes already.

target: Vi äter surströmming en gång om året.
english: We eat surströmming once a year.
grammar: Surströmming (fermented herring) is notoriously smelly — eaten outdoors in late summer.

target: Har ni en barnmeny på kvällen nog?
english: Do you have a children's menu in the evening probably?

target: Jag vill ha lite grädde till kaffet.
english: I would like some cream for the coffee.

target: Sillen på julbordet är traditionell under veckan.
english: The herring at the Christmas table is traditional during the week.
grammar: Julbordet (Christmas buffet) features many varieties of pickled herring.

target: Vi tar varsin fika på morgonen redan.
english: We'll each have a fika in the morning already.

target: Räkorna är färska hela tiden redan.
english: The shrimp are fresh all the time already.

target: Jag dricker hellre te på kvällen alltid.
english: I'd rather drink tea in the evening always.

target: Pannkakorna är goda med sylt förra veckan.
english: The pancakes are good with jam last week.
grammar: Thursday is traditionally pancake day ("pannkakstorsdag") in Sweden.

target: Vi beställer hemmapizza ikväll ibland på helgerna.
english: We'll order home delivery pizza tonight sometimes on weekends.

target: Saftig äppelpaj med vaniljsås hela tiden på helgerna.
english: Juicy apple pie with vanilla sauce all the time on weekends.

target: Jag tar en macka till lunch gärna.
english: I'll have a sandwich for lunch gladly.

target: Kräftskivan är i augusti väldigt ofta nog.
english: The crayfish party is in August very often probably.
grammar: Kräftskiva is a beloved Swedish tradition — eating crayfish with dill, singing songs.

target: Vi dricker glögg på vintern under veckan.
english: We drink mulled wine in winter during the week.
grammar: Glögg is the Swedish mulled wine, spiced and served with almonds and raisins.

target: Smöret och osten ligger på bordet väl.
english: The butter and cheese are on the table I suppose.

target: Jag vill ha socker i teet gärna.
english: I want sugar in the tea gladly.

target: Menyn har tre rätter i helgen väl.
english: The menu has three courses on the weekend I suppose.

target: Förrätten är en tonfisksallad i parken varje morgon.
english: The starter is a tuna salad in the park every morning.

target: Huvudrätten är grillad kyckling i centrum varje morgon.
english: The main course is grilled chicken in the center every morning.

target: Efterrätten är chokladtårta varje dag nog.
english: The dessert is a chocolate cake every day probably.

target: Buffén har mycket att välja på redan.
english: The buffet has a lot to choose from already.

target: Grönsakerna är ekologiska nästa vecka snart.
english: The vegetables are organic next week soon.

target: Potatisen är kokt just nu nog.
english: The potatoes are boiled right now probably.

target: Riset är perfekt tillagat på morgonen nog.
english: The rice is perfectly cooked in the morning probably.

target: Vi dricker juice till frukost förra veckan.
english: We drink juice for breakfast last week.

target: Yoghurten är naturell efter jobbet väl.
english: The yogurt is plain after work I suppose.

target: Jag äter havregrynsgröt varje morgon under sommaren.
english: I eat oatmeal porridge every morning during the summer.
grammar: Havregrynsgröt is a classic Swedish breakfast, often with milk and jam.

target: Filmjölk smakar gott med flingor nästa vecka.
english: Soured milk tastes good with cereal next week.
grammar: Filmjölk is a fermented dairy product unique to Scandinavia.

target: Vi grillar korv sedan länge i trädgården.
english: We grill sausages for a long time in the garden.

target: En bit ost och en skiva bröd.
english: A piece of cheese and a slice of bread.

target: Potatismos till köttbullarna efter jobbet ibland.
english: Mashed potatoes with the meatballs after work sometimes.

target: Lingonsylten är hemgjord hela tiden redan.
english: The lingonberry jam is homemade all the time already.

target: Vi dricker snaps till sillen på kvällen.
english: We drink schnapps with the herring in the evening.
grammar: Singing snapsvisor (drinking songs) while toasting is a Swedish tradition.

target: Prinskorven serveras på julbordet väldigt ofta nog.
english: Small sausages are served at the Christmas table very often probably.

target: Jag tar en kladdkaka väldigt ofta gärna.
english: I'll have a sticky chocolate cake very often gladly.
grammar: Kladdkaka is a beloved Swedish dessert — intentionally undercooked for gooey richness.

target: Semlan är en favorit i februari nog.
english: The semla is a favorite in February probably.
grammar: Semlor (cream-filled buns) are traditionally eaten before Lent, now available January-March.

target: Lussekatter bakas till Lucia ibland sedan länge.
english: Saffron buns are baked for Lucia sometimes for a long time.

target: Vi har alltid pepparkakor till jul väl.
english: We always have gingerbread cookies for Christmas I suppose.

target: Jag dricker en smoothie efter träningen varje dag.
english: I drink a smoothie after the workout every day.

target: Varmkorven med bröd och senap ibland redan.
english: The hot dog with bread and mustard sometimes already.

target: Vi äter tacos på fredagar sedan länge.
english: We eat tacos on Fridays for a long time.
grammar: "Fredagsmys" (cozy Friday) often features tacos — a uniquely Swedish tradition.

target: Har ni veganskt alternativ just nu väl?
english: Do you have a vegan option right now I suppose?

target: Ärtsoppan serveras på torsdagar väldigt ofta redan.
english: Pea soup is served on Thursdays very often already.
grammar: Ärtsoppa on Thursdays is an old Swedish military tradition still kept alive.

target: Jag tar en portion pommes frites gärna.
english: I'll have a portion of French fries gladly.

target: Brödet med smör och ost i helgen.
english: The bread with butter and cheese on the weekend.

target: En flaska mineralvatten, tack ibland snart.
english: A bottle of mineral water, please sometimes soon.

target: Vi tar varsitt glas vin väldigt ofta.
english: We'll each have a glass of wine very often.

target: Cider är populärt på sommaren väldigt ofta.
english: Cider is popular in the summer very often.

target: Jag tar en kaffe latte varje morgon.
english: I'll have a café latte every morning.

target: Fiskgratängen är husets specialitet förra veckan gärna.
english: The fish gratin is the house specialty last week gladly.

target: Toast Skagen är en klassiker efter jobbet.
english: Toast Skagen is a classic after work.
grammar: Toast Skagen is a Swedish appetizer with shrimp, mayo, and dill on toast.

target: Vi äter raggmunk med fläsk under sommaren.
english: We eat potato pancake with pork during the summer.

target: Janssons frestelse till julbordet på stranden varje morgon.
english: Jansson's Temptation for the Christmas table at the beach every morning.
grammar: A classic Swedish potato and anchovy casserole served at Christmas.

target: Jordgubbstårtan serveras till midsommar under veckan väl.
english: The strawberry cake is served at midsummer during the week I suppose.

target: Vi tar en fika paus i helgen.
english: We'll take a fika break on the weekend.

target: Kanelbullen smakar fantastiskt just nu också.
english: The cinnamon bun tastes fantastic right now too.

target: Vi plockar fram ostbrickan väldigt ofta också.
english: We'll bring out the cheese board very often too.

target: Jag tycker om stark mat efter jobbet.
english: I like spicy food after work.

target: Vattnet är kolsyrat efter jobbet redan.
english: The water is sparkling after work already.

target: Mackan med räkor och majonnäs på kvällen.
english: The sandwich with shrimp and mayonnaise in the evening.

target: Vi fikar minst två gånger om dagen.
english: We have fika at least twice a day.

target: Filmjölken serveras med knäckebröd nästa vecka för alla.
english: The soured milk is served with crispbread next week for everyone.
grammar: Knäckebröd (crispbread) is a Swedish staple found in every household.

target: Det gör inget väldigt ofta dit.
english: It doesn't matter very often there.
grammar: "Det gör inget" is the go-to phrase for "it doesn't matter" or "no worries."

target: Ingen orsak efter jobbet under sommaren.
english: No problem after work during summer.
grammar: "Ingen orsak" literally means "no cause" — used like "you're welcome" or "no problem."

target: Vad synd att du inte kunde komma med oss idag!
english: What a shame that you could not come with us today!
grammar: "Vad + adjective/noun" = what a...! "Vad synd!" = what a pity! Very common exclamation.

target: Vad bra att du äntligen fick det nya jobbet!
english: How great that you finally got the new job!
grammar: "Vad bra!" = how great! Swedish uses "vad" (what) for exclamations, not "hur" (how).

target: Jag vet inte efter jobbet väl.
english: I don't know after work I suppose.
grammar: "Veta" is irregular: vet (present), visste (past), vetat (supinum). "Vet inte" = don't know.

target: Det spelar ingen roll ibland med vänner.
english: It doesn't matter sometimes with friends.
grammar: "Spela roll" = matter. "Ingen roll" = no matter/doesn't matter.

target: Det beror på sedan länge ibland.
english: It depends for a long time sometimes.
grammar: "Bero på" = depend on. Very commonly used in conversation.

target: Javisst, det kan jag hjälpa dig med gärna.
english: Certainly, I can help you with that gladly.
grammar: "Javisst" combines "ja" and "visst" (certainly). Very emphatic agreement.

target: Självklart kommer jag att vara där på festen.
english: Of course I will be there at the party.
grammar: "Självklart" = of course! Compound: "själv" (self) + "klart" (clear). Very common.

target: Jag tror det nästa vecka med vänner.
english: I think so next week with friends.

target: Det kan vara sant väldigt ofta gärna.
english: That may be true very often gladly.

target: Vilken tur att vi hann med det sista tåget hem!
english: What luck that we made it onto the last train home!

target: Vilken otur att det började regna precis när vi kom.
english: What bad luck that it started raining just when we arrived.

target: Så klart att jag hjälper dig med det projektet.
english: Of course I will help you with that project.

target: Vad menar du hela tiden egentligen?
english: What do you mean all the time actually?

target: Jag har ingen aning varje dag väl.
english: I have no idea every day I suppose.
grammar: "Aning" = idea/inkling. "Ingen aning" = no idea.

target: Det stämmer precis, du har helt rätt om det.
english: That is correct, you are completely right about it.
grammar: "Stämma" means to be correct or to match — used to confirm information.

target: Det finns inget att göra nästa vecka.
english: There's nothing to do next week.

target: Det var på tiden efter jobbet egentligen!
english: It was about time after work actually!

target: Det är lika bra det var verkligen oväntat men väldigt positivt.
english: It's just as well it was really unexpected but very positive.

target: Vad händer egentligen med projektet som vi planerade förut?
english: What is actually happening with the project we planned before?

target: Hur går det nästa vecka efter jobbet?
english: How is it going next week after work?

target: Det ordnar sig sedan länge för alla.
english: It will work out for a long time for everyone.
grammar: Swedes often say "det ordnar sig" to express calm optimism about the future.

target: Inte en chans i centrum varje morgon!
english: Not a chance in the center every morning!

target: Du skämtar väl inte med mig om det här?
english: You are surely not joking with me about this?

target: Jag menar allvar på kvällen redan.
english: I am serious in the evening already.
grammar: "Mena allvar" = be serious. "Allvar" = seriousness.

target: Det var länge sedan ibland redan.
english: It was a long time ago sometimes already.
grammar: "Länge sedan" = long ago. "Det var länge sedan vi sågs" = it's been a long time.

target: Var så snäll varje dag redan.
english: Please every day already.
grammar: "Var så snäll" literally means "be so kind" — a polite way to ask for something.

target: Sluta med det under veckan gärna!
english: Stop that during the week gladly!

target: Vad ska vi göra på kvällen idag?
english: What should we do in the evening today?

target: Jag har bråttom förra veckan nog.
english: I am in a hurry last week probably.

target: Ta det lugnt nästa vecka nog.
english: Take it easy next week probably.
grammar: "Ta det lugnt" is one of the most common Swedish expressions for "calm down" or "relax."

target: Skynda dig så att vi inte missar bussen dit!
english: Hurry up so that we do not miss the bus there!

target: Vi får se hela tiden snart.
english: We'll see all the time soon.
grammar: "Få" here means "will have to" — a softer future than "ska."

target: Jag längtar dit hela tiden gärna.
english: I long to go there all the time gladly.
grammar: "Längta" expresses yearning or longing — a deeply Swedish word with no exact English match.

target: Det gick snabbt efter jobbet nu!
english: That went fast after work now!

target: Det var inte meningen varje dag redan.
english: I didn't mean to every day already.

target: Jag klarar det i centrum ibland idag.
english: I can handle it in the center sometimes today.

target: Ge inte upp nu för du är nästan framme!
english: Do not give up now because you are almost there!

target: Jag gör mitt bästa just nu dit.
english: I am doing my best right now there.

target: Vilken överraskning att se dig här efter så lång tid!
english: What a surprise to see you here after such a long time!

target: Äntligen har vi kommit fram till vårt mål nu.
english: Finally we have reached our goal now.
grammar: "Äntligen" = finally/at last. Expresses relief after a long wait.

target: Det räcker nu, vi behöver inte diskutera mer om det.
english: That is enough now, we do not need to discuss it more.

target: Jag håller inte med förra veckan väl.
english: I don't agree last week I suppose.

target: Det låter konstigt i helgen verkligen.
english: That sounds strange on the weekend really.

target: Jag har ont om tid på morgonen.
english: I'm short on time in the morning.

target: Det spelar roll varje dag egentligen.
english: It matters every day actually.

target: Vad roligt att du kommer på middag hos oss ikväll!
english: How fun that you are coming to dinner at our place tonight!

target: Vad tråkigt att höra att du inte mår bra idag.
english: How sad to hear that you do not feel well today.
grammar: "Tråkigt" means both "boring" and "sad/too bad" depending on context.

target: Vad skönt att vara hemma igen efter den långa resan.
english: How nice to be home again after the long trip.

target: Det är typiskt på stationen varje morgon!
english: That's typical at the station every morning!

target: Jag fattar precis vad du menar, det är tydligt.
english: I get exactly what you mean, it is clear.
grammar: "Fatta" is casual for understanding. More formal: "förstå."

target: Jag fattar inte på kvällen gärna.
english: I don't get it in the evening gladly.

target: Skit samma, vi gör det på vårt sätt istället.
english: Whatever, we will do it our way instead.
grammar: Mildly vulgar but extremely common in casual Swedish.

target: Det var inte illa förra veckan väl.
english: That wasn't bad last week I suppose.

target: Helt okej tillsammans i skolan på jobbet.
english: Totally okay together at school at work.

target: Lagom bra tillsammans för alla verkligen.
english: Moderately good together for everyone really.
grammar: "Lagom" — not too good, not too bad, just the right amount.

target: Det är en bra fråga under sommaren.
english: That's a good question during the summer.

target: Kolla vad jag hittade i den gamla lådan igår!
english: Look what I found in the old box yesterday!

target: Vad i hela världen ibland redan?
english: What in the world sometimes already?

target: Herregud, jag kan inte tro att det verkligen hände!
english: Oh my God, I cannot believe that it really happened!

target: Jisses, det var verkligen oväntat men väldigt positivt!
english: Gosh, it was really unexpected but very positive!

target: Oj då, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: Oh dear, I understand how you feel right now!

target: Det var det sista jag väntade mig.
english: That was the last thing I expected.

target: Det kan inte stämma jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu.
english: That can't be right I understand how you feel right now.

target: Så kan det gå just nu också.
english: That's how it goes right now too.

target: Man lär sig så länge man lever.
english: You learn as long as you live.

target: Bättre sent än aldrig på morgonen nog.
english: Better late than never in the morning probably.

target: Ingen ko på isen sedan länge nog.
english: No cow on the ice for a long time probably.
grammar: "Ingen ko på isen" means no worries — a distinctly Swedish idiom.

target: Nu kör vi på stranden varje morgon!
english: Let's go! / Here we go at the beach every morning!

target: Jag ser det som en möjlighet redan.
english: I see it as an opportunity already.

target: Vi tar det som det kommer nog.
english: We'll take it as it comes probably.

target: Det går inte att klaga under veckan.
english: Can't complain during the week.

target: Jag tänkte att det var du egentligen.
english: I thought it was you actually.

target: Det verkar bra hela tiden med vänner.
english: It seems good all the time with friends.

target: Jag antar det under veckan alltid.
english: I suppose so during the week always.

target: Vi hörs sedan efter jobbet på kontoret.
english: We'll talk later after work at the office.

target: Det var allt för idag på kvällen.
english: That was all for today in the evening.

target: Punkt slut, vi har redan bestämt oss om den saken.
english: End of discussion, we have already decided about that matter.

target: Vad var det jag sa förra veckan!
english: What did I tell you last week!

target: Jag visste det på kvällen redan!
english: I knew it in the evening already!

target: Det ska bli spännande på kvällen nu.
english: That will be exciting in the evening now.

target: Vi ses där varje dag nog!
english: See you there every day probably!

target: Jag kommer så fort jag kan alltid.
english: I'll come as soon as I can always.

target: Inga problem tillsammans alltid efter jobbet.
english: No problems together always after work.

target: Det var gott under sommaren egentligen!
english: That was tasty during the summer actually!

target: Jag är mätt på kvällen nog.
english: I am full in the evening probably.
grammar: "Mätt" means satisfied/full after eating — important at Swedish dinner parties.

target: Det var som fan efter jobbet egentligen!
english: That was unbelievable after work actually!
grammar: Mildly vulgar exclamation expressing astonishment.

target: Jag har inte råd efter jobbet väl.
english: I can't afford it after work I suppose.

target: Det löser sig under sommaren på morgonen.
english: It will work itself out during the summer in the morning.

target: Inte illa, när jag hörde de goda nyheterna idag!
english: Not bad, when I heard the good news today!

target: Vilken dag, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: What a day, I understand how you feel right now!

target: Typiskt svenskt, det är precis vad jag behövde höra nu!
english: Typically Swedish, that is exactly what I needed to hear now!

target: Jag är med på kvällen redan.
english: I'm in in the evening already.

target: Rätt ska vara rätt hela tiden nog.
english: Right is right / Fair is fair all the time probably.

target: Det duger gott och väl för det vi behöver.
english: It is good enough for what we need.

target: Hur bär man sig åt ibland väl?
english: How does one go about it sometimes I suppose?

target: Jag tar reda på det just nu.
english: I'll find out right now.

target: Det har du rätt i varje morgon.
english: You're right about that every morning.

target: Jag tror inte det just nu på helgerna.
english: I don't think so right now on weekends.

target: Det lät ju bra på kvällen gärna!
english: That sounded great in the evening gladly!

target: Detsamma, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: Same to you, I understand how you feel right now!

target: Tack detsamma, när jag hörde de goda nyheterna idag!
english: Thanks, same to you, when I heard the good news today!

target: Akta dig, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: Watch out, I understand how you feel right now!

target: Passa dig, det var verkligen oväntat men väldigt positivt!
english: Be careful, it was really unexpected but very positive!

target: Jag vill inte störa jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu.
english: I don't want to disturb I understand how you feel right now.

target: Det var snällt av dig under sommaren.
english: That was nice of you during the summer.

target: Du är för snäll på morgonen nog.
english: You are too kind in the morning probably.

target: Lagom är bäst hela tiden nog.
english: Moderation is best all the time probably.
grammar: "Lagom är bäst" — the unofficial Swedish motto. Just the right amount is ideal.

target: Jag gick till affären igår ibland väl.
english: I went to the store yesterday sometimes I suppose.
grammar: "Gå" is irregular in past tense: gå → gick. Many common verbs are irregular.

target: Hon åt frukost klockan sju på kvällen.
english: She ate breakfast at seven in the evening.
grammar: "Äta" → "åt" in past tense. One of the most common irregular verbs.

target: Vi reste till Gotland förra sommaren sedan länge.
english: We traveled to Gotland last summer for a long time.
grammar: Group 2 verbs: -te ending in past: resa → reste.

target: Han spelade fotboll som barn just nu.
english: He played football as a child right now.
grammar: Group 1 verbs: -ade ending in past: spela → spelade.

target: De bodde i Lund i tio år.
english: They lived in Lund for ten years.

target: Jag drack kaffe i morse efter jobbet.
english: I drank coffee this morning after work.
grammar: "Dricka" → "drack." Irregular — the vowel changes like English drink/drank.

target: Vi såg en fin film igår dit.
english: We saw a nice movie yesterday there.
grammar: "Se" → "såg." Another common irregular verb.

target: Hon kom hem sent förra veckan alltid.
english: She came home late last week always.

target: Det regnade hela dagen i centrum varje morgon.
english: It rained all day in the center every morning.

target: Jag köpte en ny jacka ibland förra året.
english: I bought a new jacket sometimes last year.
grammar: "Köpa" is Group 2: köper, köpte, köpt. Past: -te ending.

target: Vi läste en bok tillsammans på morgonen.
english: We read a book together in the morning.
grammar: "Läsa" is Group 2: läser, läste, läst.

target: Han skrev ett brev till sin mamma.
english: He wrote a letter to his mom.
grammar: "Skriva" is strong: skriver, skrev, skrivit. Vowel changes.

target: De sjöng svenska sånger sedan länge nog.
english: They sang Swedish songs for a long time probably.
grammar: "Sjunga" is strong: sjunger, sjöng, sjungit. i-ö-u pattern.

target: Jag sprang fem kilometer på kvällen på kontoret.
english: I ran five kilometers in the evening at the office.

target: Vi sov länge på lördag varje morgon.
english: We slept in on Saturday every morning.
grammar: "Sova" is strong: sover, sov, sovit.

target: Hon hittade sina nycklar varje dag redan.
english: She found her keys every day already.
grammar: "Hitta" is Group 1: hittar, hittade, hittat.

target: Jag tappade min telefon i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: I dropped my phone in the library every morning.

target: Vi hade en trevlig kväll varje dag.
english: We had a pleasant evening every day.
grammar: "Ha" → "hade" in past tense. Irregular but very common.

target: Han var sjuk förra veckan på kvällen.
english: He was sick last week in the evening.
grammar: "Vara" → "var" in past tense. The most basic irregular verb.

target: De blev förvånade väldigt ofta till slut.
english: They were surprised very often in the end.
grammar: "Bli" → "blev" is used like English "became" but also for "got" (surprised, angry, etc.).

target: Jag lärde mig att simma som liten.
english: I learned to swim when I was little.

target: Vi flyttade hit 2015 sedan länge förra året.
english: We moved here in 2015 for a long time last year.

target: Hon slutade jobba klockan fem efter jobbet.
english: She stopped working at five after work.
grammar: "Sluta" = stop/finish. Group 1: slutar, slutade, slutat.

target: Jag började studera i september under veckan.
english: I started studying in September during the week.

target: Vi åkte skidor i fjällen under sommaren.
english: We went skiing in the mountains during the summer.
grammar: "Åka skidor" = go skiing. "Åka" → "åkte" (Group 2).

target: Han stod i kön i en timme.
english: He stood in line for an hour.
grammar: "Stå" → "stod." Swedes are known for being orderly queue-standers.

target: Jag satt på bussen i trettio minuter.
english: I sat on the bus for thirty minutes.

target: De fick en present förra veckan också.
english: They got a present last week too.
grammar: "Få" → "fick" (got). Used very frequently in Swedish.

target: Vi tog tåget till Malmö efter jobbet.
english: We took the train to Malmö after work.

target: Jag gav honom min adress varje dag.
english: I gave him my address every day.

target: Hon sa att hon var trött egentligen.
english: She said she was tired actually.
grammar: "Säga" → "sa" — short and irregular.

target: Vi tyckte om maten på stationen varje morgon.
english: We liked the food at the station every morning.

target: Jag trodde att du var hemma egentligen.
english: I thought you were at home actually.

target: Han förstod allt i affären varje morgon.
english: He understood everything in the store every morning.

target: De vann matchen just nu varje dag.
english: They won the match right now every day.

target: Vi förlorade tyvärr sedan länge nog.
english: Unfortunately we lost for a long time probably.

target: Jag öppnade dörren just nu varje vecka.
english: I opened the door right now every week.

target: Hon stängde fönstret på morgonen varje dag.
english: She closed the window in the morning every day.

target: Vi lagade middag tillsammans förra veckan gärna.
english: We cooked dinner together last week gladly.

target: Han tvättade bilen förra veckan också.
english: He washed the car last week too.

target: Jag ringde min syster på morgonen efter jobbet.
english: I called my sister in the morning after work.

target: Vi diskuterade saken hela tiden nästa år.
english: We discussed the matter all the time next year.

target: Hon berättade en rolig historia förra veckan.
english: She told a funny story last week.

target: De dansade hela natten förra veckan också.
english: They danced all night last week too.

target: Jag badade i havet i affären varje morgon.
english: I swam in the sea in the store every morning.

target: Vi vandrade i biblioteket sedan länge i Sverige.
english: We hiked in the library for a long time in Sweden.

target: Han cyklade till jobbet hela tiden efter jobbet.
english: He cycled to work all the time after work.

target: Jag lyssnade på musik varje dag redan.
english: I listened to music every day already.

target: Vi tittade på nyheterna i helgen på jobbet.
english: We watched the news on the weekend at work.

target: Hon handlade mat just nu ofta.
english: She did the grocery shopping right now often.

target: De hjälpte oss att flytta efter jobbet.
english: They helped us move after work.

target: Jag tackade för hjälpen i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: I thanked for the help in the library every morning.

target: Vi firade midsommar i Dalarna varje dag.
english: We celebrated midsummer in Dalarna every day.

target: Han frågade om vägen varje dag redan.
english: He asked about the way every day already.

target: Jag svarade på mejlet i helgen egentligen.
english: I answered the email on the weekend actually.

target: Vi beställde pizza just nu ute.
english: We ordered pizza right now outside.

target: Hon betalade räkningen varje dag egentligen.
english: She paid the bill every day actually.

target: De visade oss runt efter jobbet också.
english: They showed us around after work too.

target: Jag provade svenska köttbullar förra veckan gärna.
english: I tried Swedish meatballs last week gladly.

target: Vi besökte Vasamuseet under sommaren förra året.
english: We visited the Vasa Museum during the summer last year.

target: Han klädde sig fint efter jobbet i Sverige.
english: He dressed up nicely after work in Sweden.

target: Jag vaknade tidigt just nu ibland.
english: I woke up early right now sometimes.
grammar: "Vakna" = wake up (intransitive). "Väcka" = wake someone (transitive).

target: Vi somnade sent väldigt ofta hemma.
english: We fell asleep late very often at home.

target: Hon log mot mig under veckan gärna.
english: She smiled at me during the week gladly.
grammar: "Le" → "log." A short, irregular verb.

target: Jag skrattade högt väldigt ofta i skolan.
english: I laughed loudly very often at school.

target: De grät av glädje i helgen på jobbet.
english: They cried with joy on the weekend at work.
grammar: "Gråta" → "grät" — an irregular strong verb.

target: Vi njöt av solnedgången efter jobbet för alla.
english: We enjoyed the sunset after work for everyone.

target: Han tänkte på framtiden i skogen varje morgon.
english: He thought about the future in the forest every morning.

target: Jag kände mig lycklig i centrum varje morgon.
english: I felt happy in the center every morning.

target: Vi bestämde oss för att stanna till slut.
english: We decided to stay in the end.
grammar: "Bestämma sig för" = decide on. The preposition "för" is required.

target: Hon lovade att komma förra veckan alltid.
english: She promised to come last week always.

target: De glömde sina väskor efter jobbet på helgerna.
english: They forgot their bags after work on weekends.

target: Jag mindes plötsligt den gången vi besökte Stockholm förra året.
english: I suddenly remembered that time we visited Stockholm last year.

target: Vi hoppades på bra väder just nu.
english: We hoped for good weather right now.

target: Han föreslog en promenad hela tiden ofta.
english: He suggested a walk all the time often.

target: Jag lade märke till förändringen nästa vecka.
english: I noticed the change next week.
grammar: "Lägga märke till" = notice. A three-part particle verb.

target: Vi hörde en konstig ljud i helgen.
english: We heard a strange sound on the weekend.

target: Hon kände lukten av nybakat bröd just nu.
english: She smelled the scent of freshly baked bread right now.
grammar: "Nybakat" = freshly baked. Compound adj: "ny" + past participle "bakat."

target: De flöt på vattnet ibland redan.
english: They floated on the water sometimes already.

target: Jag bar väskan hela vägen ibland nog.
english: I carried the bag the whole way sometimes probably.

target: Vi slog läger i helgen nog.
english: We set up camp on the weekend probably.

target: Han bröt armen sedan länge hemma.
english: He broke his arm for a long time at home.

target: Jag valde den blå tröjan på kvällen.
english: I chose the blue sweater in the evening.

target: Vi bjöd in grannen i helgen på kontoret.
english: We invited the neighbor on the weekend at the office.

target: Hon sjönk ner i soffan efter jobbet.
english: She sank into the sofa after work.

target: De dog av skratt just nu med vänner.
english: They died of laughter right now with friends.

target: Jag fann svaret väldigt ofta egentligen.
english: I found the answer very often actually.

target: Vi klev av bussen sedan länge alltid.
english: We got off the bus for a long time always.

target: Han drog i dörren efter jobbet ibland.
english: He pulled the door after work sometimes.

target: Jag sköt upp mötet i helgen under sommaren.
english: I postponed the meeting on the weekend during summer.

target: Vi for till landet på morgonen väl.
english: We went to the countryside in the morning I suppose.
grammar: "Fara" → "for" — an old Swedish verb for traveling, still commonly used.

target: Hon bet i äpplet förra veckan också.
english: She bit into the apple last week too.

target: Jag frös hela kvällen under sommaren sedan länge.
english: I was cold all evening during the summer for a long time.
grammar: "Frysa" → "frös" means to freeze/be cold.

target: Vi slöt fred just nu gärna.
english: We made peace right now gladly.

target: Han band fast båten efter jobbet för alla.
english: He tied the boat after work for everyone.

target: Jag höll i ratten i helgen dit.
english: I held the steering wheel on the weekend there.

target: Vi ställde in festen hela tiden för alla.
english: We cancelled the party all the time for everyone.

target: De fick plats på tåget ibland till slut.
english: They got seats on the train sometimes in the end.

target: Jag lämnade hemmet tidigt väldigt ofta dit.
english: I left home early very often there.

target: Vi anlände sent på kvällen ibland på jobbet.
english: We arrived late in the evening sometimes at work.

target: Hon parkerade bilen utanför hela tiden ute.
english: She parked the car outside all the time outside.

target: De packade väskorna förra veckan gärna.
english: They packed the bags last week gladly.

target: Jag bokade flyget sedan länge efter jobbet.
english: I booked the flight for a long time after work.

target: Vi checkade in på hotellet förra veckan.
english: We checked in at the hotel last week.

target: Han fotograferade solnedgången sedan länge nästa år.
english: He photographed the sunset for a long time next year.

target: Jag skickade ett vykort hela tiden med vänner.
english: I sent a postcard all the time with friends.

target: Vi provsmakadefika lokala ostar just nu gärna.
english: We tasted local cheeses right now gladly.

target: De upplevde norrskenet på kvällen under sommaren.
english: They experienced the northern lights in the evening during summer.

target: Jag njöt av varje ögonblick förra veckan.
english: I enjoyed every moment last week.

target: Jag ser dig på morgonen dit.
english: I see you in the morning there.
grammar: Object pronouns: mig (me), dig (you), honom (him), henne (her), oss (us), er (you pl.), dem (them).

target: Hon gav mig en present sedan länge.
english: She gave me a present for a long time.
grammar: Indirect objects (mig, dig, etc.) come before direct objects: "gav mig en present."

target: Vi hjälpte dem under veckan alltid.
english: We helped them during the week always.
grammar: "Dem" is the object form of "de" (they). In speech, both are often pronounced "dom."

target: Han ringde henne igår i affären varje morgon.
english: He called her yesterday in the store every morning.
grammar: Object pronouns: mig, dig, honom, henne, oss, er, dem. "Henne" = her (object).

target: Kan du ge mig saltet nästa vecka?
english: Can you give me the salt next week?
grammar: Object pronouns go right after the verb: "ge mig," "hjälp mig."

target: Jag saknar er på morgonen verkligen.
english: I miss you (plural) in the morning really.
grammar: "Er" is both 'you' (object, plural) and 'your.' Context determines the meaning.

target: Läraren frågade oss sedan länge väl.
english: The teacher asked us for a long time I suppose.
grammar: "Oss" = us. Object form of "vi" (we).

target: Vänta på mig efter jobbet alltid!
english: Wait for me after work always!
grammar: Many Swedish verbs need a preposition with their object: vänta PÅ (wait for).

target: Jag älskar dig i trädgården varje morgon.
english: I love you in the garden every morning.
grammar: "Dig" = you (object). Pronounced "dej" in everyday speech.

target: Vi besökte honom på sjukhuset i helgen.
english: We visited him at the hospital on the weekend.
grammar: "Honom" is the object form of "han." Swedish distinguishes subject/object pronouns clearly.

target: Kan du hjälpa mig med det här?
english: Can you help me with this?
grammar: "Det här" (this) vs. "det där" (that) — "här" and "där" add proximity.

target: Hon tittade på oss på kvällen snart.
english: She looked at us in the evening soon.
grammar: "Titta på" = look at. Object pronouns after prepositions: på mig, på dig, på oss, på dem.

target: Ge dem tid varje dag redan.
english: Give them time every day already.
grammar: "Dem" is pronounced "dom" in speech, as is "de" (they).

target: Jag hörde dig inte väldigt ofta sedan länge.
english: I didn't hear you very often for a long time.
grammar: "Inte" goes after the object pronoun: "hörde dig inte."

target: Han bad henne om hjälp på morgonen.
english: He asked her for help in the morning.
grammar: "Be om" = ask for. "Bad" is past of "be." Indirect object (henne) before "om."

target: Vi förstår er i helgen för alla.
english: We understand you (plural) on the weekend for everyone.
grammar: "Er" is both "you" (object, plural) and "your." In speech, "er" as object is being replaced by "dig" (singular).

target: Följ mig så visar jag dig vägen till stationen.
english: Follow me and I will show you the way to the station.
grammar: In imperatives, the pronoun follows directly: "Följ mig," "Ring honom."

target: Jag ska ringa honom ikväll hela tiden.
english: I'll call him tonight all the time.
grammar: "Honom" = him. Object form of "han" (he).

target: Hon berättade det för oss varje dag.
english: She told us about it every day.
grammar: "Berätta för" = tell (to someone). "Det" (it) as object goes before "för oss."

target: Kan ni se mig på morgonen väl?
english: Can you (plural) see me in the morning I suppose?
grammar: "Ni" = you (plural subject). "Er" = you (plural object). "Mig" is often pronounced "mej."

target: Jag träffade henne på festen på kvällen.
english: I met her at the party in the evening.
grammar: "Träffa" = meet. Object pronouns go right after the verb: "träffade henne."

target: Han skickade oss ett paket väldigt ofta.
english: He sent us a package very often.
grammar: Indirect object (oss) before direct object (ett paket): "skickade oss ett paket."

target: De bjöd mig på middag under veckan.
english: They invited me for dinner during the week.
grammar: "Bjuda på" = treat to / invite for. "Bjöd" is past of "bjuda" (strong verb).

target: Jag litar på dig i helgen gärna.
english: I trust you on the weekend gladly.
grammar: "Lita på" = to trust. The preposition "på" is required.

target: Hon lyssnade på honom ibland hemma.
english: She listened to him sometimes at home.

target: Vi väntar på er efter jobbet gärna.
english: We are waiting for you (plural) after work gladly.

target: Kan du lära mig svenska ibland nog?
english: Can you teach me Swedish sometimes probably?

target: Jag visade dem vägen i trädgården varje morgon.
english: I showed them the way in the garden every morning.

target: Hon gav oss sin adress varje dag.
english: She gave us her address every day.

target: Han frågade mig om vägen hela tiden.
english: He asked me about the way all the time.

target: De tackar dig för hjälpen sedan länge.
english: They thank you for the help for a long time.

target: Vi gillar henne mycket förra veckan på helgerna.
english: We like her a lot last week on weekends.

target: Jag behöver dig på kvällen idag.
english: I need you in the evening today.

target: Hon bryr sig om oss varje morgon.
english: She cares about us every morning.
grammar: "Bry sig om" = to care about. A reflexive verb with a preposition.

target: Han tänker på henne på kontoret varje morgon.
english: He thinks about her at the office every morning.

target: Vi såg dem i helgen i skolan.
english: We saw them on the weekend at school.

target: Jag ringde till er igår varje morgon.
english: I called you (plural) yesterday every morning.

target: Hon hämtade mig vid stationen förra veckan.
english: She picked me up at the station last week.

target: Han svarade oss direkt på kvällen egentligen.
english: He answered us immediately in the evening actually.

target: De bjöd henne på fika hela tiden.
english: They invited her for fika all the time.

target: Jag följde honom till dörren ibland här.
english: I followed him to the door sometimes here.

target: Vi ska träffa dem imorgon under sommaren.
english: We'll meet them tomorrow during the summer.

target: Hon lovade mig att komma nästa vecka.
english: She promised me to come next week.

target: Han underhöll oss med historier hela tiden.
english: He entertained us with stories all the time.

target: De överraskade henne i helgen idag.
english: They surprised her on the weekend today.

target: Jag presenterade honom för mina föräldrar förra året.
english: I introduced him to my parents last year.

target: Vi gratulerade dem hela tiden alltid.
english: We congratulated them all the time always.

target: Han gav mig sitt telefonnummer under sommaren.
english: He gave me his phone number during the summer.

target: Hon bad mig vänta hela tiden väl.
english: She asked me to wait all the time I suppose.

target: Vi bjöd in dem till festen varje dag.
english: We invited them to the party every day.

target: Jag såg henne under sommaren redan.
english: I saw her during the summer already.

target: Han skrämde oss efter jobbet för alla.
english: He scared us after work for everyone.

target: De störde mig under veckan alltid.
english: They disturbed me during the week always.

target: Jag tröstade henne på kvällen ibland.
english: I comforted her in the evening sometimes.

target: Vi varnade dem på kvällen redan.
english: We warned them in the evening already.

target: Hon gladde mig med nyheten på morgonen.
english: She made me happy with the news in the morning.

target: Han imponerade på oss nästa vecka i skolan.
english: He impressed us next week at school.

target: Jag beundrar henne varje dag egentligen.
english: I admire her every day actually.

target: Vi uppmuntrade honom på morgonen nog.
english: We encouraged him in the morning probably.

target: De ignorerade mig vid sjön varje morgon.
english: They ignored me by the lake every morning.

target: Jag respekterar er på morgonen varje dag.
english: I respect you (plural) in the morning every day.

target: Hon förlät mig på morgonen hemma.
english: She forgave me in the morning at home.
grammar: "Förlåta" → "förlät" in past tense. Forgiveness is important in Swedish culture.

target: Vi välkomnade dem förra veckan alltid.
english: We welcomed them last week always.

target: Han förstod mig inte förra veckan gärna.
english: He didn't understand me last week gladly.

target: De bjöd oss på kaffe förra veckan.
english: They offered us coffee last week.

target: Jag minns henne nästa vecka ofta.
english: I remember her next week often.

target: Vi stödde honom under veckan gärna.
english: We supported him during the week gladly.

target: Hon undervisade oss i svenska väldigt ofta.
english: She taught us Swedish very often.

target: Han inspirerade mig förra veckan väl.
english: He inspired me last week I suppose.

target: De försvarade oss på kvällen egentligen.
english: They defended us in the evening actually.

target: Jag tackade henne sedan länge på helgerna.
english: I thanked her for a long time on weekends.

target: Vi beundrar dem nästa vecka varje dag.
english: We admire them next week every day.

target: Han tröttade ut mig på kvällen i Sverige.
english: He wore me out in the evening in Sweden.

target: Hon lugnande ner oss efter jobbet i Sverige.
english: She calmed us down after work in Sweden.

target: De förvirrade mig på morgonen nog.
english: They confused me in the morning probably.

target: Jag tror på dig under den trevliga middagen med alla vännerna.
english: I believe in you during the nice dinner with all the friends.
grammar: "Tro på" = believe in. Different from "tro" alone which means to think/assume.

target: Vi lämnade henne ifred på kvällen nog.
english: We left her alone in the evening probably.

target: Han påminde mig om mötet varje morgon.
english: He reminded me about the meeting every morning.

target: De behandlade oss väl efter jobbet hemma.
english: They treated us well after work at home.

target: Jag saknar honom på morgonen verkligen.
english: I miss him in the morning really.

target: Vi besvärade henne på stationen varje morgon.
english: We bothered her at the station every morning.

target: Han räddade oss under veckan också.
english: He saved us during the week too.

target: De följde mig hem ibland hemma.
english: They followed me home sometimes at home.

target: Jag övertalade henne i centrum ibland hemma.
english: I persuaded her in the center sometimes at home.

target: Vi tillät dem att gå varje dag.
english: We allowed them to go every day.

target: Hon hindrade mig under sommaren nu.
english: She stopped me during the summer now.

target: Han avbröt oss sedan länge nästa år.
english: He interrupted us for a long time next year.

target: De förvånade mig under veckan också.
english: They amazed me during the week too.

target: Jag kallade honom vid namn förra veckan.
english: I called him by name last week.

target: Vi erbjöd dem hjälp under sommaren just nu.
english: We offered them help during the summer right now.

target: Hon visade mig sin trädgård varje morgon.
english: She showed me her garden every morning.

target: De gav oss hopp varje dag till slut.
english: They gave us hope every day in the end.

target: Jag ber dig om en tjänst på kontoret.
english: I ask you for a favor at the office.
grammar: "Be om en tjänst" = ask for a favor. "Tjänst" also means service/job.

target: Vi anförtrodde henne hemligheten på morgonen också.
english: We entrusted her with the secret in the morning too.

target: Han envisades med att hjälpa mig här.
english: He insisted on helping me here.

target: Jag förstår dig helt ibland sedan länge.
english: I understand you completely sometimes for a long time.

target: De missade oss varje dag egentligen.
english: They missed us every day actually.

target: Vi mötte honom utanför i centrum varje morgon.
english: We met him outside in the center every morning.

target: Hon berömde mig hela tiden ibland.
english: She praised me all the time sometimes.

target: Jag undvek henne på morgonen förra året.
english: I avoided her in the morning last year.

target: De skyddade oss på morgonen hemma.
english: They protected us in the morning at home.

target: Han oroade mig nästa vecka varje vecka.
english: He worried me next week every week.

target: Jag uppskattade henne väldigt ofta nu.
english: I appreciated her very often now.

target: Vi förde dem till hotellet just nu.
english: We took them to the hotel right now.

target: Han övertygade mig i helgen med familjen.
english: He convinced me on the weekend with the family.

target: Jag bad honom stanna just nu i skolan.
english: I asked him to stay right now at school.

target: De lärde oss allt varje dag egentligen.
english: They taught us everything every day actually.

target: Vi bärgar henne i helgen redan.
english: We carry her on the weekend already.

target: Hon berörde mig djupt nästa vecka till slut.
english: She touched me deeply next week in the end.

target: Jag bad er vänta på kvällen nog.
english: I asked you (plural) to wait in the evening probably.

target: Jag kan simma efter jobbet också.
english: I can swim after work too.
grammar: "Kan" expresses ability. The main verb is always in infinitive: kan + simma.

target: Du måste gå nu hela tiden alltid.
english: You must go now all the time always.
grammar: "Måste" has no infinitive form — it's always "måste" in all tenses.

target: Vi ska åka till stugan varje morgon.
english: We are going to go to the cabin every morning.
grammar: "Ska" expresses intention, plan, or future. Very frequently used.

target: Hon vill lära sig danska ibland nog.
english: She wants to learn Danish sometimes probably.
grammar: "Vill" = want. Unlike English, no "to" needed: "vill lära sig" not "vill att lära sig."

target: Jag borde ringa henne efter jobbet här.
english: I should call her after work here.
grammar: "Borde" = should/ought to. It implies advice or mild obligation.

target: Man får inte röka här nästa vecka.
english: You may not smoke here next week.
grammar: "Får" = may/allowed to. "Får inte" = must not / not allowed to.

target: Vi behöver handla mat varje dag idag.
english: We need to buy groceries every day today.
grammar: "Behöva" = need. Can be followed by infinitive or a noun.

target: Han kan inte komma idag väldigt ofta.
english: He cannot come today very often.
grammar: Modal + inte + infinitive: the negation goes between the modal and main verb.

target: Du ska inte oroa dig sedan länge.
english: You shouldn't worry for a long time.
grammar: "Ska" + infinitive expresses plans or obligations. "Oroa sig" is reflexive (worry oneself).

target: Vi måste bestämma oss snart ibland idag.
english: We must decide soon sometimes today.
grammar: "Måste" (must) never changes form — same for all persons, all tenses.

target: Jag vill ha en glass på kvällen.
english: I want an ice cream in the evening.
grammar: "Vill ha" = want (a thing). Just "vill" = want (to do). Don't forget "ha" with nouns.

target: Hon kan prata tre språk just nu.
english: She can speak three languages right now.
grammar: "Kan" means both 'can' and 'know how to.' No 'att' before the infinitive after modals.

target: Vi ska träffas klockan fem under veckan.
english: We are meeting at five o'clock during the week.
grammar: "Ska" for plans/arrangements: "Vi ska träffas" = we're meeting (arranged).

target: Man måste ha biljett sedan länge alltid.
english: You must have a ticket for a long time always.
grammar: "Man" = one/you (impersonal). "Måste" is invariable — no past tense form; use "var tvungen att" for past.

target: Jag får inte äta gluten förra veckan.
english: I may not eat gluten last week.
grammar: "Får inte" = not allowed to. "Får" also means "get/receive" — context determines meaning.

target: Du borde vila dig ibland här.
english: You should rest sometimes here.
grammar: "Borde" = should (present advice, though technically past of "böra"). "Vila sig" = rest (reflexive).

target: Vi behöver inte stressa väldigt ofta idag.
english: We don't need to stress very often today.
grammar: "Behöver inte" = don't need to. Much milder than "måste inte" (must not). Important distinction.

target: Han vill flytta till Spanien på kvällen.
english: He wants to move to Spain in the evening.
grammar: "Vill" = want to. No "att" after modals: "vill flytta" not "vill att flytta."

target: Jag kan hjälpa dig imorgon under sommaren.
english: I can help you tomorrow during the summer.
grammar: "Kan" = can/know how to. No "att" needed: "kan hjälpa" = can help.

target: Vi ska fira med tårta förra veckan.
english: We are going to celebrate with cake last week.
grammar: "Ska" for intentions: "ska fira" = going to celebrate. "Tårta" = cake (layer cake specifically).

target: Hon måste jobba övertid under sommaren alltid.
english: She has to work overtime during the summer always.
grammar: "Övertid" = overtime. "Jobba" is informal for "arbeta" — both mean work.

target: Man borde vara snäll under veckan i Sverige.
english: One should be kind during the week in Sweden.

target: Jag vill inte gå ut ikväll verkligen.
english: I don't want to go out tonight really.

target: Kan du öppna fönstret under veckan alltid?
english: Can you open the window during the week always?
grammar: "Kan du" + infinitive is the standard polite request format.

target: Ska vi ses imorgon nästa vecka nu?
english: Shall we meet tomorrow next week now?

target: Måste vi verkligen gå sedan länge alltid?
english: Must we really go for a long time always?

target: Vill du följa med sedan länge gärna?
english: Do you want to come along for a long time gladly?

target: Får jag sitta här på kvällen redan?
english: May I sit here in the evening already?
grammar: "Får jag" = may I. Polite but not overly formal.

target: Borde vi inte vänta just nu nog?
english: Shouldn't we wait right now probably?

target: Behöver jag ta med något under sommaren?
english: Do I need to bring something during the summer?

target: Jag kan inte hitta mina nycklar också.
english: I can't find my keys too.

target: Vi ska resa till Japan varje morgon.
english: We are going to travel to Japan every morning.

target: Hon vill bli pilot just nu alltid.
english: She wants to become a pilot right now always.

target: Du måste visa passet sedan länge idag.
english: You must show your passport for a long time today.

target: Man får bada gratis här varje dag.
english: You can swim for free here every day.

target: Vi borde äta snart varje dag med familjen.
english: We should eat soon every day with the family.

target: Jag behöver sova mer ibland idag.
english: I need to sleep more sometimes today.

target: Han kan laga mat riktigt bra väl.
english: He can cook really well I suppose.

target: Vi ska gifta oss nästa år nog.
english: We are going to get married next year probably.

target: Hon måste plugga till provet just nu.
english: She must study for the test right now.

target: Jag vill prova surströmming nästa vecka ibland.
english: I want to try surströmming next week sometimes.

target: Man ska vara försiktig på isen nu.
english: One should be careful on the ice now.

target: Du kan ta bussen dit hela tiden.
english: You can take the bus there all the time.

target: Vi behöver mer tid efter jobbet idag.
english: We need more time after work today.

target: Han borde gå till doktorn sedan länge.
english: He should go to the doctor for a long time.

target: Jag får inte glömma det just nu.
english: I must not forget it right now.

target: Vi kan inte stanna längre under sommaren.
english: We cannot stay any longer during the summer.

target: Hon vill inte sluta efter jobbet nu.
english: She doesn't want to stop after work now.

target: Du ska inte vara orolig just nu.
english: You shouldn't be worried right now.

target: Man måste källsortera just nu alltid.
english: You must sort your recycling right now always.
grammar: Recycling (källsortering) is mandatory in Sweden — not just a recommendation.

target: Jag kan tala engelska varje dag väl.
english: I can speak English every day I suppose.

target: Vi ska flytta i höst hela tiden.
english: We are moving in the fall all the time.

target: Hon måste ringa tillbaka på kvällen nu.
english: She must call back in the evening now.
