english: We have definitely decided sometimes already.

target: Han har faktiskt aldrig provat det nog.
english: He has actually never tried it probably.

target: Jag har förmodligen haft fel förra veckan.
english: I have probably been wrong last week.

target: Vi har helt enkelt tur under veckan.
english: We simply have luck during the week.

target: Hon har till slut lyckats på kvällen.
english: She has finally succeeded in the evening.

target: De har i alla fall försökt redan.
english: They have at least tried already.

target: Jag har nu förstått allt hela tiden.
english: I have now understood everything all the time.

target: Vi har hittills klarat oss i helgen.
english: We have managed so far on the weekend.

target: Han har möjligen glömt det på kvällen.
english: He has possibly forgotten it in the evening.

target: Jag har antagligen gjort ett misstag nog.
english: I have probably made a mistake probably.

target: Vi har knappast hunnit på kontoret varje morgon.
english: We have barely had time at the office every morning.

target: Hon har absolut rätt hela tiden väl.
english: She is absolutely right all the time I suppose.

target: De har verkligen imponerat på stranden varje morgon.
english: They have really impressed at the beach every morning.

target: Jag har fullständigt missat det just nu.
english: I have completely missed it right now.

target: Vi har praktiskt taget avslutat varje morgon.
english: We have practically finished every morning.

target: Hur tar jag mig till centralstationen gärna?
english: How do I get to the central station gladly?
grammar: "Hur tar jag mig till..." is the standard way to ask for directions.

target: Gå rakt fram i köket varje morgon.
english: Go straight ahead in the kitchen every morning.
grammar: "Rakt fram" = straight ahead. Essential for giving directions.

target: Sväng till höger vid trafikljuset efter jobbet.
english: Turn right at the traffic light after work.
grammar: "Höger" = right. "Vänster" = left. "Vid" = at.

target: Sväng till vänster vid nästa korsning egentligen.
english: Turn left at the next intersection actually.
grammar: "Vid" means 'at/by.' Directions: till vänster (left), till höger (right), rakt fram (straight).

target: Det ligger på höger sida i helgen.
english: It's on the right side on the weekend.
grammar: "Ligga" (lie/be located) is used for places and flat objects. "Stå" for upright things.

target: Det är fem minuters promenad härifrån väl.
english: It's a five-minute walk from here I suppose.
grammar: "Härifrån" = from here. Compound: här+i+från. Swedish loves building words this way.

target: Ta buss nummer sju hela tiden hemma.
english: Take bus number seven all the time at home.
grammar: Transport: ta bussen (take the bus), åka tåg (go by train), flyga (fly). No article after 'nummer.'

target: Var ligger närmaste tunnelbanestation varje dag redan?
english: Where is the nearest subway station every day already?
grammar: "Tunnelbana" (T-bana) is Stockholm's metro. Gothenburg has trams (spårvagnar).

target: Tåget avgår från spår tre efter jobbet.
english: The train departs from track three after work.
grammar: "Avgå" (depart) — a formal/transport word. Everyday: "Tåget går." "Spår" = track/platform.

target: Vi behöver byta tåg i Nässjö idag.
english: We need to change trains in Nässjö today.
grammar: "Byta tåg" = change trains. Nässjö is a major rail junction.

target: En enkelbiljett till Göteborg, tack väldigt ofta.
english: A one-way ticket to Gothenburg, please very often.
grammar: "Enkelbiljett" = one-way ticket. "Tur och retur" = round trip.

target: En tur och retur till Malmö i Sverige.
english: A round trip to Malmö in Sweden.
grammar: "Tur och retur" = round trip. "Enkel" = one-way. Essential train/bus vocabulary.

target: Var kan jag köpa biljett efter jobbet?
english: Where can I buy a ticket after work?
grammar: "Biljett" = ticket. Most transport tickets in Sweden are digital — "SL-appen" in Stockholm.

target: Du kan betala med Swish i helgen.
english: You can pay with Swish on the weekend.
grammar: Swish is Sweden's mobile payment app — used everywhere from stores to street vendors.

target: Bussen stannar vid torget hela tiden idag.
english: The bus stops at the square all the time today.
grammar: "Torget" = the square/marketplace. "Vid" = at/by (for locations near something).

target: Nästa hållplats är Slussen efter jobbet väl.
english: The next stop is Slussen after work I suppose.
grammar: "Hållplats" = stop (bus/tram). "Station" for train/subway. "Slussen" is a major Stockholm hub.

target: Jag vill åka till flygplatsen varje dag.
english: I want to go to the airport every day.
grammar: "Åka" = go/travel (by vehicle). "Gå" = go (on foot). "Flyga" = fly. Use the right verb!

target: Arlanda Express tar tjugo minuter hela tiden.
english: The Arlanda Express takes twenty minutes all the time.
grammar: "Arlanda" is Stockholm's main airport. "Express" trains connect airports to city centers in Sweden.

target: Vi åker spårvagn på morgonen efter jobbet.
english: We take the tram in the morning after work.
grammar: "Spårvagn" = tram. Gothenburg is famous for its tram network — Stockholm doesn't have trams.

target: Var ligger närmaste busshållplats under sommaren nog?
english: Where is the nearest bus stop during the summer probably?
grammar: "Närmaste" = nearest (superlative of "nära"). "Ligga" for location of places.

target: Finns det en parkeringsplats här just nu?
english: Is there a parking space here right now?
grammar: "Parkeringsplats" = parking spot. Swedish compound: parkering + s + plats.

target: Vi behöver tanka bilen nästa vecka idag.
english: We need to fill up the car next week today.
grammar: "Tanka" = refuel. From "tank." Swedish cars increasingly switch to "ladda" (charge).

target: Hastigheten är begränsad till åttio nästa vecka.
english: The speed is limited to eighty next week.
grammar: "Begränsad till" = limited to. Swedish speed limits: 30-50 urban, 70-120 highways.

target: Kör försiktigt, det är halt ibland redan.
english: Drive carefully, it's slippery sometimes already.
grammar: "Halt" = slippery (ice). "Kör försiktigt" = drive carefully (imperative).

target: Vi tar färjan till Gotland nästa vecka.
english: We take the ferry to Gotland next week.

target: Finns det cykelvägar härifrån just nu väl?
english: Are there bike paths from here right now I suppose?

target: Jag hyr en cykel nästa vecka väl.
english: I rent a bicycle next week I suppose.

target: Gå över bron i affären varje morgon.
english: Walk over the bridge in the store every morning.

target: Fortsätt förbi kyrkan hela tiden också.
english: Continue past the church all the time too.

target: Det ligger i centrum på morgonen ibland.
english: It's in the center in the morning sometimes.

target: Kan du visa mig på kartan också?
english: Can you show me on the map too?

target: Vi har gått fel i helgen redan.
english: We have gone the wrong way on the weekend already.

target: Det är inte långt härifrån hela tiden.
english: It's not far from here all the time.

target: Tåget är försenat med tio minuter redan.
english: The train is delayed by ten minutes already.
grammar: "Försenad" = delayed. "Med" + time = by (amount): delayed by ten minutes.

target: Bussen kommer var femtonde minut under veckan.
english: The bus comes every fifteen minutes during the week.

target: Vi borde ta en taxi efter jobbet.
english: We should take a taxi after work.

target: Flyget landar klockan tre sedan länge gärna.
english: The flight lands at three for a long time gladly.

target: Vi måste checka in senast klockan två.
english: We must check in by two o'clock at the latest.

target: Var är utgången på morgonen nog?
english: Where is the exit in the morning probably?

target: Ingången är på andra sidan nästa vecka.
english: The entrance is on the other side next week.

target: Vi parkerar i garaget förra veckan gärna.
english: We park in the garage last week gladly.

target: Det är enkelriktat här på morgonen redan.
english: It's one-way here in the morning already.

target: Övergångsstället är framme på kvällen nog.
english: The crosswalk is ahead in the evening probably.

target: Håll till vänster på kvällen ibland.
english: Keep to the left in the evening sometimes.

target: Vi promenerar längs kajen på kvällen efter jobbet.
english: We walk along the quay in the evening after work.

target: Det tar ungefär en timme med bil.
english: It takes about an hour by car.

target: Vi kör motorvägen norrut just nu dit.
english: We drive the motorway northward right now there.
grammar: E4 is Sweden's main highway running from Helsingborg to Haparanda.

target: Rondellen kommer snart hela tiden nog.
english: The roundabout is coming soon all the time probably.

target: Vi behöver GPS under sommaren idag.
english: We need GPS during the summer today.

target: Motorvägen är snabbare under veckan alltid.
english: The highway is faster during the week always.

target: Landsvägen är vackrare just nu väl.
english: The country road is more beautiful right now I suppose.

target: Kan jag gå dit till fots väl?
english: Can I walk there I suppose?

target: Det är bara tio minuter med tåg.
english: It's only ten minutes by train.

target: Pendeltåget går till Södertälje väldigt ofta efter jobbet.
english: The commuter train goes to Södertälje very often after work.

target: Vi åker tunnelbana till Odenplan varje morgon.
english: We take the subway to Odenplan every morning.

target: Busshållplatsen är runt hörnet på stranden varje morgon.
english: The bus stop is around the corner at the beach every morning.

target: Vi kliver av vid nästa station verkligen.
english: We get off at the next station really.

target: Tåget stannar inte i Katrineholm på kvällen.
english: The train doesn't stop in Katrineholm in the evening.

target: Plattformen är nere till höger ibland nog.
english: The platform is down to the right sometimes probably.

target: Vi behöver en tidtabell på morgonen idag.
english: We need a timetable in the morning today.

target: Jag bokar biljetten online hela tiden just nu.
english: I book the ticket online all the time right now.

target: Sista bussen gick redan under veckan gärna.
english: The last bus has already left during the week gladly.

target: Vi tar nattåget till Abisko hela tiden.
english: We take the night train to Abisko all the time.

target: Jag åker Öresundståget till Köpenhamn just nu.
english: I take the Öresund train to Copenhagen right now.
grammar: The Öresund Bridge connects Sweden to Denmark — a twenty-minute train ride.

target: Flyget till Luleå tar en och en halv timme.
english: The flight to Luleå takes an hour and a half.

target: Vi landar på Landvetter flygplats på kvällen.
english: We land at Landvetter airport in the evening.

target: Segelbåten ligger i hamnen hela tiden ibland.
english: The sailboat is in the harbor all the time sometimes.

target: Vi paddlar kanot på Klarälven under veckan.
english: We canoe on the Klarälven river during the week.

target: Det finns inga direktflyg dit hela tiden.
english: There are no direct flights there all the time.

target: Vi har en mellanlandning i Oslo redan.
english: We have a layover in Oslo already.

target: Bussen tar en omväg förra veckan alltid.
english: The bus takes a detour last week always.

target: Vi fick plats på sista tåget till slut.
english: We got seats on the last train in the end.

target: Hyrbilen väntar vid flygplatsen varje dag redan.
english: The rental car is waiting at the airport every day already.

target: Vi kör genom Småland väldigt ofta dit.
english: We drive through Småland very often there.

target: Vägen är slingrig men vacker varje morgon.
english: The road is winding but beautiful every morning.

target: Vi stannar vid en rastplats just nu.
english: We stop at a rest area right now.

target: Bensinstationen ligger vid avfarten på morgonen verkligen.
english: The gas station is at the exit in the morning really.

target: Vi följer skyltarna mot Åre förra veckan.
english: We follow the signs towards Åre last week.

target: Det tar tre timmar att köra dit.
english: It takes three hours to drive there.

target: Vi byter till lokaltrafiken under sommaren väl.
english: We switch to the local transit during the summer I suppose.

target: SL-kortet gäller i hela Stockholm under veckan.
english: The SL card is valid in all of Stockholm during the week.
grammar: SL (Storstockholms Lokaltrafik) runs buses, metro, and commuter trains.

target: Biljettpriset har höjts nästa vecka redan.
english: The ticket price has increased next week already.

target: Vi köper biljetten i appen just nu.
english: We buy the ticket in the app right now.

target: Första klass eller andra klass varje dag?
english: First class or second class every day?

target: Vi sitter i tyst avdelning förra veckan.
english: We sit in the quiet section last week.
grammar: Swedish trains have "tyst avdelning" (quiet sections) where phone calls are not allowed.

target: Jag bokar en plats vid fönstret ofta.
english: I book a window seat often.

target: Bistrovagnen har god mat i trädgården varje morgon.
english: The bistro car has good food in the garden every morning.

target: Vi anländer till Umeå klockan åtta väl.
english: We arrive in Umeå at eight I suppose.

target: Bussen går från bussterminalen efter jobbet dit.
english: The bus leaves from the bus terminal after work there.

target: Det finns laddstolpar för elbilar sedan länge.
english: There are charging stations for electric cars for a long time.
grammar: Sweden is rapidly expanding its electric car infrastructure.

target: Vi kör elbil till jobbet varje dag.
english: We drive an electric car to work every day.

target: Cykelbanan går längs vattnet efter jobbet dit.
english: The bike path goes along the water after work there.

target: Vi hyrer en elsparkcykel väldigt ofta nu.
english: We rent an electric scooter very often now.

target: Vi tar Vaxholmsbåten ut i skärgården redan.
english: We take the Vaxholm boat out to the archipelago already.

target: Jag kliver på vid nästa stopp snart.
english: I get on at the next stop soon.

target: Vi köar vid perrongen under sommaren snart.
english: We queue at the platform during the summer soon.

target: Tåget rullar in på kvällen på helgerna.
english: The train rolls into the station in the evening on weekends.

target: Vi har nått vår destination varje morgon.
english: We have reached our destination every morning.

target: Resan var bekväm i helgen redan.
english: The trip was comfortable on the weekend already.

target: Vi tog omvägen för utsiktens skull dit.
english: We took the detour for the view there.

target: Jag vet att hon bor i Malmö.
english: I know that she lives in Malmö.
grammar: "Att" introduces a that-clause. Word order in subordinate clause: subject + inte + verb.

target: Hon sa att det var kallt ute.
english: She said that it was cold outside.
grammar: In att-clauses, word order changes: "inte" comes BEFORE the verb: "att det inte var kallt."

target: Vi hoppas att vädret blir bra verkligen.
english: We hope that the weather will be nice really.
grammar: "Hoppas" is a deponent verb (s-form but active meaning). It takes an att-clause.

target: Han tror att vi kommer i tid.
english: He thinks that we'll be on time.
grammar: "Tro" (believe/think) vs. "tänka" (think/ponder). "Tro" for opinions, "tänka" for mental activity.

target: Jag vet inte om han kommer till slut.
english: I don't know if he's coming in the end.
grammar: "Om" = if/whether in subordinate clauses. Different from "om" = about.

target: Vi undrar om det finns plats här.
english: We wonder if there's space here.
grammar: "Om" introduces indirect yes/no questions: 'We wonder if/whether there's room.'

target: Berätta om du behöver hjälp under sommaren.
english: Tell me if you need help during the summer.
grammar: "Om" here means 'if' — subordinate clause word order: subject before verb.

target: Jag frågar om hon vill följa med.
english: I ask if she wants to come along.
grammar: "Fråga om" = ask whether. "Följa med" = come along — very common particle verb.

target: När jag var liten bodde vi i Kiruna.
english: When I was little we lived in Kiruna.
grammar: "När" = when. Subordinate clause, so "inte" goes BEFORE the verb inside it.

target: Jag ringer dig när jag kommer väl.
english: I'll call you when I arrive I suppose.
grammar: "När" + present tense for future events in Swedish: "when I come" not "when I will come."

target: Vi äter när maten är klar på morgonen.
english: We eat when the food is ready in the morning.
grammar: "Klar" = ready/done. Subordinate clause keeps normal word order after "när."

target: Sedan hon flyttade hit har hon trivts.
english: Since she moved here she has enjoyed it.
grammar: "Sedan" = since. "Trivts" = enjoyed being here (deponent verb "trivas").

target: Innan vi åker måste vi handla med familjen.
english: Before we leave we must shop with the family.
grammar: "Innan" = before (time). Subordinate clause follows.

target: Vi väntade tills regnet slutade ibland förra året.
english: We waited until the rain stopped sometimes last year.

target: Medan vi åt berättade hon historien med familjen.
english: While we ate she told the story with the family.
grammar: "Medan" = while. Used for simultaneous actions.

target: Jag kan inte sova eftersom det är ljust ute.
english: I can't sleep because it's light outside.
grammar: "Eftersom" = because/since. Triggers subordinate word order.

target: Trots att det regnade gick vi ut.
english: Although it rained we went out.
grammar: "Trots att" = although/despite that.

target: Vi stannade hemma för att det snöade.
english: We stayed home because it was snowing.
grammar: "För att" = because (reason). Not to be confused with "för att" = in order to (purpose).

target: Så snart jag kommer hem ringer jag dig.
english: As soon as I get home I'll call you.

target: Innan du går, kan du stänga fönstret?
english: Before you go, can you close the window?

target: Jag tror att det blir en fin dag.
english: I think it will be a nice day.

target: Hon berättade att hon hade fått jobbet.
english: She told us she had gotten the job.
grammar: Reported speech uses past perfect (hade fått) when the original was past tense (fick).

target: Vi är glada att ni kunde komma.
english: We are happy that you could come.

target: Jag vet att du har rätt redan.
english: I know that you are right already.

target: Om det regnar stannar vi inne på morgonen.
english: If it rains we'll stay inside in the morning.
grammar: "Om" = if (conditional). The subordinate clause often comes first.

target: Om vi skyndar oss hinner vi snart.
english: If we hurry we'll make it soon.

target: Jag skulle bli glad om du hjälpte mig.
english: I would be happy if you helped me.

target: Även om det regnar går vi ut.
english: Even if it rains we'll go out.

target: Så fort tåget stannar kliver vi av.
english: As soon as the train stops we get off.

target: Förrän solen gick ner satt vi ute.
english: Until the sun went down we sat outside.

target: Varje gång jag besöker dem bjuds jag på fika.
english: Every time I visit them I'm offered fika.

target: Hon jobbar extra för att kunna resa.
english: She works extra to be able to travel.

target: Vi sparar pengar så att vi kan köpa hus.
english: We save money so that we can buy a house.

target: Jag undrar om det lönar sig gärna.
english: I wonder if it's worth it gladly.

target: Han frågade om jag ville följa med.
english: He asked if I wanted to come along.

target: Vi vet inte om butiken är öppen.
english: We don't know if the store is open.

target: Det beror på om vädret tillåter verkligen.
english: It depends on whether the weather permits really.

target: Jag hörde att du har fått nytt jobb.
english: I heard that you got a new job.

target: Hon märkte att han var ledsen nog.
english: She noticed that he was sad probably.

target: Vi förstod att det var svårt till slut.
english: We understood that it was difficult in the end.

target: Han insåg att han hade fel redan.
english: He realized that he was wrong already.

target: Jag önskar att jag kunde stanna längre.
english: I wish I could stay longer.

target: Problemet är att vi inte har tid.
english: The problem is that we don't have time.

target: Anledningen är att tåget var försenat nog.
english: The reason is that the train was delayed probably.

target: Det verkar som att det blir regn.
english: It seems like it will rain.

target: Jag är glad att du mår bra.
english: I'm glad that you feel well.

target: Vi är oroliga att det inte räcker.
english: We're worried that it won't be enough.

target: Hon är säker på att hon har rätt.
english: She is sure that she is right.

target: Det är synd att du inte kan komma.
english: It's a pity that you can't come.

target: Det är bra att du berättade redan.
english: It's good that you told already.

target: Det är viktigt att vi är i tid.
english: It's important that we are on time.

target: Det är möjligt att han har glömt.
english: It's possible that he has forgotten.

target: Det händer att bussen är sen nog.
english: It happens that the bus is late probably.

target: Jag minns att vi hade roligt redan.
english: I remember that we had fun already.

target: Vi lovar att vi ska hjälpa också.
english: We promise that we will help too.

target: Han bestämde att han skulle sluta till slut.
english: He decided that he would quit in the end.

target: Jag hoppas att vi ses igen nästa år.
english: I hope that we see each other again next year.

target: När jag vaknade var det redan ljust.
english: When I woke up it was already light.

target: Medan han jobbade lagade hon mat på kvällen.
english: While he worked she cooked in the evening.

target: Eftersom det var sent gick vi hem.
english: Since it was late we went home.
grammar: "Eftersom" = since/because. Formal reason clause.

target: Trots att vi var trötta fortsatte vi.
english: Although we were tired we continued.

target: Fastän det var dyrt köpte vi det.
english: Even though it was expensive we bought it.
grammar: "Fastän" = even though/although. Synonym with "trots att."

target: Vi stannade tills det slutade regna förra året.
english: We stayed until it stopped raining last year.

target: Så länge det är ljust kan vi stanna.
english: As long as it's light we can stay.

target: Ända sedan jag kom hit har jag trivts.
english: Ever since I came here I've enjoyed it.

target: Det var trevligt medan det varade egentligen.
english: It was nice while it lasted actually.

target: Nu när du är här kan vi börja.
english: Now that you're here we can start.

target: Jag berättade för honom att vi inte kunde.
english: I told him that we couldn't.

target: Hon lovade att hon inte skulle berätta.
english: She promised that she wouldn't tell.

target: Vi insisterade på att han inte behövde.
english: We insisted that he didn't need to.

target: Han medgav att han inte hade rätt.
english: He admitted that he wasn't right.

target: Jag föreslog att vi inte skulle vänta.
english: I suggested that we shouldn't wait.

target: Det visar sig att de inte visste.
english: It turns out that they didn't know.

target: Man aldrig vet om det kan hända.
english: You never know if it can happen.

target: Jag undrar när hon kommer tillbaka väl.
english: I wonder when she'll come back I suppose.

target: Vi diskuterade vad vi borde göra just nu.
english: We discussed what we should do right now.

target: Hon berättade var hon hade bott redan.
english: She told where she had lived already.

target: Jag förstår varför du är upprörd nog.
english: I understand why you're upset probably.

target: Vi vet inte hur lång tid det tar.
english: We don't know how long it takes.

target: Han undrade vem som hade ringt redan.
english: He wondered who had called already.

target: Jag frågade vilken väg vi skulle ta.
english: I asked which way we should take.

target: Vi fick reda på att skolan var stängd.
english: We found out that the school was closed.

target: Det framgick att ingen visste sedan länge.
english: It became clear that nobody knew for a long time.

target: Jag är medveten om att det tar tid.
english: I'm aware that it takes time.

target: Vi utgår från att allt går som planerat.
english: We assume that everything goes as planned.

target: Det förutsätter att alla samarbetar efter jobbet.
english: It requires that everyone cooperates after work.

target: Jag tvivlar på att det fungerar på kvällen.
english: I doubt that it works in the evening.

target: Vi räknar med att vara framme klockan fem.
english: We expect to arrive at five o'clock.

target: Det innebär att vi måste ändra planen.
english: It means that we have to change the plan.

target: Hon påpekade att vi hade glömt det.
english: She pointed out that we had forgotten it.

target: Vi antog att det var korrekt redan.
english: We assumed that it was correct already.

target: Det framkom att de inte hade informerats.
english: It emerged that they had not been informed.

target: Kom hit, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Come here, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: Imperative = verb stem. Group 1: drop -a (prata → prat!). Group 2/3: use stem (kom!).

target: Titta, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Look, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: Single-word imperatives are very common: "Titta! Lyssna! Vänta! Kom!"

target: Vänta lite, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Wait a moment, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Lite" softens the command: "vänta lite" = wait a moment (not as urgent as just "vänta!").

target: Sitt ner, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Sit down, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: "Sitta" → imperative "sitt." Irregular strong verb. "Ner" = down.

target: Stå upp, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Stand up, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Stå" → imperative "stå." "Upp" = up. "Stå upp" = stand up / get up.

target: Öppna dörren, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Open the door, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: Group 1 imperatives keep the -a: öppna! stänga! → stäng! (Group 2, drop -a).

target: Stäng fönstret, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Close the window, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Stänga" → imperative "stäng." Group 2 verbs drop -a in imperative.

target: Var tyst, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Be quiet, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Vara" imperative is "var" — irregular. "Var tyst!" "Var snäll!"

target: Lyssna på mig under veckan gärna!
english: Listen to me during the week gladly!
grammar: "Lyssna" → imperative "lyssna" (Group 1 keeps -a). "Lyssna på" = listen to.

target: Läs den här boken ibland väl!
english: Read this book sometimes I suppose!

target: Skriv ner det på kvällen för alla!
english: Write it down in the evening for everyone!

target: Ät upp maten nästa vecka till slut!
english: Eat up the food next week in the end!
grammar: "Äta" imperative is "ät" — the bare stem. "Upp" adds completion.

target: Drick ditt vatten förra veckan alltid!
english: Drink your water last week always!

target: Spring inte, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Don't run, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: Negative imperative: verb + inte. "Spring inte!" "Gå inte!"

target: Gå inte dit i helgen förra året!
english: Don't go there on the weekend last year!

target: Sluta prata, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Stop talking, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Var snäll och hjälp mig under veckan.
english: Please help me during the week.
grammar: "Var snäll och" + imperative is a polite way to make a request.

target: Var försiktig, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Be careful, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: "Vara" imperative = "var." Irregular. "Försiktig" = careful.

target: Skynda dig och kom hit innan bussen går utan oss!
english: Hurry up and come here before the bus leaves without us!

target: Ta det lugnt under veckan alltid!
english: Take it easy during the week always!
grammar: "Ta det lugnt" = take it easy. "Lugnt" (neuter) for the impersonal "det."

target: Ge mig nyckeln sedan länge alltid!
english: Give me the key for a long time always!
grammar: "Ge" imperative is just "ge" — already the stem form.

target: Visa mig vägen under veckan gärna!
english: Show me the way during the week gladly!

target: Berätta vad som hände på kvällen förra året!
english: Tell me what happened in the evening last year!

target: Glöm inte passet under veckan väl!
english: Don't forget the passport during the week I suppose!

target: Ring mig imorgon på kvällen för alla!
english: Call me tomorrow in the evening for everyone!

target: Tvätta händerna, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Wash your hands, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: Group 1 imperative: keep -a. "Tvätta!" "Lyssna!" "Titta!"

target: Borsta tänderna, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Brush your teeth, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: "Tänderna" = the teeth. "Tand" → "tänder" (plural) → "tänderna" (def. plural).

target: Klä på dig på kvällen ute!
english: Get dressed in the evening outside!

target: Lägg dig, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Go to bed, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Vakna, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Wake up, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Vakna" imperative keeps the -a: Vakna! But "kom" (Group 4) is just the stem.

target: Ät frukost, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Eat breakfast, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Packa väskan, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Pack your bag, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: Group 1 imperative: keep the -a. "Packa! Stanna! Öppna!"

target: Häng upp jackan hela tiden väl!
english: Hang up the jacket all the time I suppose!

target: Stäng av TVn hela tiden på jobbet!
english: Turn off the TV all the time at work!
grammar: Particle verbs in imperative: verb + particle. "Stäng av!" "Slå på!"

target: Sätt på musiken på morgonen efter jobbet!
english: Turn on the music in the morning after work!

target: Ta av skorna på morgonen snart!
english: Take off the shoes in the morning soon!
grammar: Taking shoes off indoors is an unspoken rule in Swedish homes.

target: Städa ditt rum under veckan väl!
english: Clean your room during the week I suppose!

target: Bädda sängen, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Make the bed, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Diska tallrikarna, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Wash the plates, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Plocka upp efter dig på morgonen nu!
english: Pick up after yourself in the morning now!

target: Kasta inte skräp på morgonen hemma!
english: Don't litter in the morning at home!

target: Sortera soporna, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Sort the garbage, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Hjälp till, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Help out, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Svara på frågan förra veckan alltid!
english: Answer the question last week always!

target: Fråga om du inte förstår efter jobbet!
english: Ask if you don't understand after work!

target: Försök igen, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Try again, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Försöka" imperative: "Försök!" Group 2 drops the -a.

target: Ge inte upp på morgonen nu!
english: Don't give up in the morning now!

target: Tänk efter, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Think it over, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Bestäm dig, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Make up your mind, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Lugna ner dig sedan länge egentligen!
english: Calm down for a long time actually!

target: Slappna av, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Relax, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Njut av resan efter jobbet just nu!
english: Enjoy the trip after work right now!
grammar: "Njuta av" = enjoy. Imperative of Group 4: just the stem "njut."

target: Ha kul, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Have fun, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!
grammar: "Ha" imperative is "ha" — already short. "Ha det bra!" "Ha kul!"

target: Ta hand om dig hemma hos oss varje morgon!
english: Take care of yourself at our home every morning!

target: Kolla in det här under sommaren väl!
english: Check this out during the summer I suppose!

target: Prova den här rätten på morgonen väl!
english: Try this dish in the morning I suppose!

target: Smaka på det förra veckan gärna!
english: Taste it last week gladly!

target: Köp biljetter i förväg ibland väl!
english: Buy tickets in advance sometimes I suppose!

target: Boka tidigt, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Book early, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Res dit på sommaren sedan länge hemma!
english: Travel there in the summer for a long time at home!

target: Besök Gamla Stan på morgonen snart!
english: Visit the Old Town in the morning soon!

target: Gå till Skansen sedan länge idag!
english: Go to Skansen for a long time today!
grammar: Skansen is the world's first open-air museum, located in Stockholm.

target: Promenera längs Strandvägen på stationen varje morgon!
english: Walk along Strandvägen at the station every morning!

target: Åk till Dalarna varje dag egentligen!
english: Go to Dalarna every day actually!

target: Se norrskenet, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: See the northern lights, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Plocka blåbär, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Pick blueberries, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Fira midsommar, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Celebrate midsummer, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Bada i sjön i helgen efter jobbet!
english: Swim in the lake on the weekend after work!

target: Testa den svenska maten förra veckan väl!
english: Try the Swedish food last week I suppose!

target: Säg det på svenska under sommaren också!
english: Say it in Swedish during the summer too!

target: Repetera alla nya ord varje dag för att lära dig.
english: Repeat all new words every day in order to learn.

target: Övning ger färdighet på kvällen nog!
english: Practice makes perfect in the evening probably!

target: Läs högt, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Read aloud, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Lär dig nya ord hemma hos oss varje morgon!
english: Learn new words at our home every morning!

target: Börja om, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Start over, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Fortsätt, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Continue, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Håll dig lugn under sommaren på helgerna!
english: Keep calm during the summer on weekends!

target: Var dig själv på kvällen egentligen!
english: Be yourself in the evening actually!

target: Tro på dig själv ibland i Sverige!
english: Believe in yourself sometimes in Sweden!

target: Le, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Smile, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Andas djupt, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Breathe deeply, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Ställ väskan där väldigt ofta nu!
english: Put the bag there very often now!

target: Flytta stolen, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Move the chair, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Tänd ljusen, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Light the candles, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!
grammar: Candles are central to Swedish hygge/mys — Swedes light more candles per capita than anyone.

target: Släck lampan, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Turn off the lamp, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Lås dörren, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Lock the door, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Kör sakta, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Drive slowly, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Stanna här, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Stop here, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Parkera där borta på morgonen också!
english: Park over there in the morning too!

target: Sväng här, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Turn here, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Gå rakt fram i helgen efter jobbet!
english: Go straight ahead on the weekend after work!

target: Akta dig för is sedan länge just nu!
english: Watch out for ice for a long time right now!

target: Håll i dig väldigt ofta i Sverige!
english: Hold on very often in Sweden!

target: Kliv på, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Get on, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Kliv av här sedan länge väl!
english: Get off here for a long time I suppose!

target: Sätt dig ner på morgonen ofta!
english: Sit down in the morning often!
grammar: Reflexive imperatives: sätt dig (sit down), skynda dig (hurry up). "Dig" for 'yourself.'

target: Res dig upp på kvällen med familjen!
english: Stand up in the evening with the family!

target: Rör dig inte förra veckan alltid!
english: Don't move last week always!

target: Var så god, sitt i trädgården varje morgon!
english: Please, sit in the garden every morning!

target: Välj en plats väldigt ofta hemma!
english: Choose a seat very often at home!

target: Beställ vad du vill nästa vecka nu!
english: Order whatever you want next week now!

target: Ät så mycket du vill varje dag!
english: Eat as much as you want every day!

target: Njut, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Enjoy, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Ta för dig varje dag redan!
english: Help yourself every day already!
grammar: "Ta för sig" = help yourself to food. Common at Swedish gatherings.

target: Fyll på glaset just nu nog!
english: Refill the glass right now probably!

target: Skicka smöret, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Pass the butter, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Kom igen, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Come on, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Håll ut, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Hang in there, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Våga, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Dare, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Satsa, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Go for it, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Gör ditt bästa under sommaren på kontoret!
english: Do your best during the summer at the office!

target: Var modig, innan det blir för sent att ändra sig!!
english: Be brave, before it becomes too late to change your mind!!

target: Se framåt, så att vi hinner med tåget till Stockholm!!
english: Look forward, so that we make it to the train to Stockholm!!

target: Den stora bilen är min under sommaren.
english: The big car is mine during the summer.
grammar: Double definite: adjective + definite article (den/det/de) AND definite suffix (-en/-et/-na).

target: Det lilla barnet sover nästa vecka på helgerna.
english: The small child is sleeping next week on weekends.
grammar: "Liten" in definite → "lilla": "det lilla barnet," "den lilla katten."

target: De nya böckerna är bra sedan länge.
english: The new books are good for a long time.
grammar: "Bok" → "böcker" (irregular plural) → "böckerna" (def. plural). "Nya" — all adjectives end -a in definite.

target: Den röda stugan ligger vid sjön varje vecka.
english: The red cottage is by the lake every week.
grammar: Röda stugor (red cottages) are the most iconic image of the Swedish countryside.

target: Det gamla slottet är vackert under veckan.
english: The old castle is beautiful during the week.
grammar: Double definite: det + gamla + slottet. Three markers of definiteness simultaneously!

target: Bilen är röd i helgen väl.
english: The car is red on the weekend I suppose.
grammar: Simple definite: just the suffix. "Bil" → "bilen." No adjective = no double definite needed.

target: Huset är stort som vi såg i den gamla butiken igår.
english: The house is big that we saw in the old shop yesterday.
grammar: Simple definite: "Huset" = the house. Suffix -et for ett-words.

target: Böckerna ligger på bordet på kvällen nog.
english: The books are on the table in the evening probably.
grammar: Definite plural: -na/-erna. "Böcker" → "böckerna."

target: Den svarta katten sitter i fönstret på jobbet.
english: The black cat sits in the window at work.
grammar: Double definite with en-word: den + svarta + katten. Adjective always ends in -a in definite.

target: Det vita huset är till salu redan.
english: The white house is for sale already.
grammar: "Till salu" = for sale. "Vit" → "vita" in definite: den vita, det vita, de vita.

target: De vackra blommorna doftar gott efter jobbet.
english: The beautiful flowers smell nice after work.
grammar: "Dofta" = smell (emit scent). "Gott" (neuter) here because it's an adverb, not adjective.

target: Den fina restaurangen är fullbokad väldigt ofta.
english: The nice restaurant is fully booked very often.
grammar: "Fullbokad" = fully booked. Compound: full + bokad. Very common in Swedish.

target: Det kalla vattnet är uppfriskande efter jobbet.
english: The cold water is refreshing after work.
grammar: "Vatten" is ett-word: vattnet (def.). Double definite: det + kalla + vattnet.

target: De svenska somrarna är korta nästa vecka.
english: The Swedish summers are short next week.
grammar: "Kort" → "korta" in plural/definite. "Svensk" → "svenska" — same pattern for all adjectives.

target: Den höga byggnaden är ett hotell väl.
english: The tall building is a hotel I suppose.

target: Det varma kaffet smakar gott varje dag.
english: The hot coffee tastes good every day.

target: De gröna träden växer snabbt nästa vecka.
english: The green trees grow fast next week.

target: Den gamla kyrkan är från tolvhundratalet väl.
english: The old church is from the twelfth century I suppose.

target: Det mörka molnet ser hotfullt ut för alla.
english: The dark cloud looks threatening for everyone.

target: De långa nätterna är typiska för vintern.
english: The long nights are typical for winter.

target: Mannen i hörnet läser en bok hemma.
english: The man in the corner reads a book at home.
grammar: When there's no adjective, no double definite: just "mannen," not "den mannen."

target: Flickan med det röda håret i helgen.
english: The girl with the red hair on the weekend.
grammar: "Hår" is ett-word: "det röda håret" — double definite with adjective.

target: Pojken som springer sedan länge varje vecka.
english: The boy who runs for a long time every week.

target: Solen skiner tillsammans på morgonen ute.
english: The sun is shining together in the morning outside.
grammar: Simple definite (no adjective) = just the suffix: "sol" → "solen."

target: Vinden blåser tillsammans till slut ute.
english: The wind is blowing together in the end outside.

target: Skogen är tyst i helgen redan.
english: The forest is quiet on the weekend already.

target: Sjön glittrar i solen på morgonen dit.
english: The lake glitters in the sun in the morning there.
grammar: Both "sjön" and "solen" are simple definite — no double definite needed.

target: Berget syns långt borta i helgen med familjen.
english: The mountain is visible far away on the weekend with the family.

target: Stranden är tom under veckan redan.
english: The beach is empty during the week already.

target: Himlen är blå sedan länge nog.
english: The sky is blue for a long time probably.
grammar: "Himmel" → "himlen" in definite. The -el drops the e.

target: Boken jag läser är spännande förra veckan.
english: The book I'm reading is exciting last week.
grammar: When a relative clause follows, no double definite: "boken jag läser."

target: Filmen vi såg var bra nästa vecka.
english: The movie we saw was good next week.

target: Maten som serveras är god sedan länge.
english: The food that is served is good for a long time.

target: Musiken som spelas är klassisk väldigt ofta.
english: The music being played is classical very often.

target: Människorna på torget firar i helgen med familjen.
english: The people at the square celebrate on the weekend with the family.

target: Den nya läraren är snäll sedan länge.
english: The new teacher is kind for a long time.

target: Det gamla biblioteket stängs under veckan också.
english: The old library is closing during the week too.

target: De blåa stolarna är bekväma förra veckan.
english: The blue chairs are comfortable last week.

target: Den gula bussen kör till centrum dit.
english: The yellow bus goes to the center there.

target: Det färska brödet luktar gott på kvällen.
english: The fresh bread smells good in the evening.

target: De varma bullarna är nylagade efter jobbet.
english: The warm buns are freshly made after work.

target: Den vita snön täcker marken just nu.
english: The white snow covers the ground right now.

target: Det klara vattnet är rent sedan länge.
english: The clear water is clean for a long time.

target: De höga bergen är imponerande ibland redan.
english: The high mountains are impressive sometimes already.

target: Den starka vinden blåser hela tiden gärna.
english: The strong wind blows all the time gladly.

target: Det djupa havet är kallt hela tiden.
english: The deep sea is cold all the time.

target: De smala gatorna i Gamla Stan ofta.
english: The narrow streets in the Old Town often.

target: Den långa vägen hem ibland väl.
english: The long way home sometimes I suppose.

target: Det stora fönstret ger mycket ljus ute.
english: The big window gives a lot of light outside.

target: De moderna byggnaderna i Hammarby Sjöstad alltid.
english: The modern buildings in Hammarby Sjöstad always.

target: Den populära restaurangen på hörnet sedan länge.
english: The popular restaurant on the corner for a long time.

target: Det kända museet mitt i stan verkligen.
english: The famous museum in the middle of town really.

target: De vänliga grannarna hjälpte oss hela tiden.
english: The friendly neighbors helped us all the time.

target: Den duktige läraren förklarar bra sedan länge.
english: The skilled teacher explains well for a long time.
grammar: In definite singular with adjective, -e ending is used for male persons: "den duktige läraren."

target: Den duktiga läkaren räddar liv på kvällen.
english: The skilled doctor saves lives in the evening.
grammar: Female/non-gendered definite adjective uses -a: "den duktiga läkaren."

target: Det tysta rummet är perfekt på kvällen.
english: The quiet room is perfect in the evening.

target: De glada barnen leker förra veckan också.
english: The happy children play last week too.

target: Den sista bussen har gått varje dag.
english: The last bus has left every day.

target: Det första steget är viktigt hela tiden.
english: The first step is important all the time.

target: De andra länderna i Norden på kvällen.
english: The other countries in the Nordics in the evening.

target: Dagen var lång på morgonen redan.
english: The day was long in the morning already.

target: Natten är kort på sommaren i helgen.
english: The night is short in summer on the weekend.

target: Veckan gick snabbt efter jobbet alltid.
english: The week went fast after work always.

target: Månaden är snart slut under veckan också.
english: The month is almost over during the week too.

target: Året har gått fort hela tiden nog.
english: The year has gone fast all the time probably.

target: Vintern är snart här på morgonen nog.
english: Winter is almost here in the morning probably.

target: Våren kommer sent i norr hela tiden.
english: Spring comes late in the north all the time.

target: Sommaren är bäst i Dalarna väldigt ofta.
english: Summer is best in Dalarna very often.

target: Hösten är färgrik på kvällen nog.
english: Autumn is colorful in the evening probably.

target: Den svenska flaggan är blå och gul.
english: The Swedish flag is blue and yellow.

target: Det svenska systemet är välkänt förra veckan.
english: The Swedish system is well known last week.

target: De svenska skolorna är gratis ibland väl.
english: Swedish schools are free sometimes I suppose.
grammar: Swedish education is free from preschool through university.

target: Den svenska naturen är unik på kvällen.
english: Swedish nature is unique in the evening.

target: Det svenska samhället är jämlikt varje dag.
english: Swedish society is egalitarian every day.

target: Den berömda Nobelfesten på kontoret varje morgon.
english: The famous Nobel banquet at the office every morning.

target: Det mytomspunna norrskenet nästa vecka efter jobbet.
english: The legendary northern lights next week after work.

target: Den traditionella julbordet nästa vecka väl.
english: The traditional Christmas table next week I suppose.

target: Det snöiga landskapet varje dag idag.
english: The snowy landscape every day today.

target: De historiska runstenar hela tiden idag.
english: The historical rune stones all the time today.

target: Den livliga staden aldrig sover under sommaren.
english: The lively city never sleeps during the summer.

target: Det lugna livet på landet varje morgon.
english: The calm life in the countryside every morning.

target: De pittoreska byarna i Skåne på kvällen.
english: The picturesque villages in Skåne in the evening.

target: Den rika kulturen imponerar varje dag egentligen.
english: The rich culture impresses every day actually.

target: Det goda kaffet på kvällen i trädgården.
english: The good coffee in the evening in the garden.
grammar: Sweden is one of the top coffee-consuming nations in the world.

target: De långa sommarkvällarna i helgen redan.
english: The long summer evenings on the weekend already.

target: Den korta vintersolen under veckan också.
english: The short winter sun during the week too.

target: Det stora intresset för friluftsliv just nu.
english: The great interest in outdoor life right now.

target: De viktiga traditionerna bevaras i helgen egentligen.
english: The important traditions are preserved on the weekend actually.

target: Den gemytliga stämningen väldigt ofta till slut.
english: The cozy atmosphere very often in the end.

target: Det öppna landskapet i söder på kvällen.
english: The open landscape in the south in the evening.

target: De djupa skogarna i Norrland varje morgon.
english: The deep forests in Norrland every morning.

target: Den stilla sjön vid stugan i helgen.
english: The still lake by the cabin on the weekend.

target: Det klara nordliga ljuset på kvällen varje vecka.
english: The clear northern light in the evening every week.

target: De mäktiga fjällen i väst ibland förra året.
english: The mighty mountains in the west sometimes last year.

target: Den långa kusten sträcker sig hela tiden.
english: The long coast extends all the time.

target: Det rika djurlivet fascinerar under veckan väl.
english: The rich wildlife fascinates during the week I suppose.

target: De tusentals öarna i skärgården på morgonen.
english: The thousands of islands in the archipelago in the morning.

target: Den svenska allemansrätten är unik förra veckan.
english: The Swedish right to roam is unique last week.
grammar: Allemansrätten allows everyone to walk, camp, and pick berries on any land.

target: Det traditionella fikat klockan tre i helgen.
english: The traditional fika at three o'clock on the weekend.

target: De stora företagen som Volvo och IKEA.
english: The big companies like Volvo and IKEA.

target: Den långa midsommarstången efter jobbet gärna.
english: The tall midsummer pole after work gladly.

target: Det glada midsommarfirandet på kvällen dit.
english: The joyful midsummer celebration in the evening there.

target: De traditionella snapsvisorna väldigt ofta på kvällen.
english: The traditional drinking songs very often in the evening.

target: Den svenska rågbrödet på morgonen nästa år.
english: The Swedish rye bread in the morning next year.

target: Det berömda smörgåsbordet i helgen väl.
english: The famous smorgasbord on the weekend I suppose.
grammar: "Smörgåsbord" is one of few Swedish words used in English.

target: Mannen som bor här är min granne.
english: The man who lives here is my neighbor.
grammar: "Som" is the all-purpose relative pronoun — it replaces who, which, that.

target: Boken som jag läser är spännande redan.
english: The book that I'm reading is exciting already.
grammar: "Som" can be omitted when it's the object: "Boken jag läser" is also correct.

target: Huset som ligger vid sjön är gammalt.
english: The house that is by the lake is old.
grammar: "Som" as subject cannot be omitted: always keep it.

target: Flickan som sjunger har en fin röst.
english: The girl who sings has a beautiful voice.
grammar: "Som" is the universal relative pronoun in spoken Swedish — works for who, which, that.

target: Filmen som vi såg igår var bra.
english: The movie that we saw yesterday was good.
grammar: Past tense in relative clause: "som vi såg" (that we saw).

target: Katten som sitter i fönstret är min.
english: The cat that sits in the window is mine.
grammar: In relative clauses, "som" is always the subject or object. Never omit it like English 'that.'

target: Restaurangen som ligger på hörnet är ny.
english: The restaurant on the corner is new.
grammar: "Som ligger" = that is located. Very common pattern.

target: Människorna som bor här är vänliga redan.
english: The people who live here are friendly already.
grammar: "Människor" → "människorna" (the people). Double definite: article + noun suffix.

target: Tåget som avgår klockan nio är snabbt.
english: The train that departs at nine is fast.
grammar: Relative clauses go right after the noun they describe, just like in English.

target: Läraren som undervisar oss är duktig nog.
english: The teacher who teaches us is skilled probably.
grammar: "Duktig" means good/clever at something. Not to be confused with "snäll" (kind).

target: Barnet som leker i parken är glatt.
english: The child playing in the park is happy.
grammar: "Som" never changes form — same for subjects, objects, en/ett/plural. Universal relative pronoun.

target: Vägen som leder till sjön är lång.
english: The road that leads to the lake is long.
grammar: "Leda" = lead. "Sjön" = the lake (en sjö). In relative clauses, verb order stays normal.

target: Staden som vi besökte var vacker egentligen.
english: The city that we visited was beautiful actually.
grammar: "Som" as object — in formal Swedish you can use "vilken/vilket/vilka" instead, but "som" is standard.

target: Musiken som spelas är fin varje dag.
english: The music being played is nice every day.
grammar: "Som spelas" = that is being played. S-passive in relative clause — very natural in Swedish.

target: Kaffet som serveras här är gott redan.
english: The coffee served here is good already.
grammar: "Serveras" = is served (s-passive). "Gott" = good/tasty (neuter, matching "kaffet").

target: Kvinnan som jobbar på banken är trevlig.
english: The woman who works at the bank is nice.
grammar: After "som" as subject, the verb agrees with the antecedent: "kvinnan som jobbar" (she works).

target: Blomman som växer där är sällsynt nog.
english: The flower that grows there is rare probably.
grammar: "Sällsynt" = rare. "Växa" = grow (intransitive). Group 2: växer, växte, växt.

target: Hunden som springer i parken tillhör oss.
english: The dog running in the park belongs to us.
grammar: "Tillhöra" = belong to. Formal. Everyday: "är vår" (is ours).

target: Det som gör Sverige unikt förra veckan.

target: Känslan som man inte kan beskriva gärna.
english: The feeling that you can't describe gladly.

target: Ögonblicket som aldrig glöms varje dag redan.
english: The moment that is never forgotten every day already.

target: Minnet som stannar kvar varje dag egentligen.
english: The memory that remains every day actually.

target: Drömmen som blev verklighet varje dag egentligen.

target: Beslutet som formade framtiden på kvällen på helgerna.
english: The decision that shaped the future in the evening on weekends.

target: Resan som vi minns för alltid efter jobbet.
english: The trip we remember forever after work.

target: Platsen som vi kallar hem varje morgon.
english: The place we call home every morning.

target: Upplevelsen som lärde mig mest varje morgon.
english: The experience that taught me the most every morning.

target: Orden som aldrig sagts på kvällen ute.
english: The words that were never said in the evening outside.

target: Boken som ändrade mitt liv sedan länge.
english: The book that changed my life for a long time.

target: Dörren öppnas klockan åtta väldigt ofta också.
english: The door is opened at eight very often too.
grammar: S-passive: add -s to the verb. "Öppna" → "öppnas." Used for general/habitual actions.

target: Maten lagas av kocken varje dag redan.
english: The food is cooked by the chef every day already.
grammar: S-passive is more common than bli-passive for habitual/general statements.

target: Boken skrevs av Astrid Lindgren under veckan.
english: The book was written by Astrid Lindgren during the week.
grammar: Past s-passive: "skriva" → "skrevs." The agent uses "av" (by).

target: Huset byggdes 1950 förra veckan gärna.
english: The house was built in 1950 last week gladly.
grammar: Past s-passive: "byggdes." Used for historical facts and completed events.

target: Dörren blev öppnad av vinden i helgen.
english: The door was opened by the wind on the weekend.
grammar: Bli-passive: "bli" + past participle. Emphasizes a single event or change of state.

target: Bilen har blivit stulen hela tiden nog.
english: The car has been stolen all the time probably.
grammar: "Bli-passive" (bli + past participle) emphasizes the process/event of something happening.

target: Barnen väcks klockan sju sedan länge alltid.
english: The children are woken at seven for a long time always.
grammar: S-passive present: verb stem + -s. "Väcka" → "väcks."

target: Fönstret stängdes av städaren under veckan gärna.
english: The window was closed by the cleaner during the week gladly.
grammar: "Av" introduces the agent in passive: stängdes av = was closed by. Often omitted.

target: Maten serveras klockan sex under sommaren väl.
english: Food is served at six during the summer I suppose.
grammar: S-passive (serveras) for habitual/general actions. Bli-passive for specific events.

target: Brevet skickades igår under sommaren väl.
english: The letter was sent yesterday during the summer I suppose.
grammar: Past s-passive: skicka → skickades. Add -s to past tense: skickade + s.

target: Biljetter kan köpas online under sommaren alltid.
english: Tickets can be bought online during the summer always.
grammar: Modal + s-passive infinitive: "kan köpas," "måste göras," "bör läsas."

target: Problemet löstes snabbt just nu under sommaren.
english: The problem was solved quickly right now during summer.
grammar: "Lösa" → "löstes" (was solved). S-passive past of Group 2 verbs: -te → -tes.

target: Nyheten rapporterades i tidningen på kvällen hemma.
english: The news was reported in the newspaper in the evening at home.
grammar: "Rapporteras" (present), "rapporterades" (past). S-passive is very common in Swedish news.

target: Lagen antogs av riksdagen i helgen under sommaren.
english: The law was passed by parliament on the weekend during summer.
grammar: "Riksdagen" = the Swedish parliament. "Antog" → "antogs" — just add -s for s-passive past.

target: Tåget blev försenat väldigt ofta gärna.
english: The train got delayed very often gladly.
grammar: "Bli-passive" + past participle emphasizes the event/change: "blev försenat" = got delayed.

target: Boken har översatts till tjugo språk nog.
english: The book has been translated into twenty languages probably.
grammar: "Har översatts" = has been translated. Perfect s-passive: har + supine + s.

target: Huset ska säljas under sommaren nästa år.
english: The house is going to be sold during the summer next year.
grammar: "Ska säljas" = will be sold. Modal + infinitive s-passive. Very common in real estate.

target: Gatan repareras just nu nästa vecka väl.
english: The street is being repaired right now next week I suppose.
grammar: "Just nu" = right now. S-passive for ongoing actions: "repareras" = is being repaired.

target: Filmen visades på bio på morgonen verkligen.
english: The movie was shown in the cinema in the morning really.
grammar: "Visas" (present) → "visades" (past). "På bio" = at the cinema (no article needed).

target: Kläderna tvättades igår på morgonen dit.
english: The clothes were washed yesterday in the morning there.
grammar: "Tvätta" → "tvättades" (past s-passive). Group 1 verbs: -ades ending in past passive.

target: Resultatet publicerades i morse i helgen här.
english: The result was published this morning on the weekend here.
grammar: "Publicera" → "publicerades" (past s-passive). "I morse" = this morning.

target: Mötet ställdes in väldigt ofta idag.
english: The meeting was cancelled very often today.
grammar: "Ställa in" = cancel. S-passive past: "ställdes in." The particle stays.

target: Museet besöks av tusentals turister väldigt ofta.
english: The museum is visited by thousands of tourists very often.
grammar: "Tusentals" = thousands of. "Besöks av" = is visited by. S-passive present.

target: Bilen reparerades av mekanikern väldigt ofta gärna.
english: The car was repaired by the mechanic very often gladly.
grammar: "Reparera" → "reparerades." "-ades" is Group 1 past s-passive ending.

target: Maten tillagas med lokala råvaror under sommaren.
english: The food is prepared with local ingredients during the summer.

target: Boken trycktes i tusen exemplar efter jobbet.
english: The book was printed in a thousand copies after work.

target: Priset bestämdes av styrelsen i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: The price was decided by the board in the library every morning.

target: Skolan grundades 1880 under veckan alltid.

target: Kyrkan restaurerades förra året ibland väl.

english: The City Hall was inaugurated in 1923 in the morning every week.

english: The Nobel Prize is awarded in December in the morning.
grammar: The Nobel Prize ceremony takes place at Stockholm Concert Hall on December 10th.

english: The party was cancelled because of rain.

grammar: In Sweden, presents are opened on Christmas Eve (the 24th), not Christmas Day.
