english: The place has not been decided yet last week.

target: Boken har blivit belönad under veckan nog.
english: The book has been awarded during the week probably.

target: Vi hoppas på bra väder ibland verkligen.
english: We hope for good weather sometimes really.
grammar: Deponent verbs end in -s but are not passive. "Hoppas" = hope, "minnas" = remember.

target: Jag minns sommaren i Dalarna sedan länge.
english: I remember the summer in Dalarna for a long time.
grammar: "Minnas" is deponent — active meaning (remember) but -s form.

target: Vi trivs bra här förra veckan också.
english: We are happy here last week too.
grammar: "Trivas" = to thrive/enjoy being somewhere. No non-s form exists.

target: De andas tungt efter löpningen ibland till slut.
english: They breathe heavily after the run sometimes in the end.
grammar: "Andas" is deponent — always has -s but is active in meaning (to breathe).

target: Jag syns inte i mörkret nästa vecka.
english: I'm not visible in the dark next week.
grammar: "Synas" = to be visible/appear. Deponent.

target: Vi lyckas alltid i slutändan varje morgon.
english: We always succeed in the end every morning.
grammar: "Lyckas" (succeed) is deponent. "I slutändan" = in the end.

target: Han misslyckas med provet efter jobbet väl.
english: He fails the test after work I suppose.
grammar: "Misslyckas" (fail) — prefix miss- + lyckas. Many Swedish verbs build meaning with prefixes.

target: Jag undviks av honom hela tiden under sommaren.
english: I am avoided by him all the time during summer.

target: Vi umgås varje helg just nu egentligen.
english: We socialize every weekend right now actually.
grammar: "Umgås" = spend time together. Very important concept in Swedish social life.

target: De följs åt till jobbet hela tiden.
english: They walk together to work all the time.
grammar: "Följas åt" = go together / accompany each other.

target: Vi möts vid stationen sedan länge under sommaren.
english: We'll meet at the station for a long time during summer.
grammar: "Mötas" = meet each other (reciprocal). "Möta" = meet someone.

target: Dörren öppnas automatiskt under sommaren varje vecka.
english: The door opens automatically during the summer every week.
grammar: Here "-s" makes it passive: 'the door is opened.' Context tells passive from deponent.

target: Barnen leks av andra barn under veckan.
english: The children are played with by other children during the week.

target: Vi enades om priset i helgen på kontoret.
english: We agreed on the price on the weekend at the office.
grammar: "Enas om" = agree on. Past: "enades." Reciprocal s-verb.

target: De slåss om sista platsen under veckan.
english: They fight for the last spot during the week.
grammar: "Slåss" = to fight. Deponent verb with active meaning.

target: Vi kramas vid avskedet på kvällen med vänner.
english: We hug at the farewell in the evening with friends.
grammar: "Kramas" = to hug each other. The reciprocal s-form.

target: De brottas på mattan varje dag redan.
english: They wrestle on the mat every day already.
grammar: "Brottas" = wrestle. Reciprocal — they wrestle each other.

target: Vi träffas imorgon på kvällen med vänner.
english: We'll meet tomorrow in the evening with friends.
grammar: "Träffas" = meet each other (by arrangement).

target: De hjälps åt med flytten på morgonen.
english: They help each other with the move in the morning.

target: Vi samsas om köket just nu med vänner.
english: We share the kitchen amicably right now with friends.

target: De turas om att laga mat i trädgården.
english: They take turns cooking in the garden.
grammar: "Turas om" = take turns. Deponent.

target: Vi skiljs åt vid korsningen ibland hemma.
english: We part ways at the intersection sometimes at home.

target: De närmas varandra nästa vecka nog.
english: They approach each other next week probably.

target: Vi samtals om framtiden under sommaren här.
english: We converse about the future during the summer here.

target: Jag svettas mycket varje dag redan.
english: I sweat a lot every day already.

target: Hon skäms för misstaget i helgen med vänner.
english: She is ashamed of the mistake on the weekend with friends.
grammar: "Skämmas" = to be ashamed. Deponent — no non-s form.

target: Vi vågas inte hoppa under sommaren för alla.
english: We don't dare to jump during the summer for everyone.

target: Han fattas mig just nu ibland.
english: I miss him right now sometimes.
grammar: "Fattas" = be missing/lack. Also impersonal: "Det fattas en sak" (one thing is missing).

target: Vi finns på Storgatan varje dag här.
english: We are located on Storgatan every day here.
grammar: "Finnas" = to exist / be located. "Det finns" = there is/are.

target: Det finns många sjöar i Sverige i Sverige.
english: There are many lakes in Sweden in Sweden.

target: Jag känns pigg idag förra veckan väl.
english: I feel perky today last week I suppose.

target: Det verkas som att det stämmer idag.
english: It seems like that's correct today.

target: Vi roas av underhållningen under veckan gärna.
english: We are amused by the entertainment during the week gladly.

target: Hon föds i Stockholm i helgen ofta.
english: She is born in Stockholm on the weekend often.
grammar: "Födas" = to be born. Technically passive but used as deponent.

target: Barnet döps i kyrkan under veckan väl.
english: The child is baptized in the church during the week I suppose.

target: Vi giftes i juni sedan länge på jobbet.
english: We got married in June for a long time at work.

target: De förlovas på nyårsafton sedan länge i trädgården.
english: They get engaged on New Year's Eve for a long time in the garden.

target: Vi skildes förra året på kvällen just nu.
english: We divorced last year in the evening right now.

target: De tävlas om första platsen hela tiden.
english: They compete for first place all the time.

target: Vi övades på musiken förra veckan också.
english: We practiced the music last week too.

target: Han förundras över naturen förra veckan också.
english: He marvels at nature last week too.

target: Vi gläds åt nyheten på kontoret varje morgon.
english: We rejoice at the news at the office every morning.

target: Jag längtas efter sommaren på kvällen för alla.
english: I long for summer in the evening for everyone.

target: Vi känns igen på morgonen varje dag.
english: We look familiar in the morning every day.

target: Hon liknas vid sin mamma i helgen.
english: She resembles her mother on the weekend.

target: De samsas alltid bra på kontoret varje morgon.
english: They always get along well at the office every morning.

target: Vi lyckas med uppgiften hela tiden nog.
english: We succeed with the task all the time probably.

target: Jag hoppas det löser sig nästa vecka.
english: I hope it works out next week.

target: Vi minns den kvällen väldigt ofta snart.
english: We remember that evening very often soon.

target: De trivs på jobbet på morgonen i skolan.
english: They enjoy their work in the morning at school.

target: Jag andas djupt förra veckan också.
english: I breathe deeply last week too.

target: Vi kämpar mot vinden sedan länge väl.
english: We struggle against the wind for a long time I suppose.

target: Hon drabbas av en förkylning just nu.
english: She is hit by a cold right now.

target: Vi inspireras av naturen under sommaren också.
english: We are inspired by nature during the summer too.

target: De fascineras av norrskenet i helgen sedan länge.
english: They are fascinated by the northern lights on the weekend for a long time.

target: Jag berörs av musiken på kvällen på kontoret.
english: I am touched by the music in the evening at the office.

target: Vi besväras av värmen under veckan gärna.
english: We are bothered by the heat during the week gladly.

target: Han förvirras av instruktionerna varje dag redan.
english: He is confused by the instructions every day already.

target: Vi motiveras av resultaten ibland just nu.
english: We are motivated by the results sometimes right now.

target: Jag intresseras av historia ibland idag.
english: I am interested in history sometimes today.

target: De imponeras av prestationen ibland nästa år.
english: They are impressed by the performance sometimes next year.

target: Vi förvånas av svaret sedan länge egentligen.
english: We are surprised by the answer for a long time actually.

target: Jag oroas av nyheterna hela tiden egentligen.
english: I am worried by the news all the time actually.

target: Vi glädjes åt framgången i köket varje morgon.
english: We rejoice at the success in the kitchen every morning.

target: Han skäms inte alls väldigt ofta varje vecka.
english: He is not ashamed at all very often every week.

target: Vi hoppas kunna hjälpa sedan länge nästa år.
english: We hope to be able to help for a long time next year.

target: Jag minns att vi träffades där väl.
english: I remember that we met there I suppose.

target: De trivdes bra i stugan i helgen.
english: They enjoyed themselves at the cabin on the weekend.

target: Vi lyckades äntligen just nu till slut.
english: We finally succeeded right now in the end.

target: Jag misslyckades med baket ibland till slut.
english: I failed at baking sometimes in the end.

target: Hon hoppades på sol under veckan alltid.
english: She hoped for sun during the week always.

target: Vi umgicks varje kväll i parken varje morgon.
english: We socialized every evening in the park every morning.

target: De träffades första gången i Lund nu.
english: They met for the first time in Lund now.

target: Vi kramades länge just nu dit.
english: We hugged for a long time right now there.

target: Jag andades ut av lättnad under veckan.
english: I breathed out with relief during the week.

target: De slogs som barn ibland idag.
english: They fought as children sometimes today.

target: Vi hjälptes åt att bära under hela den långa och spännande semesterresan.
english: We helped each other carry during the entire long and exciting vacation trip.

target: Jag mindes plötsligt på morgonen ute.
english: I suddenly remembered in the morning outside.

target: De enades till slut just nu på kontoret.
english: They finally agreed right now at the office.

target: Vi skiljdes som vänner hela tiden varje dag.
english: We parted as friends all the time every day.

target: Jag hoppas vi ses snart hela tiden.
english: I hope we see each other soon all the time.

target: De kände att de fattades något gärna.
english: They felt that something was missing gladly.

target: Vi trivdes jättebra på semestern under sommaren.
english: We really enjoyed ourselves on vacation during the summer.

target: Jag lyckas inte öppna dörren just nu.
english: I can't manage to open the door right now.

target: Hon minns inte var hon lade nycklarna.
english: She doesn't remember where she put the keys.

target: De umgås med grannar ofta under veckan.
english: They socialize with neighbors often during the week.

target: Vi möttes av en vacker soluppgång just nu.
english: We were met by a beautiful sunrise right now.

target: Jag hoppas innerligt sedan länge verkligen.
english: I sincerely hope for a long time really.

target: De kramas alltid när de ses väl.
english: They always hug when they see each other I suppose.

target: Vi svettas i bastun på stationen varje morgon.
english: We sweat in the sauna at the station every morning.

target: Han försöker att inte skämmas förra veckan.
english: He tries not to be ashamed last week.

target: Det finns hopp vid sjön varje morgon.
english: There is hope by the lake every morning.

target: Vi turas om att köra väldigt ofta.
english: We take turns driving very often.

target: De brottas med problemet nästa vecka till slut.
english: They grapple with the problem next week in the end.

target: Vi följdes åt nästa vecka ofta.
english: We walked together next week often.

target: Jag roas av hans berättelser på morgonen.
english: I'm amused by his stories in the morning.

target: Det visar sig vara sant efter jobbet.
english: It turns out to be true after work.

target: Vi hoppas alla på det bästa verkligen.
english: We all hope for the best really.

target: Jag ska åka till Norge imorgon nu.
english: I'm going to go to Norway tomorrow now.
grammar: "Ska" + infinitive expresses plans/intentions. The most common future form.

target: Det kommer att regna ikväll på kvällen.
english: It is going to rain tonight in the evening.
grammar: "Kommer att" + infinitive expresses predictions, especially weather and external events.

target: Vi skulle flytta om vi kunde hemma.
english: We would move if we could at home.
grammar: "Skulle" + infinitive = would. Used for hypotheticals and conditionals.

target: Hon ska börja ett nytt jobb idag.
english: She is going to start a new job today.
grammar: "Ska" + infinitive is the most common future in Swedish. More definite than "kommer att."

target: Det kommer att bli kallt i morgon.
english: It will be cold tomorrow.
grammar: "Kommer att" + infinitive = will. More neutral/predictive than "ska" (which implies intention).

target: Jag skulle vilja ha en kaffe nog.
english: I would like a coffee probably.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like. Very polite way to make requests.

target: Vi ska gifta oss i sommar nog.
english: We are getting married this summer probably.
grammar: "Ska" for planned future events. "I sommar" means this/next summer.

target: Det kommer att ta tre timmar nog.
english: It will take three hours probably.
grammar: "Ta" in time expressions: "Det tar 5 min" (it takes 5 min). Idiomatic and very common.

target: Han skulle aldrig göra det nästa vecka.
english: He would never do that next week.
grammar: "Skulle" = would. Also used for reported future: "Han sa att han skulle komma."

target: Jag ska ringa henne senare under sommaren.
english: I will call her later during the summer.
grammar: "Ska" for definite plans/intentions. More personal than "kommer att" which is prediction.

target: Vi kommer att behöva hjälp efter jobbet.
english: We will need help after work.
grammar: "Kommer att" for predictions/expectations. "Ska" would imply you've already arranged help.

target: Om jag vann på lotto skulle jag resa.
english: If I won the lottery I would travel.
grammar: Swedish conditional: "om" + past tense, "skulle" + infinitive. Same pattern as English.

target: De ska flytta till Malmö på morgonen.
english: They are going to move to Malmö in the morning.
grammar: "Ska" for future plans someone has decided on. "Malmö" is Sweden's third-largest city.

target: Det kommer att bli bättre varje dag.
english: It will get better every day.
grammar: "Kommer att bli" = will become/get. "Bli" is the go-to verb for changes of state.

target: Jag skulle kunna hjälpa dig förra veckan.
english: I could help you last week.
grammar: "Skulle kunna" = could (conditional). More polite than "kan."

target: Vi ska ha fest i helgen varje dag.
english: We're having a party this weekend every day.
grammar: "I helgen" = this weekend. "Ha fest" = have a party — no article before "fest."

target: Det kommer att vara fullt i helgen.
english: It will be full on the weekend.
grammar: "Kommer att vara" = will be (state). Use "bli" for change, "vara" for ongoing state.

target: Hon skulle vilja resa mer nästa vecka.
english: She would like to travel more next week.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like to. The polite way to express wishes.

target: Jag ska prova den nya restaurangen nästa år.
english: I'm going to try the new restaurant next year.
grammar: "Prova" = try. "Ska prova" = am going to try (planned action).

target: Sommaren kommer att bli fin på morgonen.
english: The summer will be nice in the morning.
grammar: "Kommer att bli" = will become/be. Prediction about the future.

target: Vi skulle stanna längre om vi kunde.
english: We would stay longer if we could.
grammar: "Om vi kunde" = if we could. Hypothetical condition: past tense in Swedish.

target: Han ska plugga till läkare hela tiden.
english: He's going to study to be a doctor all the time.
grammar: "Plugga" = study (informal). "Plugga till" = study to become.

target: Det kommer att bli dyrt under veckan.
english: It will be expensive during the week.

target: Jag skulle aldrig säga det på kvällen.
english: I would never say that in the evening.

target: Vi ska resa till Japan nästa år.
english: We're going to travel to Japan next year.

target: Vädret kommer att förbättras under veckan snart.
english: The weather will improve during the week soon.

target: Om jag hade tid skulle jag läsa mer.
english: If I had time I would read more.

target: Jag ska börja träna regelbundet i helgen.
english: I'm going to start exercising regularly on the weekend.

target: Det kommer att bli spännande hela tiden.
english: It will be exciting all the time.

target: Jag skulle vilja lära mig fler språk.
english: I would like to learn more languages.

target: Vi ska ses nästa vecka på kvällen.
english: We're meeting next week in the evening.

target: Priserna kommer att stiga efter jobbet till slut.
english: Prices will rise after work in the end.

target: Han skulle kunna komma på fredag till slut.
english: He could come on Friday in the end.

target: Jag ska handla på vägen hem också.
english: I'm going to shop on the way home too.

target: Tågen kommer att gå som vanligt till slut.
english: The trains will run as usual in the end.

target: Vi skulle bli glada om ni kom.
english: We would be happy if you came.

target: Hon ska ta semester i augusti snart.
english: She's going to take vacation in August soon.

target: Det kommer att finnas plats sedan länge.
english: There will be room for a long time.

target: Jag skulle inte ha gjort det på kontoret.
english: I wouldn't have done that at the office.
grammar: "Skulle inte ha" + supine = wouldn't have. Conditional perfect.

target: Vi ska fira med hela familjen också.
english: We're going to celebrate with the whole family too.

target: Det kommer att kräva tålamod nästa vecka.
english: It will require patience next week.

target: Han skulle ha kommit om han kunnat.
english: He would have come if he could.

target: Jag ska boka biljetter idag sedan länge.
english: I'm going to book tickets today for a long time.

target: Det kommer snart att vara vår nog.
english: Soon it will be spring probably.

target: Vi skulle vilja bo vid havet väl.
english: We would like to live by the sea I suppose.

target: Hon ska börja plugga i höst nog.
english: She's going to start studying in the fall probably.

target: Ekonomin kommer att växa just nu nog.
english: The economy will grow right now probably.

target: Om jag var du skulle jag vänta.
english: If I were you I would wait.

target: Jag ska sluta röka på kvällen nog.
english: I'm going to quit smoking in the evening probably.

target: Det kommer att löna sig under veckan.
english: It will pay off during the week.

target: Vi skulle ha stannat längre sedan länge.
english: We should have stayed longer for a long time.
grammar: "Skulle ha" + supine also = should have (in hindsight).

target: Han ska laga middag ikväll ibland nu.
english: He's going to cook dinner tonight sometimes now.

target: Regnet kommer att sluta snart i helgen.
english: The rain will stop soon on the weekend.

target: Jag skulle gärna följa med under veckan.
english: I would gladly come along during the week.

target: Vi ska besöka mormor på söndag nog.
english: We're going to visit grandma on Sunday probably.

target: Det kommer att bli en lång vinter.
english: It will be a long winter.

target: Om vi hade pengar skulle vi resa.
english: If we had money we would travel.

target: Jag ska köpa ny cykel hela tiden.
english: I'm going to buy a new bicycle all the time.

target: Temperaturen kommer att sjunka under veckan nog.
english: The temperature will drop during the week probably.

target: Han skulle inte ha sagt det på jobbet.
english: He shouldn't have said that at work.

target: Vi ska åka och fiska i helgen.
english: We're going fishing this weekend.

target: Det kommer att ordna sig på kvällen.
english: It will work out in the evening.

target: Jag skulle vilja prova att segla dit.
english: I would like to try sailing there.

target: Hon ska ta körkort i helgen snart.
english: She's going to get a driver's license on the weekend soon.

target: Befolkningen kommer att öka på kvällen nog.
english: The population will increase in the evening probably.

target: Vi skulle kunna ta tåget istället verkligen.
english: We could take the train instead really.

target: Jag ska anmäla mig till kursen idag.
english: I'm going to sign up for the course today.

target: Det kommer att bli möjligt snart nog.
english: It will be possible soon probably.

target: Om det inte regnar ska vi grilla.
english: If it doesn't rain we'll barbecue.

target: Vi ska renovera badrummet under veckan snart.
english: We're going to renovate the bathroom during the week soon.

target: Sjukvården kommer att förbättras på morgonen nog.
english: Healthcare will improve in the morning probably.

target: Jag skulle inte ändra något under sommaren.
english: I wouldn't change anything during the summer.

target: De ska skaffa hund i helgen också.
english: They're going to get a dog on the weekend too.

target: Det kommer att ta lite tid till slut.
english: It will take some time in the end.

target: Vi skulle uppskatta det sedan länge nästa år.
english: We would appreciate it for a long time next year.

target: Jag ska lära mig att laga husmanskost.
english: I'm going to learn to cook Swedish home cooking.
grammar: "Husmanskost" is traditional Swedish home cooking — hearty, comforting dishes.

target: Det kommer att vara värt besväret snart.
english: It will be worth the trouble soon.

target: Hon skulle ha blivit glad nästa vecka.
english: She would have been happy next week.

target: Vi ska plantera nya träd nästa vecka.
english: We're going to plant new trees next week.

target: Dagarna kommer att bli längre ibland snart.
english: The days will get longer sometimes soon.

target: Jag skulle kunna tänka mig det också.
english: I could imagine that too.
grammar: "Jag skulle kunna tänka mig" = I could imagine / I'd be open to — very common polite phrase.

target: Vi ska ta itu med problemet snart.
english: We're going to tackle the problem soon.

target: Det kommer att bli annorlunda på kvällen.
english: It will be different in the evening.

target: Han skulle vilja bo utomlands ibland i Sverige.
english: He would like to live abroad sometimes in Sweden.

target: Jag ska läsa klart boken i helgen.
english: I'm going to finish the book this weekend.

target: Sverige kommer att nå sina klimatmål snart.
english: Sweden will reach its climate goals soon.

target: Om jag kunde skulle jag stanna ute.
english: If I could I would stay outside.

target: Vi ska ha det trevligt nästa vecka.
english: We're going to have a nice time next week.

target: Det kommer att finnas fler möjligheter nog.
english: There will be more opportunities probably.

target: Jag skulle vilja tacka er alla dit.
english: I would like to thank you all there.

target: Vi ska göra det här tillsammans förra veckan.
english: We're going to do this together last week.

target: Framtiden kommer att visa just nu nog.
english: The future will tell right now probably.

target: Allt ska bli bra till slut väl.
english: Everything will be fine in the end I suppose.

target: Vi skulle inte ha missat det gärna.
english: We wouldn't have missed it gladly.

target: Jag ska börja om på nytt väl.
english: I'm going to start over I suppose.

target: Det kommer aldrig att hända igen till slut.
english: It will never happen again in the end.

target: Vi ska ta vara på varje dag.
english: We're going to treasure every day.

target: Hon skulle ha föredragit att stanna i skolan.
english: She would have preferred to stay at school.

target: Imorgon ska vi åka tidigt hela tiden.
english: Tomorrow we're leaving early all the time.

target: Sommaren kommer att vara underbar just nu.
english: The summer will be wonderful right now.

target: Jag skulle vilja se mer av Sverige.
english: I would like to see more of Sweden.

target: Vi ska fortsätta kämpa förra veckan nu.
english: We're going to keep fighting last week now.

target: Även om det regnar ska vi gå ut.
english: Even if it rains we'll go out.
grammar: "Även om" = even if/though. Introduces a concessive clause.

target: Å ena sidan är det billigt, å andra sidan är det långt bort.
english: On one hand it's cheap, on the other hand it's far away.
grammar: "Å ena sidan ... å andra sidan" = on one hand ... on the other hand.

target: Dessutom behöver vi mer tid under veckan.
english: Moreover, we need more time during the week.
grammar: "Dessutom" = moreover/besides/in addition.

target: Trots att hon var trött fortsatte hon.
english: Despite being tired she continued.
grammar: "Trots att" = despite the fact that. Subclause triggers verb-final order.

target: Antingen åker vi idag eller imorgon under sommaren.
english: Either we go today or tomorrow during summer.
grammar: "Antingen ... eller" = either ... or.

target: Varken han eller hon kom nästa vecka.
english: Neither he nor she came next week.
grammar: "Varken ... eller" = neither ... nor.

target: Dels regnade det, dels blåste det redan.
english: Partly it rained, partly it was windy already.
grammar: "Dels ... dels" = partly ... partly. Used to list reasons.

target: Ju mer man övar, desto bättre blir man.
english: The more you practice, the better you get.
grammar: "Ju...desto" = the more...the more. A fixed correlative pattern.

target: Inte bara studerar hon, hon jobbar också.
english: Not only does she study, she also works.
grammar: "Inte bara ... utan också" = not only ... but also.

target: Huruvida det stämmer vet jag inte väl.
english: Whether it's correct I don't know I suppose.
grammar: "Huruvida" = whether. More formal than "om."

target: Förutsatt att vädret tillåter åker vi dit.
english: Provided the weather permits, we'll go there.
grammar: "Förutsatt att" = provided that / assuming that.

target: I och med att han slutade fick hon jobbet.
english: Since he quit, she got the job.
grammar: "I och med att" = since/given that.

target: Så länge du är här är jag glad.
english: As long as you're here I'm happy.
grammar: "Så länge" = as long as. Second clause inverts after fronted subclause.

target: Snarare tycker jag det är intressant ibland.
english: Rather, I think it's interesting sometimes.
grammar: "Snarare" = rather/more accurately.

target: Emellertid finns det problem varje dag egentligen.
english: However, there are problems every day actually.
grammar: "Emellertid" = however. More formal than "men."

target: Däremot gillar jag kaffe på morgonen alltid.
english: On the other hand, I like coffee in the morning always.
grammar: "Däremot" = on the other hand / by contrast.

target: Likväl fortsätter de varje dag egentligen.
english: Nevertheless, they continue every day actually.
grammar: "Likväl" = nevertheless/yet. Formal.

target: Visserligen är det dyrt, men det är bra.
english: Admittedly it's expensive, but it's good.
grammar: "Visserligen...men" = admittedly...but. Concessive pattern.

target: I synnerhet gillar jag svensk natur ibland.
english: In particular I like Swedish nature sometimes.
grammar: "I synnerhet" = especially/in particular. Formal connector.

target: Till följd av stormen stängdes vägen ofta.
english: As a result of the storm, the road was closed often.

target: Med anledning av festen stänger vi tidigt.
english: On account of the party, we close early.

target: Bortsett från vädret var det perfekt i Sverige.
english: Apart from the weather, it was perfect in Sweden.

target: Såvida du inte ångrar dig på kvällen.
english: Unless you change your mind in the evening.
grammar: "Såvida ... inte" = unless.

target: I den mån det är möjligt hjälper vi.
english: Insofar as it's possible, we'll help.

target: Allt eftersom tiden gick blev det bättre.
english: As time went on it got better.
grammar: "Allt eftersom" = as (gradually over time).

target: Oavsett vad som händer fortsätter vi väl.
english: Regardless of what happens, we continue I suppose.

target: Trots det lyckades vi på kvällen till slut.
english: Despite that, we succeeded in the evening in the end.

target: I gengäld hjälper jag dig imorgon gärna.
english: In return, I'll help you tomorrow gladly.

target: Dock finns det undantag ibland här.
english: However, there are exceptions sometimes here.
grammar: "Dock" = however/yet. Very common in written Swedish.

target: Nämligen är problemet mer komplext varje morgon.
english: Namely, the problem is more complex every morning.

target: Med hänsyn till situationen väntar vi gärna.
english: In consideration of the situation, we'll wait gladly.

target: Å andra sidan har du en poäng.
english: On the other hand, you have a point.

target: Under förutsättning att alla kommer på kvällen.
english: On condition that everyone comes in the evening.

target: I samband med flytten behöver vi hjälp.
english: In connection with the move, we need help.

target: I stället för att klaga, föreslå en lösning.
english: Instead of complaining, suggest a solution.

target: Utan tvekan är det rätt beslut redan.
english: Without doubt, it's the right decision already.

target: Följaktligen ändrade vi planen väldigt ofta förra året.
english: Consequently, we changed the plan very often last year.
grammar: "Följaktligen" = consequently/therefore. Formal.

target: Sammanfattningsvis var det en bra dag redan.
english: In summary, it was a good day already.

target: Kort sagt, vi lyckades hela tiden till slut.
english: In short, we succeeded all the time in the end.

target: Annorlunda uttryckt, vi har ett problem nog.
english: Put differently, we have a problem probably.

target: Med andra ord behöver vi agera nu.
english: In other words, we need to act now.

target: Det vill säga, vi har två alternativ.
english: That is to say, we have two options.
grammar: "Det vill säga" (dvs.) = that is (i.e.).

target: Nämligen, det finns en annan lösning här.
english: Namely, there is another solution here.

target: Allteftersom vintern närmade sig blev det kallare.
english: As winter approached it got colder.

target: Inte desto mindre är jag optimistisk redan.
english: Nonetheless, I am optimistic already.
grammar: "Inte desto mindre" = nonetheless/nevertheless.

target: Så till vida att vi har pengar kvar.
english: In so far as we have money left.

target: I avsaknad av bevis friade rätten på kvällen.
english: In the absence of evidence, the court acquitted in the evening.

target: Till skillnad från Stockholm är Malmö platt.
english: Unlike Stockholm, Malmö is flat.

target: I jämförelse med förra året har vi förbättrats.
english: Compared to last year, we have improved.

target: Med avseende på kvaliteten är den utmärkt.
english: With regard to quality, it's excellent.

target: Oaktat problemen slutfördes projektet på morgonen till slut.
english: Notwithstanding the problems, the project was completed in the morning in the end.
grammar: "Oaktat" = notwithstanding. Very formal written Swedish.

target: Emedan solen sken var alla glada egentligen.
english: As the sun shone, everyone was happy actually.
grammar: "Emedan" = as/since. Archaic/formal — rarely used in speech.

target: Medan vi väntade läste vi förra veckan.
english: While we waited, we read last week.

target: Så fort dörren öppnades rusade hunden ut.
english: As soon as the door opened, the dog rushed out.

target: Inte förrän klockan tre fick vi svar.
english: Not until three o'clock did we get an answer.

target: Givet omständigheterna var det bra sedan länge.
english: Given the circumstances, it was good for a long time.

target: I enlighet med reglerna agerade vi ute.
english: In accordance with the rules, we acted outside.

target: Med utgångspunkt från data kan vi se.
english: Based on data, we can see.

target: Sett till resultaten har vi lyckats väl.
english: Looking at the results, we have succeeded I suppose.

target: Så vitt jag vet stämmer det väl.
english: As far as I know, it's correct I suppose.

target: Såsom jag ser det finns det inget val.
english: As I see it, there is no choice.

target: I det fall att ni behöver hjälp, ring.
english: In case you need help, call.

target: För det första behöver vi planera idag.
english: First of all, we need to plan today.

target: För det andra ska vi budgetera nästa år.
english: Secondly, we should budget next year.

target: Slutligen vill jag tacka alla under veckan.
english: Finally, I want to thank everyone during the week.

target: Vidare behöver vi utvärdera sedan länge idag.
english: Furthermore, we need to evaluate for a long time today.

target: Därtill kommer ytterligare kostnader ibland nog.
english: In addition to that, there are further costs sometimes probably.

target: Likaså gäller det för alla avdelningar gärna.
english: Likewise, it applies to all departments gladly.

target: På samma sätt kan vi lösa det här.
english: In the same way, we can solve this.

target: Samtidigt måste vi vara realistiska förra veckan.
english: At the same time, we must be realistic last week.

target: Icke desto mindre fortsätter arbetet på morgonen.
english: Nevertheless, the work continues in the morning.

target: Tvärtemot vad vi trodde gick det bra.
english: Contrary to what we thought, it went well.

target: Tvärtom tycker jag det är en bra idé.
english: On the contrary, I think it's a good idea.

target: Istället för att vänta agerade vi efter jobbet.
english: Instead of waiting, we acted after work.

target: Det innebär att vi behöver ändra planen.
english: This means we need to change the plan.

target: Härmed förklarar jag mötet öppnat förra veckan.
english: Hereby I declare the meeting open last week.

target: Härav följer att vi måste agera nu.
english: From this it follows that we must act now.

target: I det stora hela var det positivt.
english: On the whole, it was positive.

target: Så att säga var det en kompromiss.
english: So to speak, it was a compromise.

target: I alla händelser kommer vi att vara redo.
english: In any case, we will be ready.

target: Faktum är att vi lyckades under veckan.
english: The fact is that we succeeded during the week.

target: Allt som allt var det en bra dag.
english: All in all, it was a good day.

target: Lika fullt gick vi framåt hela tiden.
english: Just the same, we moved forward all the time.

target: Ännu mer anmärkningsvärt är framgången förra veckan.
english: Even more remarkable is the success last week.

target: I korthet handlar det om samarbete varje dag.
english: In short, it's about cooperation every day.

target: Alltnog, vi behöver gå vidare varje morgon.
english: Anyhow, we need to move on every morning.

target: Med det sagt vill jag tacka er.
english: With that said, I want to thank you.

target: Utöver det har vi inga fler frågor.
english: Beyond that, we have no more questions.

target: I ljuset av nya fakta ändrar vi oss.
english: In light of new facts, we change our minds.

target: Mot bakgrund av detta föreslår jag i skolan.
english: Against this background, I suggest at school.

target: I första hand bör vi fokusera nog.
english: In the first place, we should focus probably.

target: I andra hand kan vi överväga också.
english: Secondly, we can consider too.

target: Inte minst är samarbete viktigt just nu.
english: Not least, cooperation is important right now.

target: Framför allt vill jag betona på kvällen.
english: Above all, I want to emphasize in the evening.

target: Härutöver tillkommer resekostnader under sommaren till slut.
english: In addition to this, travel costs are added during the summer in the end.

target: I övrigt finns inget att tillägga i Sverige.
english: Otherwise, there is nothing to add in Sweden.

target: Det ska tilläggas att vi är nöjda.
english: It should be added that we are satisfied.

target: Rent praktiskt innebär det att på morgonen.
english: In practical terms, this means that in the morning.

target: I princip är vi överens väldigt ofta.
english: In principle, we agree very often.

target: Sett ur det perspektivet stämmer det väl.
english: Seen from that perspective, it's correct I suppose.

target: Givetvis ställer vi upp i köket varje morgon.
english: Of course, we'll participate in the kitchen every morning.

target: I sista hand avgör chefen just nu.
english: As a last resort, the boss decides right now.

target: Den leende flickan vinkade varje dag gärna.
english: The smiling girl waved every day gladly.
grammar: Present participle as adjective: -ande/-ende. "Le" → "leende." Does not change for gender.

target: Det sjungande barnet var glatt väldigt ofta.
english: The singing child was happy very often.
grammar: Present participle as adjective: sjungande (singing). Same form for en/ett/plural.

target: De springande barnen skrattade på kontoret varje morgon.
english: The running children laughed at the office every morning.
grammar: Participles don't inflect: springande works with any gender/number.

target: En imponerande prestation sedan länge ibland.
english: An impressive performance for a long time sometimes.
grammar: Present participle (-ande/-ende) never changes form — same for all genders.

target: Ett växande problem under sommaren i trädgården.
english: A growing problem during the summer in the garden.
grammar: Present participle is invariable — same form for en/ett/plural: "en/ett/de växande..."

target: Den stängda dörren hela tiden under sommaren.
english: The closed door all the time during summer.
grammar: Past participle as adjective: changes for gender! En-word: -d. Ett-word: -t. Plural: -da.

target: Det stängda fönstret efter jobbet hemma.
english: The closed window after work at home.
grammar: Past participle as adjective: stängd/stängt/stängda. Agrees with the noun's gender/number.

target: De stängda dörrarna förra veckan också.
english: The closed doors last week too.
grammar: Plural past participle: -a ending. Stängd (en) → stängt (ett) → stängda (plural/definite).

target: Den parkerade bilen just nu i Sverige.
english: The parked car right now in Sweden.
grammar: Past participle as adj agrees with gender: parkerad (en), parkerat (ett), parkerade (pl/def).

target: Ett brutet löfte just nu nog.
english: A broken promise right now probably.
grammar: Strong verbs have irregular past participles: "bryta" → "bruten/brutet/brutna."

target: De skrivna orden hela tiden också.
english: The written words all the time too.
grammar: "Skriven/skrivet/skrivna" — strong verb participle. "Ord" is ett-word, plural same form.

target: En skriven text under veckan väl.
english: A written text during the week I suppose.
grammar: Strong verb past participle: skriven (en), skrivet (ett), skrivna (plural).

target: Det målade huset under veckan gärna.
english: The painted house during the week gladly.
grammar: Past participle as adjective: "målad" (painted). "Målat" for ett-words: "det målade huset."

target: Den kokta potatisen på morgonen dit.
english: The boiled potatoes in the morning there.
grammar: "Kokt" = boiled/cooked. Past participle agrees: kokt (ett), kokta (plural/definite).

target: Ett fryst paket under sommaren för alla.
english: A frozen package during the summer for everyone.
grammar: "Fryst" = frozen (from "frysa"). Indefinite ett-word: "ett fryst paket" (no change needed).

target: De älskade barnen förra veckan idag.
english: The beloved children last week today.
grammar: "Älskade" can mean both "beloved" (participle adjective) and "loved" (past tense). Context decides.

target: En respekterad ledare i trädgården varje morgon.
english: A respected leader in the garden every morning.
grammar: Past participle with en-word (indefinite): "respekterad." No ending change needed.

target: Det förlorade passet efter jobbet väl.
english: The lost passport after work I suppose.
grammar: "Förlorad" = lost (from "förlora"). "Pass" is ett-word: passet. "Förlorade" in definite.

target: De glömda minnena under sommaren väl.
english: The forgotten memories during the summer I suppose.
grammar: "Glömd" = forgotten. Plural definite: "glömda." "Minne" is ett-word, plural: "minnen."

target: En överraskande nyhet väldigt ofta nu.
english: A surprising piece of news very often now.
grammar: "Överraskande" (surprising) — present participle (-ande/-ende) never inflects. Same for all forms.

target: Ett avslappnande bad sedan länge ute.
english: A relaxing bath for a long time outside.
grammar: "Avslappnande" = relaxing. Present participle from "avslappna." -ande is universal.

target: De fascinerande berättelserna nästa vecka under sommaren.
english: The fascinating stories next week during summer.
grammar: "Fascinerande" = fascinating. Present participle — never changes form.

target: En utmanande uppgift på morgonen med vänner.
english: A challenging task in the morning with friends.
grammar: "Utmanande" = challenging. From "utmana" (challenge).

target: Ett inspirerande tal efter jobbet hemma.
english: An inspiring speech after work at home.
grammar: "Inspirerande" = inspiring. "Tal" is ett-word: ett tal, talet, tal, talen.

target: De spännande äventyren under sommaren med familjen.
english: The exciting adventures during the summer with the family.

target: Flickan sittande vid fönstret under sommaren väl.
english: The girl sitting by the window during the summer I suppose.

target: Mannen stående i hörnet efter jobbet under sommaren.
english: The man standing in the corner after work during summer.

target: Barnen lekande i trädgården nästa vecka gärna.
english: The children playing in the garden next week gladly.

target: En brinnande eld ibland på helgerna.
english: A burning fire sometimes on weekends.

target: Det fallande lövet under sommaren väl.
english: The falling leaves during the summer I suppose.

target: De dansande paren sedan länge förra året.
english: The dancing couples for a long time last year.

target: En levande legend i helgen i Sverige.
english: A living legend on the weekend in Sweden.
grammar: "Levande" = living (present participle). "Leva" → "levande" — a very common form.

target: Ett pågående projekt hela tiden redan.
english: An ongoing project all the time already.

target: De kommande dagarna just nu till slut.
english: The coming days right now in the end.

target: En avgörande faktor varje dag egentligen.
english: A decisive factor every day actually.

target: Det befriande regnet i helgen också.
english: The liberating rain on the weekend too.

target: En välkomnande atmosfär i skogen varje morgon.
english: A welcoming atmosphere in the forest every morning.

target: Det omgivande landskapet på morgonen också.
english: The surrounding landscape in the morning too.

target: De medverkande artisterna under sommaren alltid.
english: The participating artists during the summer always.

target: En berörande historia efter jobbet på kontoret.
english: A touching story after work at the office.

target: Ett oroande tecken väldigt ofta just nu.
english: A worrying sign very often right now.

target: De saknade nycklarna på morgonen på helgerna.
english: The missing keys in the morning on weekends.

target: En underförstådd mening på kvällen under sommaren.
english: An implied meaning in the evening during summer.

target: Det oförändrade landskapet under sommaren idag.
english: The unchanged landscape during the summer today.

target: En missförstådd person på morgonen i Sverige.
english: A misunderstood person in the morning in Sweden.

target: Det övergivna huset i affären varje morgon.
english: The abandoned house in the store every morning.

target: De anställda på företaget på kvällen varje vecka.
english: The employees at the company in the evening every week.

target: En nyanställd kollega på kvällen ibland.
english: A newly hired colleague in the evening sometimes.

target: Det förbjudna området förra veckan väl.
english: The forbidden area last week I suppose.

target: De inbjudna gästerna i helgen ofta.

english: An expected change in the morning for everyone.

target: Det oväntade besöket på morgonen redan.

target: De planerade aktiviteterna väldigt ofta förra året.
