target: En vackert dekorerad tårta väldigt ofta varje vecka.
english: A beautifully decorated cake very often every week.

target: Det entusiastiskt mottagna initiativet i helgen väl.
english: The enthusiastically received initiative on the weekend I suppose.

target: De kritiskt granskade resultaten förra veckan nu.
english: The critically examined results last week now.

target: En passionerat driven entreprenör vid sjön varje morgon.
english: A passionately driven entrepreneur by the lake every morning.

target: Han sa att han var trött redan.
english: He said that he was tired already.
grammar: Reported speech: "sa att" + subordinate clause. Tense often stays the same in Swedish.

target: Hon berättade glatt att hon äntligen hade fått det nya jobbet.
english: She happily told that she had finally gotten the new job.
grammar: Reported speech uses past perfect (hade fått) when the original was past tense (fick).

target: De sa att de skulle komma till slut.
english: They said they would come in the end.
grammar: "Sa att" + "skulle" reports a future intention from the original speech.

target: Han frågade om jag hade lust att följa med ut.
english: He asked if I felt like coming along outside.
grammar: Reported questions use "om" (if/whether) for yes/no questions.

target: Hon undrade var vi bodde väldigt ofta.
english: She wondered where we lived very often.
grammar: Reported questions with wh-words keep the question word: var, när, hur, etc.

target: De berättade att allt hade gått bra.
english: They told that everything had gone well.
grammar: Past perfect in reported speech indicates action before the saying.

target: Han påstod att han hade rätt redan.
english: He claimed that he was right already.
grammar: "Påstå" = claim/assert. Often implies doubt about the truth.

target: Hon meddelade att mötet var inställt redan.
english: She informed that the meeting was cancelled already.
grammar: "Inställt" = cancelled. An adjective from "ställa in" (cancel). Past participle form.

target: De förklarade att de inte kunde komma.
english: They explained that they couldn't come.
grammar: In reported subordinate clauses, "inte" goes BEFORE the verb: "att de inte kunde."

target: Han lovade att han skulle ringa nästa år.
english: He promised that he would call next year.
grammar: "Skulle" in reported speech = 'would' — backshift of "ska" (will).

target: Hon hävdade att det var sant egentligen.
english: She maintained that it was true actually.
grammar: "Hävda" (claim/maintain) — a formal reporting verb. Everyday: "sa" (said).

target: De föreslog att vi skulle vänta dit.
english: They suggested that we should wait there.
grammar: "Föreslå" = suggest. "Skulle" in reported speech = should/would.

target: Han erkände att han hade fel redan.
english: He admitted that he was wrong already.
grammar: "Erkänna" = admit. "Ha fel" = be wrong. "Hade" in reported speech.

target: Hon försäkrade mig om att allt var bra.
english: She assured me that everything was fine.
grammar: "Försäkra om" = assure. "Allt" = everything. Reported past tense.

target: De varnade oss att det var farligt.
english: They warned us that it was dangerous.
grammar: "Varna" = warn. "Farligt" = dangerous (neuter with "det").

target: Han klagade över att det var kallt.
english: He complained that it was cold.

target: Hon upprepade att vi måste vara i tid.
english: She repeated that we must be on time.

target: De tillade att priset inte ingick på helgerna.
english: They added that the price was not included on weekends.

target: Han nämnde att han kände henne med familjen.
english: He mentioned that he knew her with the family.

target: Hon konstaterade att resultatet var bra redan.
english: She stated that the result was good already.

target: De bekräftade att bokningen var klar egentligen.
english: They confirmed that the booking was ready actually.

target: Han invände att det var för dyrt.
english: He objected that it was too expensive.

target: Hon sa att hon inte förstod till slut.
english: She said she didn't understand in the end.

target: De menade att vi borde agera också.
english: They believed we should act too.

target: Han ansåg att beslutet var fel redan.
english: He considered the decision wrong already.

target: Hon berättade för mig att hon var sjuk.
english: She told me that she was sick.

target: De rapporterade att vädret skulle bli bättre.
english: They reported that the weather would improve.

target: Han påpekade att vi hade gjort fel.
english: He pointed out that we had made a mistake.

target: Hon avslöjade att hon var gravid egentligen.
english: She revealed that she was pregnant actually.

target: De informerade oss om att tåget var försenat.
english: They informed us that the train was delayed.

target: Han önskade att vi kunde stanna nog.
english: He wished that we could stay probably.

target: Hon undrade om det fanns plats i trädgården.
english: She wondered if there was room in the garden.

target: De frågade när vi hade tänkt åka.
english: They asked when we had planned to leave.

target: Han ville veta hur länge vi stannade.
english: He wanted to know how long we were staying.

target: Hon frågade vad jag tyckte sedan länge.
english: She asked what I thought for a long time.

target: De undrade vem som hade ringt redan.
english: They wondered who had called already.

target: Han frågade varför jag var sen redan.
english: He asked why I was late already.

target: Hon ville veta vilken film vi hade sett.
english: She wanted to know which movie we had seen.

target: De frågade hur man kom dit till slut.
english: They asked how to get there in the end.

target: Han undrade om butiken var öppen egentligen.
english: He wondered if the store was open actually.

target: Hon frågade om vi hade ätit redan.
english: She asked if we had eaten already.

target: De ville veta om vi behövde hjälp.
english: They wanted to know if we needed help.

target: Han sa åt mig att vänta gärna.
english: He told me to wait gladly.
grammar: "Säga åt" = tell someone to do something. More forceful than "be."

target: Hon bad mig att stänga dörren under sommaren.
english: She asked me to close the door during summer.
grammar: "Be" = ask/request politely.

target: De uppmanade oss att lämna i helgen.
english: They urged us to leave on the weekend.

target: Han beordrade soldaterna att stanna under sommaren.
english: He ordered the soldiers to stay during the summer.

target: Hon föreslog att vi skulle ta en paus.
english: She suggested we take a break.

target: De rådde mig att söka jobbet på kvällen.
english: They advised me to apply for the job in the evening.

target: Han krävde att vi skulle betala för alla.
english: He demanded that we pay for everyone.

target: Hon övertygade mig om att det var rätt.
english: She convinced me that it was right.

target: Enligt honom var det en bra idé.
english: According to him, it was a good idea.
grammar: "Enligt" + person is another way to report: "According to..."

target: Enligt tidningen har priserna ökat på kvällen.
english: According to the newspaper, prices have increased in the evening.
grammar: "Enligt" + source is a clean way to attribute information.

target: Enligt väderprognosen ska det bli sol nu.
english: According to the forecast, it will be sunny now.

target: I hennes ögon var det perfekt egentligen.
english: In her eyes, it was perfect actually.

target: Som han uttryckte det, var det en katastrof.
english: As he put it, it was a disaster.

target: Han sa i princip att han inte ville.
english: He basically said he didn't want to.

target: Hon antydde att hon tänkte sluta egentligen.
english: She hinted that she planned to quit actually.

target: De lät förstå att de var missnöjda.
english: They made it known they were dissatisfied.

target: Han viskade att han hade en hemlighet.
english: He whispered that he had a secret.

target: Hon skrek att vi skulle stanna hemma.
english: She screamed that we should stay at home.

target: De mumlade att det var synd egentligen.
english: They mumbled that it was a pity actually.

target: Han suckade att det var hopplöst redan.
english: He sighed that it was hopeless already.

target: Hon skrattade och sa att det var roligt.
english: She laughed and said it was fun.

target: De protesterade och sa att det var orättvist.
english: They protested and said it was unfair.

target: Han log och sa att allt var bra.
english: He smiled and said everything was fine.

target: Hon nickade och bekräftade att det stämde.
english: She nodded and confirmed it was correct.

target: De vinkade och ropade att vi skulle komma.
english: They waved and called that we should come.

target: Han skakade på huvudet och sa nej.
english: He shook his head and said no.

target: Nyheten sa att det var en olycka.
english: The news said it was an accident.

target: Artikeln hävdade att det var falskt egentligen.
english: The article claimed it was false actually.

target: Rapporten visade att resultaten förbättrats varje dag.
english: The report showed that results had improved every day.

target: Studien konstaterade att det finns samband i Sverige.
english: The study found that there's a connection in Sweden.

target: Boken berättar att han föddes 1909 gärna.
english: The book tells that he was born in 1909 gladly.

target: Skylten sa att det var förbjudet egentligen.
english: The sign said it was forbidden actually.

target: Mejlet meddelade att mötet var flyttat egentligen.
english: The email informed that the meeting was moved actually.

target: Dokumentet fastslog att avtalet var giltigt egentligen.
english: The document established that the agreement was valid actually.

target: Programmet visade att mycket hade hänt redan.
english: The program showed that a lot had happened already.

target: Jag hörde att det var en bra restaurang.
english: I heard it was a good restaurant.

target: Man säger att svensk mat är tråkig.
english: They say Swedish food is boring.
grammar: "Man säger att" = they say / it is said — used for common beliefs.

target: Det sägs att sommaren blir varm redan.
english: It's said the summer will be warm already.
grammar: "Det sägs att" = it is said that — impersonal reported speech.

target: Det påstås att huset är hemsökt redan.
english: It's claimed the house is haunted already.

target: Det ryktas att de ska skiljas nog.
english: It's rumored they're getting divorced probably.
grammar: "Ryktas" = be rumored. Deponent verb.

target: Det anses vara den bästa skolan egentligen.
english: It's considered the best school actually.

target: Det uppges att situationen är allvarlig nog.
english: It's reported that the situation is serious probably.

target: Det framgår av rapporten att vi behöver mer.
english: The report shows that we need more.

target: Det framkom att ingen visste väldigt ofta.
english: It turned out that nobody knew very often.

target: Det visade sig att han hade rätt.
english: It turned out that he was right.

target: Det konstaterades att skadorna var små väl.
english: It was found that the damages were small I suppose.

target: Det beslutades att vi skulle vänta förra året.
english: It was decided that we would wait last year.

target: Det överenskoms att mötet skulle hållas till slut.
english: It was agreed that the meeting would be held in the end.

target: Det noterades att alla var närvarande nog.
english: It was noted that everyone was present probably.

target: Det betonades att kvalitet var viktigt egentligen.
english: It was emphasized that quality was important actually.

target: Det rekommenderades att vi anlitade expert till slut.
english: It was recommended that we hire an expert in the end.

target: Han ska ha sagt att han inte visste.
english: He supposedly said he didn't know.
grammar: "Ska ha" + supine = reportedly/supposedly. Distances from the claim.

target: Hon lär ha berättat hemligheten på morgonen.
english: She is said to have told the secret in the morning.
grammar: "Lär ha" = is said to have — another way to report unconfirmed information.

target: De ska tydligen ha bestämt sig snart.
english: They have apparently decided soon.

target: Enligt uppgift planeras en ny skola ofta.
english: According to reports, a new school is planned often.

target: Som jag förstod det var problemet löst.
english: As I understood it, the problem was solved.

target: Så vitt jag vet har de redan åkt.
english: As far as I know, they've already left.

target: Det är ingen ko på isen väl.
english: There's nothing to worry about I suppose.
grammar: Literally "no cow on the ice." One of Sweden's most beloved idioms — meaning relax, everything's fine.

target: Att lägga locket på väldigt ofta just nu.
english: To put a lid on it very often right now.
grammar: Means to stop discussing something, to sweep it under the carpet.

target: Att gå som katten kring het gröt.
english: To beat around the bush.
grammar: Literally "walk like a cat around hot porridge" — avoid the main point.

target: Det är ingen dans på rosor väl.
english: It's no bed of roses I suppose.
grammar: Literally "no dance on roses" — the situation is difficult.

target: Han tog skeden i vacker hand nog.
english: He got down to business graciously probably.
grammar: To accept a difficult situation and deal with it.

target: Vi satt i samma båt ibland väl.
english: We were in the same boat sometimes I suppose.
grammar: Same idiom in English and Swedish — universal maritime metaphor.

target: Att kasta in handduken på morgonen snart.
english: To throw in the towel in the morning soon.

target: Det rinner av som vatten på en gås.
english: Like water off a duck's back.
grammar: Literally "it runs off like water on a goose" — criticism doesn't affect them.

target: Att ha rent mjöl i påsen egentligen.
english: To have a clean conscience actually.
grammar: Literally "have clean flour in the bag" — nothing to hide.

target: Hon har tagit sig vatten över huvudet.
english: She has bitten off more than she can chew.
grammar: Literally "taken water over her head" — taken on too much.

target: Det faller på sin egen orimlighet med vänner.
english: It's self-evidently absurd with friends.

target: Att göra en höna av en fjäder.
english: To make a mountain out of a molehill.
grammar: Literally "make a hen out of a feather."

target: Han dog som en sill varje morgon.
english: He was dead tired every morning.
grammar: "Dö" is used figuratively — "dying like a herring" means exhausted.

target: Att inte se skogen för alla träd.
english: To not see the forest for the trees.

target: Vi tar det med en nypa salt.
english: We take it with a grain of salt.
grammar: "Nypa" = pinch. Same idiom as English "grain of salt."

target: Det var droppen som fick bägaren att rinna över.
english: It was the last straw.
grammar: Literally "the drop that made the cup overflow."

target: Han gick bet på uppgiften hela tiden.
english: He failed at the task all the time.
grammar: "Gå bet" = fail at something. Colloquial.

target: Att sticka ut hakan hela tiden väl.
english: To stick one's neck out all the time I suppose.
grammar: Literally "stick out the chin" — take a risk or bold stance.

target: Det går inte att ha kakan och äta den.
english: You can't have your cake and eat it too.

target: Hon slog huvudet på spiken just nu.
english: She hit the nail on the head right now.

target: Att hamna i blåsväder på morgonen i Sverige.
english: To be in hot water in the morning in Sweden.
grammar: Literally "end up in windy weather" — get into trouble.

target: Han har ett finger med i spelet.
english: He has a finger in the pie.

target: Att inte lägga alla ägg i samma korg.
english: To not put all eggs in one basket.

target: Det är en storm i ett vattenglas.
english: It's a storm in a teacup.

target: Hon gick rakt på sak nästa vecka.
english: She got straight to the point next week.
grammar: "Gå rakt på sak" = go straight to the point. Very direct.

target: Att dra alla över en kam efter jobbet.
english: To tar everyone with the same brush after work.
grammar: Literally "comb everyone the same way."

target: Det finns lik i garderoben varje morgon.
english: There are skeletons in the closet every morning.
grammar: Literally "corpses in the wardrobe."

target: Han har svårt att hålla tungan rätt i mun.
english: He has trouble keeping his mouth shut.
grammar: Literally "hold the tongue right in the mouth" — tends to say the wrong thing.

target: Att vara ute och cykla efter jobbet.
english: To be barking up the wrong tree after work.
grammar: Literally "be out cycling" — be completely mistaken.

target: Vi korsade fingrarna hela tiden förra året.
english: We crossed our fingers all the time last year.
grammar: Swedes actually "hold their thumbs" (hålla tummarna) rather than cross fingers!

target: Att ta tjuren vid hornen på morgonen.
english: To take the bull by the horns in the morning.

target: Hon hade fjärilar i magen efter jobbet.
english: She had butterflies in her stomach after work.

target: Det var det bästa sedan skivat bröd.
english: It was the best thing since sliced bread.

target: Att ha is i magen sedan länge.
english: To keep cool under pressure for a long time.
grammar: Literally "have ice in the stomach" — stay calm and patient.

target: Han brände alla broar efter jobbet ibland.
english: He burned all bridges after work sometimes.
grammar: Same idiom in Swedish and English — burning bridges behind you.

target: Det finns mer än ett sätt att flå en katt.
english: There's more than one way to skin a cat.

target: Att lägga sig platt hela tiden till slut.
english: To capitulate completely all the time in the end.
grammar: Literally "lay yourself flat" — give in unconditionally.

target: Hon såg rött under sommaren hemma.
english: She saw red during the summer at home.

target: Vi satte tummen mitt i ögat på honom.
english: We defeated him completely.

target: Att vara som en öppen bok egentligen.
english: To be like an open book actually.

target: Det kostar skjortan på kontoret varje morgon.
english: It costs a fortune at the office every morning.
grammar: Literally "costs the shirt" — extremely expensive.

target: Han har bränt sig på den soppan förut.
english: He's been burned by that before.

target: Att få kalla fötter på kvällen också.
english: To get cold feet in the evening too.

target: Vi drog nytta av situationen på morgonen.
english: We took advantage of the situation in the morning.
grammar: "Dra nytta av" = benefit from. Very common business expression.

target: Att hälla olja på elden på kvällen.
english: To pour oil on the fire in the evening.

target: Hon tog det med ro sedan länge.
english: She took it calmly for a long time.
grammar: "Ta det med ro" = take it calmly. "Ro" = peace/calm.

target: Det var som bortblåst hela tiden egentligen.
english: It was like it had vanished into thin air all the time actually.

target: Att stå med ryggen mot väggen på kvällen.
english: To have one's back against the wall in the evening.

target: Han gick i mål i helgen egentligen.
english: He reached his goal on the weekend actually.

target: Vi fick blod på tand just nu.
english: We got a taste for it right now.
grammar: Literally "got blood on the tooth" — became eager to continue.

target: Att vara het som en gryta redan.
english: To be very popular/trendy already.
grammar: Literally "hot as a pot" — something everyone wants.

target: Hon hade gröna fingrar under veckan alltid.
english: She had green thumbs during the week always.

target: Det ligger i linje med planen ofta.
english: It is in line with the plan often.

target: Att veta vart vinden blåser på morgonen.
english: To know which way the wind blows in the morning.

target: Han kastade ljus över saken hela tiden.
english: He shed light on the matter all the time.

target: Vi tog hem spelet hela tiden ibland.
english: We won the game all the time sometimes.

target: Det är under all kritik under sommaren.
english: It's beneath all criticism during the summer.
grammar: Means so bad it can't even be criticized properly.

target: Att simma mot strömmen nästa vecka hemma.
english: To swim against the current next week at home.

target: Hon hade en räv bakom örat redan.
english: She was cunning already.
grammar: Literally "had a fox behind the ear" — was clever/sly.

target: Vi la ner stridsbilen på kvällen under sommaren.
english: We gave up the fight in the evening during summer.

target: Att ge sig i kast med något.
english: To tackle something.

target: Han gick på en nit sedan länge.
english: He was unsuccessful for a long time.

target: Det föll i god jord hela tiden.
english: It was well received all the time.

target: Att vara en nagel i ögat egentligen.
english: To be a thorn in one's side actually.

target: Hon levde ur hand i mun nu.
english: She lived from hand to mouth now.

target: Vi satte fingret på problemet sedan länge.
english: We put our finger on the problem for a long time.

target: Det gick som smort i helgen hemma.
english: It went like clockwork on the weekend at home.
grammar: Literally "went like greased" — smoothly and effortlessly.

target: Att komma på grön kvist under sommaren.
english: To get back on one's feet during the summer.

target: Han hade tummen mitt i handen redan.
english: He was all thumbs already.
grammar: Literally "had the thumb in the middle of the hand" — clumsy.

target: Vi lät gräset växa under fötterna med vänner.
english: We let the grass grow under our feet with friends.

target: Det var en sak för sig egentligen.
english: That was a whole different matter actually.

target: Att ta bladet från munnen väldigt ofta.
english: To speak one's mind very often.
grammar: Literally "take the leaf from the mouth" — be direct/candid.

target: Hon höll masken förra veckan också.
english: She kept a straight face last week too.

target: Vi gick med på deras villkor idag.
english: We agreed to their terms today.

target: Det föll sig naturligt varje dag redan.
english: It came naturally every day already.

target: Att stå på egna ben på kvällen.
english: To stand on one's own two feet in the evening.

target: Han tog hem det hela under veckan.
english: He brought it all home during the week.

target: Vi satte punkt för diskussionen på morgonen.
english: We put an end to the discussion in the morning.

target: Det gick åt skogen efter jobbet väl.
english: It went badly wrong after work I suppose.
grammar: Literally "went to the forest" — completely failed.

target: Att ha koll på läget ibland hemma.
english: To have a handle on the situation sometimes at home.

target: Hon fick foten i dörren förra veckan.
english: She got a foot in the door last week.

target: Det var som att slå i en dörr.
english: It was like talking to a brick wall.

target: Vi tog sats och hoppade under sommaren.
english: We took a running start and jumped during the summer.

target: Att vara i det blå i helgen.
english: To be unknown on the weekend.
grammar: "I det blå" means unknown, uncertain — it's all up in the blue.

target: Han log brett förra veckan väl.
english: He grinned widely last week I suppose.

target: Vi kom överens på stående fot till slut.
english: We agreed immediately in the end.

target: Det var en riktig ögonöppnare sedan länge.
english: It was a real eye-opener for a long time.

target: Att dra lärdom av sina misstag redan.
english: To learn from one's mistakes already.

target: Hon tog saken i egna händer i skolan.
english: She took matters into her own hands at school.

target: Vi skyndade oss långsamt ibland sedan länge.
english: We made haste slowly sometimes for a long time.
grammar: "Skynda sig långsamt" = hurry slowly — a very Swedish approach to getting things done.

target: Det var en smal sak på kvällen.
english: It was easy in the evening.
grammar: Literally "a narrow thing" — a piece of cake.

target: Att visa var skåpet ska stå nästa år.
english: To show who's boss next year.
grammar: Literally "show where the cupboard should stand" — assert authority.

target: Han fick sin vilja igenom sedan länge.
english: He got his way for a long time.

target: Vi la korten på bordet ibland med familjen.
english: We put our cards on the table sometimes with the family.
grammar: "Lägga korten på bordet" = be transparent about everything.

target: Det är en klar signal efter jobbet.
english: It's a clear signal after work.

target: Att gå i bräschen efter jobbet alltid.
english: To lead the way after work always.

target: Hon fick vatten på sin kvarn till slut.
english: She got grist for her mill in the end.

target: Vi satte sprätt på pengarna varje morgon.
english: We spent the money quickly every morning.

target: Det rår jag inte för förra veckan.
english: I can't help that last week.

target: Att ha örnkoll väldigt ofta på kontoret.
english: To keep a sharp eye on very often at the office.
grammar: Literally "eagle surveillance" — very attentive monitoring.

target: Han la sig vinn om att vara artig.
english: He made an effort to be polite.

target: Att hålla tummarna förra veckan väl.
english: To keep one's fingers crossed last week I suppose.
grammar: Swedes "hold their thumbs" rather than cross fingers — the Swedish good luck gesture.

target: Vi höll oss på mattan på kvällen.
english: We kept a low profile in the evening.
grammar: Literally "stayed on the carpet" — stayed in line, behaved.

target: Det var sur frukt förra veckan alltid.
english: It was sour grapes last week always.

target: Att gå i taket på kvällen i skolan.
english: To hit the roof in the evening at school.

target: Hon la band på sig i helgen.
english: She restrained herself on the weekend.

target: Vi fick nys om saken på kvällen.
english: We got wind of the matter in the evening.

target: Det satt som en smäck väldigt ofta.
english: It fit perfectly very often.

target: Att tappa sugen sedan länge i trädgården.
english: To lose motivation for a long time in the garden.
grammar: "Tappa sugen" = lose one's enthusiasm/drive.

target: Han la det på minnet ibland redan.
english: He made a mental note sometimes already.

target: Vi drog åt samma håll väldigt ofta.
english: We pulled in the same direction very often.

target: Det kliar i fingrarna sedan länge här.
english: My fingers are itching for a long time here.
grammar: Means eager to do something.

target: Att sova på saken efter jobbet med vänner.
english: To sleep on it after work with friends.

target: Skulle du kunna hjälpa mig förra veckan?
english: Could you help me last week?
grammar: "Skulle du kunna" is more polite than "Kan du." Adds social distance and respect.

target: Kan du hjälpa mig på morgonen också?
english: Can you help me in the morning too?
grammar: Casual and direct — perfectly fine among friends and peers.

target: Jag undrar om ni har tid nog.
english: I wonder if you have time probably.
grammar: "Ni" as polite "you" is making a small comeback in customer service contexts.

target: Har du tid varje dag nog?
english: Do you have time every day probably?

target: Jag skulle vilja beställa på morgonen förra året.
english: I would like to order in the morning last year.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like. The polite standard in restaurants and shops.

target: Jag vill ha en öl ibland snart.
english: I want a beer sometimes soon.
grammar: Direct "jag vill ha" is casual but common among friends.

target: Ursäkta att jag stör väldigt ofta redan.
english: Excuse me for disturbing very often already.
grammar: Formal/polite opener before asking a stranger something.

target: Hej, en fråga bara på kvällen nästa år.
english: Hi, just a question in the evening next year.
grammar: Casual opener — very common in everyday Swedish.

target: Jag ber om ursäkt för förseningen på jobbet.
english: I apologize for the delay at work.
grammar: Formal apology. Used in business or official settings.

target: Förlåt att jag är sen efter jobbet!
english: Sorry I'm late after work!
grammar: Casual apology among friends.

target: Tack så hjärtligt i helgen väl.
english: Thank you most kindly on the weekend I suppose.
grammar: Very formal thanks. Rarely used in everyday speech.

target: Tack, det var snällt under veckan redan!
english: Thanks, that was kind during the week already!
grammar: Casual and warm.

target: Med vänliga hälsningar ibland för alla.
english: With kind regards sometimes for everyone.
grammar: Standard formal email/letter closing in Swedish.

target: Hälsningar! / Mvh efter jobbet på kvällen?
english: Regards! / Best after work in the evening?
grammar: Casual email closing. "Mvh" = "med vänliga hälsningar" abbreviated.

target: Vi ber er vänligen att vänta väl.
english: We kindly ask you to wait I suppose.
grammar: Formal/institutional language.

target: Vänta lite, är du snäll förra veckan.
english: Wait a moment, please last week.

target: Det är med stor glädje jag meddelar.
english: It is with great pleasure I announce.
grammar: Very formal announcement style.

target: Kolla, jag fick jobbet på morgonen till slut!
english: Check it out, I got the job in the morning in the end!
grammar: Very casual exclamation.

target: Härmed bekräftas er bokning just nu väl.
english: Hereby your booking is confirmed right now I suppose.
grammar: Formal written Swedish, typical in official correspondence.

target: Din bokning är bekräftad under veckan också.
english: Your booking is confirmed during the week too.
grammar: Standard casual/neutral tone.

target: Vi anhåller om ert tålamod ibland hemma.
english: We request your patience sometimes at home.
grammar: Very formal — seen in official notices.

target: Ha lite tålamod under sommaren nästa år.
english: Have some patience during the summer next year.

target: Jag vore tacksam om ni kunde på kontoret.
english: I would be grateful if you could at the office.
grammar: "Vore" is subjunctive of "vara" — very polite/formal.

target: Jag hade blivit glad om du kunde.
english: I'd be happy if you could.
grammar: Casual conditional request.

target: Det torde vara möjligt efter jobbet egentligen.
english: It should presumably be possible after work actually.
grammar: "Torde" = presumably should. Very formal/written Swedish.

target: Det borde gå bra just nu också.
english: It should be fine right now too.

target: Jag önskar er en trevlig dag nog.
english: I wish you a pleasant day probably.

target: Ha det bra sedan länge nog!
english: Take care for a long time probably!

target: Härmed överlämnar jag rapporten förra veckan alltid.
english: Hereby I submit the report last week always.
grammar: Formal bureaucratic language.

target: Här kommer rapporten i helgen snart.
english: Here's the report on the weekend soon.

target: Torde ni ha ytterligare frågor under veckan.
english: Should you have further questions during the week.
grammar: Very formal conditional — business/official.

target: Om du har fler frågor just nu.
english: If you have more questions right now.

target: Det åligger var och en att följa reglerna.
english: It is incumbent upon everyone to follow the rules.
grammar: "Åligger" = it is the duty of. Very formal/legal.

target: Alla måste följa reglerna varje dag egentligen.
english: Everyone must follow the rules every day actually.

target: Jag vill framföra mitt djupaste tack verkligen.
english: I wish to convey my deepest thanks really.

target: Tack så jättemycket varje dag egentligen!
english: Thanks so much every day actually!
grammar: Casual and enthusiastic. "Jätte-" prefix adds emphasis.

target: Var god och fyll i formuläret redan.
english: Please fill in the form already.
grammar: "Var god" = please. Standard in official instructions.

target: Fyll i den här lappen efter jobbet.
english: Fill in this form after work.

target: Undertecknad intygar härmed på morgonen redan.
english: The undersigned hereby certifies in the morning already.
grammar: Very formal legal/official language.

target: Jag lovar att det stämmer i helgen.
english: I promise it's correct on the weekend.

target: Vi hemställer att ärendet behandlas på morgonen.
english: We respectfully request the matter be handled in the morning.
grammar: "Hemställa" = formally request. Used in official/governmental contexts.

target: Vi vill att det här fixas snart.
english: We want this to be fixed soon.

target: Ärade åhörare, jag vill tacka er alla för att ni kom.
english: Dear listeners, I want to thank you all for coming.
grammar: Very formal opening for speeches.

target: Hej allihopa, när man talar med en person man inte känner!
english: Hi everyone, when speaking with a person you do not know!

target: Jag vänder mig till er med en fråga.
english: I turn to you with a question.
grammar: Formal way to address someone with a request.

target: Jag har en fråga nästa vecka redan.
english: I have a question next week already.
grammar: "Fråga" is both a noun (en fråga) and a verb (att fråga). Very common.

target: Det hade varit önskvärt om efter jobbet.
english: It would have been desirable if after work.
grammar: Formal conditional — business/academic.

target: Det hade varit nice om på kvällen.
english: It would've been nice if in the evening.
grammar: Casual — using English loanword "nice" is very common in spoken Swedish.

target: Vederbörande har inte lämnat besked ibland nog.
english: The person in question has not responded sometimes probably.
grammar: "Vederbörande" = the person in question. Very formal.

target: Han har inte svarat sedan länge redan.
english: He hasn't answered for a long time already.

target: Undertecknad anhåller om permission på kvällen varje dag.
english: The undersigned requests leave in the evening every day.
grammar: Military/very formal bureaucratic style.

target: Jag vill ta ledigt sedan länge ibland.
english: I want to take time off for a long time sometimes.

target: Vi ber att få återkomma under sommaren.
english: We ask to get back to you during the summer.
grammar: Formal customer service language.

target: Jag hör av mig varje dag redan.
english: I'll be in touch every day already.
grammar: Casual. Very common way to end a conversation.

target: Tillåt mig att förklara just nu ibland.
english: Allow me to explain right now sometimes.

target: Okej, lyssna nu förra veckan alltid.
english: Okay, listen now last week always.

target: Hur önskar ni betala väldigt ofta nog?
english: How would you like to pay very often probably?
grammar: Formal customer service Swedish.

target: Hur vill du betala just nu snart?
english: How do you want to pay right now soon?

target: Det förefaller som om vi har ett problem.
english: It appears as if we have a problem.
grammar: "Förefalla" = to appear/seem. Very formal.

target: Det verkar som vi har ett problem.
english: It seems like we have a problem.

target: Jag uppskattar er medverkan varje dag idag.
english: I appreciate your participation every day today.

target: Tack för att ni hjälpte till nu!
english: Thanks for helping now!

target: Jag ber om att få framföra redan.
english: I ask to be allowed to present already.

target: Jag vill bara säga förra veckan verkligen.
english: I just want to say last week really.

target: Skriftligt meddelande bifogas efter jobbet redan.
english: Written notice is enclosed after work already.

target: Jag skickar med det på morgonen hemma.
english: I'm attaching it in the morning at home.

target: Ärendet är under utredning just nu nog.
english: The matter is under investigation right now probably.

target: Vi kollar på det nästa vecka i trädgården.
english: We're looking into it next week in the garden.

target: I egenskap av ordförande i helgen nog.
english: In my capacity as chairman on the weekend probably.

target: Som chef tycker jag sedan länge alltid.
english: As the boss, I think for a long time always.

target: Vi emotser ert svar förra veckan också.
english: We await your reply last week too.
grammar: "Emotse" = formally await. Used in business letters.

target: Vi väntar på svar just nu egentligen.
english: We're waiting for an answer right now actually.

target: Avseende er förfrågan efter jobbet alltid.
english: Regarding your inquiry after work always.

target: Angående det du frågade om på morgonen.
english: About what you asked in the morning.

target: Vi ber er notera väldigt ofta här.
english: We ask you to note very often here.

target: Observera att för alla under sommaren.
english: Note that for everyone during summer.

target: Jag önskar er en angenäm helg nästa år.
english: I wish you a pleasant weekend next year.

target: Ha en bra helg just nu förra året!
english: Have a good weekend right now last year!

target: Jag tillåter mig att påminna efter jobbet.
english: I take the liberty of reminding after work.

target: Bara en påminnelse i helgen med vänner.
english: Just a reminder on the weekend with friends.

target: Vi finner det angeläget att just nu.
english: We find it imperative that right now.

target: Det är viktigt att på kvällen redan.
english: It's important that in the evening already.

target: Jag ber er ha överseende på kvällen.
english: I ask for your indulgence in the evening.

target: Förlåt att jag stör, men jag har en viktig fråga.
english: Sorry to disturb, but I have an important question.

target: Vi vore er djupt förbundna på kvällen.
english: We would be deeply obliged to you in the evening.
grammar: Extremely formal gratitude. Almost never heard in speech.

target: Vi hade blivit jätteglada väldigt ofta redan.
english: We would be really happy very often already.

target: Det ligger utanför min befogenhet på kvällen.
english: It lies outside my authority in the evening.

target: Det kan jag inte göra varje dag.
english: I can't do that every day.

target: Med tillåtelse vill jag framhålla sedan länge.
english: With your permission I would like to emphasize for a long time.

target: Jag vill poängtera att hemma hos oss varje morgon.
english: I want to point out that at our home every morning.

target: Vi beklagar olägenheten hela tiden på helgerna.
english: We regret the inconvenience all the time on weekends.
grammar: Standard formal apology in customer service.

target: Förlåt för krånglet på morgonen ibland.
english: Sorry for the hassle in the morning sometimes.

target: Jag hemställer om uppskov sedan länge redan.
english: I formally request a postponement for a long time already.

target: Kan vi skjuta upp det varje dag?
english: Can we postpone it every day?

target: Till er kännedom just nu redan.
english: For your information right now already.
grammar: Formal — used in official memos.

target: Bara så du vet förra veckan alltid.
english: Just so you know last week always.

target: Vidare vill vi informera om hela tiden.
english: Furthermore, we wish to inform about all the time.

target: Och sen vill vi berätta att gärna.
english: And then we want to tell you that gladly.

target: Tack för ert förtroende på kvällen verkligen.
english: Thank you for your trust in the evening really.

target: Tack för att du litar på mig.
english: Thanks for trusting me.

target: Givet ovanstående föreslår vi i helgen väl.
english: Given the above, we suggest on the weekend I suppose.

target: Så vi tänkte att just nu egentligen.
english: So we thought that right now actually.

target: Du och jag, vi fixar det i skolan.
english: You and me, we'll fix it at school.
grammar: The familiarity and directness of Swedish informal register — "du" with everyone.

target: Vi får se till att lösa detta skyndsamt.
english: We must see to it that this is resolved promptly.

target: Skål, grabbar, i den formella inbjudan till middagen på ambassaden!
english: Cheers, guys, in the formal invitation to the dinner at the embassy!

target: Jag har äran att framföra hela tiden.
english: I have the honor to convey all the time.

target: Jag ringer upp dig senare väldigt ofta.
english: I'll call you back later very often.
grammar: Particle verbs: verb + particle (upp, ner, ut, in, av, på). The particle changes the meaning.

target: Hon stänger av TVn i helgen ofta.
english: She turns off the TV on the weekend often.
grammar: "Stänga av" = turn off. "Stänga" alone = close.

target: Vi sätter på musiken sedan länge för alla.
english: We turn on the music for a long time for everyone.
grammar: "Sätta på" = turn on. Opposite of "stänga av."

target: Han tar av sig skorna förra veckan.
english: He takes off his shoes last week.
grammar: "Ta av sig" = take off (clothing). Reflexive particle verb.

target: Jag tar på mig jackan varje morgon.
english: I put on my jacket every morning.

target: Vi går ut ikväll under veckan gärna.
english: We're going out tonight during the week gladly.
grammar: "Gå ut" = go out. "Gå in" = go in.

target: Hon kommer in hela tiden nog.
english: She comes in all the time probably.

target: Han ser fram emot semestern hela tiden.
english: He looks forward to the vacation all the time.
grammar: "Se fram emot" = look forward to. The particle "fram emot" is two words.

target: Vi ger inte upp ibland här.
english: We don't give up sometimes here.
grammar: "Ge upp" = give up.

target: Jag bryter ihop av stress sedan länge.
english: I break down from stress for a long time.
grammar: "Bryta ihop" = break down. "Ihop" = together/apart.

target: Hon slår upp ett ord i ordboken.
english: She looks up a word in the dictionary.

target: Vi tar reda på sanningen ibland gärna.
english: We find out the truth sometimes gladly.
grammar: "Ta reda på" = find out / investigate.

target: Han håller med dig hela tiden under sommaren.
english: He agrees with you all the time during summer.
grammar: "Hålla med" = agree. The particle "med" changes the meaning from "hold."

target: Jag fyller i formuläret nästa vecka väl.
english: I fill in the form next week I suppose.

target: Vi plockar upp skräpet just nu på kvällen.
english: We pick up the trash right now in the evening.

target: Hon lägger ner tid på det här.
english: She puts time into it here.
grammar: "Lägga ner" = put down/invest (time/effort). Also = shut down (a business).

target: Han ger sig av klockan sju alltid.
english: He leaves at seven always.
grammar: "Ge sig av" = leave/set off. Very common.

target: Vi håller på med middagen på morgonen.
english: We're busy with dinner in the morning.
grammar: "Hålla på med" = be busy with / be in the process of.

target: Jag sticker iväg nu nästa vecka varje dag.
english: I'm heading off now next week every day.
grammar: "Sticka iväg" = leave/head off. Casual.

target: Hon dyker upp oväntat ibland i trädgården.
english: She shows up unexpectedly sometimes in the garden.
grammar: "Dyka upp" = show up/appear.

target: Vi tar emot gäster nästa vecka gärna.
english: We receive guests next week gladly.
grammar: "Ta emot" = receive/accept.

target: Han ställer in mötet på stranden varje morgon.
english: He cancels the meeting at the beach every morning.
grammar: "Ställa in" = cancel. Very important particle verb.

target: Jag skjuter upp beslutet på stationen varje morgon.
english: I postpone the decision at the station every morning.
grammar: "Skjuta upp" = postpone.

target: Vi delar ut priserna på morgonen i trädgården.
english: We hand out the prizes in the morning in the garden.

target: Hon kastar bort maten hela tiden här.
english: She throws away the food all the time here.
grammar: "Kasta bort" = throw away.

target: Han bryter av mitt i meningen på kvällen.
english: He breaks off mid-sentence in the evening.

target: Vi tar över ansvaret varje dag egentligen.
english: We take over the responsibility every day actually.

target: Jag hinner inte med under sommaren ibland.
english: I can't keep up during the summer sometimes.
grammar: "Hinna med" = manage to keep up with / have time for.

target: Hon slår sig ner i soffan på helgerna.
english: She sits down on the sofa on weekends.
grammar: "Slå sig ner" = sit down / settle in.

target: Vi stiger på bussen väldigt ofta varje vecka.
english: We get on the bus very often every week.
grammar: "Stiga på" = get on (transport). "Stiga av" = get off.

target: Han kliver av tåget ibland för alla.
english: He gets off the train sometimes for everyone.

target: Jag kopplar av efter jobbet väldigt ofta.
english: I unwind after work very often.
grammar: "Koppla av" = relax/unwind. Literally "disconnect."

target: Vi bryter upp tidigt förra veckan väl.
english: We break up early last week I suppose.

target: Hon plockar undan efter festen under sommaren.
english: She tidies up after the party during the summer.

target: Han fyller på glaset förra veckan gärna.
english: He refills the glass last week gladly.
grammar: "Fylla på" = refill/top up.

target: Vi kommer överens på kvällen snart.
english: We agree / reach an agreement in the evening soon.
grammar: "Komma överens" = agree / come to an agreement.

target: Jag går igenom rapporten på kontoret varje morgon.
english: I go through the report at the office every morning.
grammar: "Gå igenom" = go through / review.

target: Hon tar hand om barnen på kvällen.
english: She takes care of the children in the evening.
grammar: "Ta hand om" = take care of. Extremely common.

target: Vi ger oss av på resa väl.
english: We set off on a trip I suppose.

target: Han hittar på en ursäkt väldigt ofta.
english: He makes up an excuse very often.
grammar: "Hitta på" = make up / invent. Also = come up with an activity.

target: Jag lägger ihop tvätten varje dag egentligen.
english: I fold the laundry every day actually.
grammar: "Lägga ihop" = fold / put together.

target: Vi räknar ut svaret efter jobbet egentligen.
english: We figure out the answer after work actually.
grammar: "Räkna ut" = calculate / figure out.

target: Hon pekar ut felet hela tiden med familjen.
english: She points out the error all the time with the family.

target: Han ser efter barnen under sommaren egentligen.
english: He looks after the children during the summer actually.
grammar: "Se efter" = look after / keep an eye on.

target: Vi sätter igång projektet väldigt ofta just nu.
english: We start up the project very often right now.
grammar: "Sätta igång" = start up / get going.

target: Jag skriver ner anteckningar just nu varje dag.
english: I write down notes right now every day.

target: Hon häller upp kaffe nästa vecka ibland.
english: She pours coffee next week sometimes.
grammar: "Hälla upp" = pour (a drink).

target: Vi lägger till en punkt just nu.
english: We add a point right now.
grammar: "Lägga till" = add.

target: Han drar sig tillbaka förra veckan också.
english: He withdraws last week too.
grammar: "Dra sig tillbaka" = withdraw / retire.

target: Jag sätter mig in i ämnet till slut.
english: I familiarize myself with the subject in the end.
grammar: "Sätta sig in i" = familiarize oneself with.

target: Vi ställer om klockan under veckan också.
english: We change the clock during the week too.
grammar: "Ställa om" = reset / adjust.

target: Hon tar upp frågan förra veckan alltid.
english: She brings up the question last week always.
grammar: "Ta upp" = bring up / raise (a topic).

target: Han lägger av med rökning på kvällen.
english: He quits smoking in the evening.
grammar: "Lägga av" = quit / stop. Colloquial.

target: Vi breder ut filten på morgonen väl.
english: We spread out the blanket in the morning I suppose.

target: Jag kopplar ihop delarna förra veckan alltid.
english: I connect the parts last week always.

target: Hon skiljer sig från mängden under veckan.
english: She stands out from the crowd during the week.

target: Vi tar oss an uppgiften på kvällen.
english: We take on the task in the evening.
grammar: "Ta sig an" = take on / tackle.

target: Han lyser upp rummet på kvällen för alla.
english: He lights up the room in the evening for everyone.

target: Jag häller av vattnet väldigt ofta förra året.
english: I pour off the water very often last year.

target: Vi lyfter fram fördelarna just nu också.
english: We highlight the advantages right now too.
grammar: "Lyfta fram" = highlight / bring forward.

target: Hon biter ihop och kämpar förra veckan.
english: She grits her teeth and fights last week.

target: Vi går vidare till nästa punkt dit.
english: We move on to the next point there.
grammar: "Gå vidare" = move on / proceed.

target: Han slår upp numret förra veckan alltid.
english: He looks up the number last week always.

target: Jag tar bort fläcken under veckan alltid.
english: I remove the stain during the week always.
grammar: "Ta bort" = remove / take away.

target: Vi skruvar åt locket under sommaren redan.
english: We tighten the lid during the summer already.

target: Hon vrider om nyckeln hela tiden i trädgården.
english: She turns the key all the time in the garden.

target: Han tänder lampan varje dag redan.
english: He turns on the lamp every day already.

target: Jag släcker ljuset efter jobbet nästa år.
english: I turn off the light after work next year.

target: Vi viker ihop kläderna förra veckan gärna.
english: We fold the clothes last week gladly.

target: Hon torkar av bordet väldigt ofta nog.
english: She wipes the table very often probably.
grammar: "Torka av" = wipe off/clean.

target: Han skalar av tapeten förra veckan gärna.
english: He peels off the wallpaper last week gladly.

target: Vi river ner huset nästa vecka under sommaren.
english: We tear down the house next week during summer.

target: Jag bygger ut balkongen under sommaren på morgonen.
english: I extend the balcony during the summer in the morning.

target: Hon sätter upp gardiner på morgonen ibland.
english: She puts up curtains in the morning sometimes.
grammar: "Sätta upp" = put up / hang up.

target: Vi städar undan sedan länge varje vecka.
english: We tidy away for a long time every week.

target: Han rätar ut situationen hela tiden gärna.
english: He straightens out the situation all the time gladly.

target: Jag knyter ihop säcken ibland med familjen.
english: I tie things together sometimes with the family.
grammar: "Knyta ihop säcken" = wrap things up / bring to conclusion. Literally "tie up the sack."

target: Vi drar igång festen i helgen nog.
english: We kick off the party on the weekend probably.

target: Hon bär fram maten i helgen redan.
english: She brings out the food on the weekend already.

target: Han rör om i grytan under veckan.
english: He stirs the pot during the week.

target: Jag slår in presenten nästa vecka här.
english: I wrap the present next week here.

target: Vi bjuder in dem efter jobbet för alla.
english: We invite them after work for everyone.

target: Hon skjuter till pengar just nu hemma.
english: She chips in money right now at home.
grammar: "Skjuta till" = contribute / chip in.

target: Han driver på projektet i affären varje morgon.
english: He pushes the project forward in the store every morning.
grammar: "Driva på" = push / drive forward.

target: Jag snappar upp information förra veckan väl.
english: I pick up information last week I suppose.

target: Vi låser in oss under sommaren med familjen.
english: We lock ourselves in during the summer with the family.

target: Hon springer om honom under veckan också.
english: She overtakes him during the week too.
grammar: "Springa om" = overtake (while running).

target: Han slår sig lös på kvällen till slut.
english: He lets loose in the evening in the end.
grammar: "Slå sig lös" = let loose / cut loose.

target: Vi håller ihop förra veckan gärna.
english: We stick together last week gladly.

target: Jag hänger med på det just nu.
english: I follow / understand that right now.
grammar: "Hänga med" = follow along / understand. Also = come along.

target: Hon vänder om halvvägs efter jobbet gärna.
english: She turns back halfway after work gladly.

target: Vi breder på smöret ibland i skolan.
english: We spread the butter sometimes at school.

target: Han räcker till för alla förra veckan.
english: It's enough for everyone last week.
grammar: "Räcka till" = be sufficient / be enough.

target: Jag håller ut till slutet på morgonen.
english: I persevere to the end in the morning.
grammar: "Hålla ut" = endure / persevere.

target: Vi bär oss åt som vuxna nog.
english: We behave like adults probably.
grammar: "Bära sig åt" = behave.

target: Hon ger sig inte förra veckan också.
english: She doesn't give in last week too.
grammar: "Ge sig" = give in / surrender.

target: Han faller in i mönstret under veckan.
english: He falls into the pattern during the week.

target: Jag skärper mig i helgen väl.
english: I pull myself together on the weekend I suppose.
grammar: "Skärpa sig" = pull oneself together / shape up.

target: Vi tar oss samman sedan länge gärna.
english: We pull ourselves together for a long time gladly.

target: Han tappar bort nycklarna varje dag egentligen.
english: He loses the keys every day actually.
grammar: "Tappa bort" = lose (an object).

target: Vi klarar av det efter jobbet egentligen.
english: We manage it after work actually.
grammar: "Klara av" = manage / handle.

target: Hon kollar upp fakta hela tiden nog.
english: She checks the facts all the time probably.

target: Vi böjer oss för beslutet väldigt ofta.
english: We comply with the decision very often.

target: Han står ut med smärtan ibland väl.
english: He puts up with the pain sometimes I suppose.
grammar: "Stå ut med" = put up with / endure.

target: Jag ser upp till min pappa med familjen.
english: I look up to my dad with the family.
grammar: "Se upp till" = look up to / admire.

target: Vi ser ner på fuskare på kvällen.
english: We look down on cheaters in the evening.

target: Hon ser till att allt är klart.
english: She makes sure everything is ready.
grammar: "Se till att" = make sure that.

target: Det var igår som jag träffade henne.
english: It was yesterday that I met her.
grammar: Cleft sentence: "Det var ... som" focuses on a particular element for emphasis.

target: Det är du som bestämmer i helgen.
english: It is you who decides on the weekend.
grammar: "Det är DU som bestämmer" emphasizes who. Very common pattern.

target: Det är i Stockholm som hon bor.
english: It is in Stockholm that she lives.
grammar: Cleft sentence: 'Det är X som...' emphasizes X. Very common in spoken Swedish.

target: Aldrig förr hade jag sett något sådant.
english: Never before had I seen anything like it.
grammar: Fronting a negative adverb creates a very emphatic, literary construction.

target: Inte ens en gång tänkte han på det.
english: Not even once did he think about it.
grammar: Fronted negation triggers V2: "Inte ens..." + verb + subject. Dramatic emphasis.

target: Sällan har jag ätit så gott redan.
english: Seldom have I eaten so well already.
grammar: Fronted adverbs trigger inversion: Sällan + har + jag. Adds emphasis and literary flavor.

target: Knappt hade vi anlänt förrän det började regna.
english: Hardly had we arrived when it started raining.
grammar: "Knappt...förrän" = barely...when. Triggers inversion and uses past perfect.

target: Inte bara regnade det kraftigt utan det haglade också den dagen.
english: Not only did it rain heavily but it also hailed that day.
grammar: "Inte bara...också" (not only...also). First clause inverts; second is normal order.

target: Vad jag tycker spelar ingen roll ibland.
english: What I think doesn't matter sometimes.
grammar: Subordinate clause as subject — placed first with no inversion in the main clause.

target: Att lära sig ett nytt språk tar tid.
english: Learning a new language takes time.
grammar: "Att" + infinitive clause as subject.

target: Hur vi löser problemet vet jag inte.
english: How we solve the problem I don't know.
grammar: Fronted indirect question as topic: "Hur vi löser" + inverted main: "vet jag inte."

target: Var hon bor är en hemlighet med familjen.
english: Where she lives is a secret with the family.
grammar: Indirect question as subject: "Var hon bor" = where she lives.

target: Vad han sa förvånade oss på morgonen.
english: What he said surprised us in the morning.
grammar: Indirect question as subject. Normal word order inside: "vad han sa."

target: Att han kom förvånade mig i helgen.
english: That he came surprised me on the weekend.
grammar: "Att"-clause as subject. "Förvånade" = surprised. Very natural in Swedish.

target: Duktig som hon är löser hon allt.
english: Skilled as she is, she solves everything.
grammar: Adjective fronting for emphasis: adjective + som + subject + verb.

target: Trött som jag var somnade jag direkt.
english: Tired as I was, I fell asleep right away.

target: Vacker som dagen var gick vi ut.
english: Beautiful as the day was, we went out.

target: Sjunga kan hon verkligen varje dag väl.
english: Sing she really can every day I suppose.
grammar: Verb topicalization: placing the infinitive first for emphasis.

target: Laga mat kan jag inte sedan länge.
english: Cook I cannot for a long time.

target: Springa orkar jag inte efter jobbet väl.
english: Run I can't be bothered to after work I suppose.

target: Hem gick vi tidigt i helgen här.
english: Home we went early on the weekend here.
grammar: Adverb topicalization with V2 inversion.

target: Bort flög fågeln under veckan med familjen.
english: Away flew the bird during the week with the family.

target: Upp gick solen nästa vecka väl.
english: Up went the sun next week I suppose.

target: In kom barnen varje dag redan.
english: In came the children every day already.

target: Ut sprang katten på morgonen snart.
english: Out ran the cat in the morning soon.

target: Det var kaffe hon ville ha, inte te.
english: It was coffee she wanted, not tea.

target: Det var förra veckan som vi träffades.
english: It was last week that we met.

target: Det var hon som ringde väldigt ofta.
english: It was she who called very often.

target: Det var därför vi inte kom väl.
english: That was why we didn't come I suppose.

target: Så sa han det, men jag trodde inte på honom.
english: So he said, but I didn't believe him.

target: Det gjorde hon verkligen sedan länge på jobbet.
english: She really did for a long time at work.
grammar: "Det + göra" as pro-verb for emphasis: "She really DID."

target: Gå kan jag, men inte springa alltid.
english: Walk I can, but not run always.

target: Pengar har vi inte, men tid har vi.
english: Money we don't have, but time we do.
grammar: Parallel fronting creates contrast between two objects.

target: I Sverige bor det tio miljoner människor.
english: In Sweden live ten million people.

target: Under bordet låg katten förra veckan också.
english: Under the table lay the cat last week too.

target: Mitt på natten ringde telefonen nästa vecka.
english: In the middle of the night the phone rang next week.

target: Ingenstans kunde jag hitta nyckeln på morgonen.
english: Nowhere could I find the key in the morning.

target: Så fort jag kom hem från jobbet somnade jag direkt.
english: As soon as I came home from work I fell asleep immediately.

target: Inte förrän nästa vecka kan jag svara.
english: Not until next week can I answer.

target: Bara i Sverige finns denna tradition i Sverige.
english: Only in Sweden does this tradition exist in Sweden.

target: Vad vacker hon var på stationen varje morgon!
english: How beautiful she was at the station every morning!
grammar: Exclamatory word order: "Vad" + adjective + subject + verb.

target: Vilken dag det var i helgen redan!
english: What a day it was on the weekend already!

target: Så trött var han att han somnade.
english: So tired was he that he fell asleep.

target: Liten som han var kunde han ändå hjälpa.
english: Small as he was, he could still help.

target: Den boken har jag redan läst väl.
english: That book I have already read I suppose.
grammar: Object topicalization — placing the object first for emphasis.

target: De orden glömmer jag aldrig under sommaren.
english: Those words I will never forget during the summer.

target: Sådan mat gillar jag efter jobbet på helgerna.
english: Such food I like after work on weekends.

target: Det här problemet måste vi lösa redan.
english: This problem we must solve already.

target: Henne har jag aldrig träffat under veckan.
english: Her I have never met during the week.

target: Dig vill jag prata med under veckan.
english: You I want to talk to during the week.

target: Kaffe dricker jag alltid svart varje dag.
english: Coffee I always drink black every day.
grammar: Object fronting for contrast: "KAFFE dricker jag svart" (not tea).

target: Till dig har jag en present nog.
english: For you I have a present probably.

target: Om honom vet jag ingenting ibland väl.
english: About him I know nothing sometimes I suppose.

target: Mer tid hade vi behövt sedan länge.
english: More time we would have needed for a long time.

target: Annorlunda hade det inte kunnat bli redan.
english: It couldn't have been different already.

target: Där stod han och väntade väldigt ofta.
english: There he stood waiting very often.

target: Sedan dess har jag inte sett henne.
english: Since then I haven't seen her.

target: Då och då tänker jag på det.
english: Now and then I think about it.

target: Ännu idag minns jag den kvällen verkligen.
english: Even today I remember that evening really.

target: Gång på gång försökte han efter jobbet.
english: Time and again he tried after work.

target: Steg för steg lärde hon sig nog.
english: Step by step she learned probably.

target: Lite i taget blev det bättre till slut.
english: Little by little it got better in the end.

target: Allt som oftast regnar det i helgen.
english: More often than not it rains on the weekend.

target: Mig veterligen finns det inget bevis väl.
english: To my knowledge there's no evidence I suppose.
grammar: "Mig veterligen" = to my knowledge. Formal/literary.

target: Så vitt jag vet stämmer det varje dag.
english: As far as I know, it's correct every day.

target: Det anser jag vara felaktigt just nu.
english: That I consider to be incorrect right now.

target: Mitt bland alla gäster stod hon nu.
english: In the middle of all the guests she stood now.

target: Därav kan man dra slutsatsen varje dag.
english: From this one can draw the conclusion every day.

target: Härmed förklarar jag mötet avslutat nästa vecka.
english: I hereby declare the meeting closed next week.

target: Dessförinnan hade vi ätit middag ibland redan.
english: Before that we had eaten dinner sometimes already.
grammar: "Dessförinnan" = before that. Formal connector.

target: Därutöver finns det andra fördelar i helgen.
english: Beyond that there are other advantages on the weekend.

target: Icke desto mindre lyckades vi nästa vecka.
english: Nevertheless we succeeded next week.

target: Var vi än går följer naturen dit.
english: Wherever we go, nature follows there.

target: Hur svårt det än är ger jag inte upp.
english: No matter how hard it is, I won't give up.

target: Vem som än frågar, säg inget verkligen.
english: Whoever asks, say nothing really.

target: När som helst kan det hända alltid.
english: It can happen at any time always.

target: Var som helst i Sverige hittar man sjöar.
english: Anywhere in Sweden you find lakes.

target: Hur du än gör blir det fel.
english: No matter what you do, it'll be wrong.

target: Vad du än säger lyssnar hon inte.
english: Whatever you say, she doesn't listen.

target: Det vet jag inte alls nästa vecka.
english: That I don't know at all next week.

target: Inte heller jag förstår det just nu.
english: Neither do I understand it right now.
grammar: "Inte heller" = neither/nor. "Inte heller jag" = me neither.

target: Först då förstod jag förra veckan väl.
english: Only then did I understand last week I suppose.

target: Enbart genom samarbete kan vi lyckas gärna.
english: Only through cooperation can we succeed gladly.

target: Det var inte alls vad jag förväntade mig.
english: It was not at all what I expected.

target: Inte heller i Stockholm har jag bott.
english: Neither in Stockholm have I lived.

target: Det var med stor förvåning jag hörde.
english: It was with great surprise I heard.

target: Bara tillsammans klarar vi det just nu.
english: Only together can we manage it right now.

target: Med ens förstod jag allting varje morgon.
english: All at once I understood everything every morning.

target: Sent omsider kom beskedet varje dag egentligen.
english: At long last the news came every day actually.

target: Allt emellanåt tänker jag på henne idag.
english: Every now and then I think about her today.

target: Ganska ofta händer det just nu nog.
english: Quite often it happens right now probably.

target: Betydligt mer arbete krävs hela tiden väl.
english: Significantly more work is required all the time I suppose.

target: Framför allt uppskattar jag ärligheten på kvällen.
english: Above all I appreciate the honesty in the evening.

target: I grund och botten har vi samma åsikt.
english: Fundamentally we have the same opinion.

target: Lång tid har gått sedan dess nog.
english: A long time has passed since then probably.

target: Allt jag vill ha är lugn och ro.
english: All I want is peace and quiet.

target: Det enda vi kan göra är att vänta.
english: The only thing we can do is wait.

target: Kvar stod bara stolen ibland redan.
english: All that remained was the chair sometimes already.

target: Omöjligt att förstå var det väldigt ofta.
english: Impossible to understand it was very often.

target: Inte på länge har jag känt mig så bra.
english: Not in a long time have I felt this good.

target: Så bra har det aldrig varit egentligen.
english: It has never been this good actually.

target: Den mörka natten sänkte sig över landskapet.
english: The dark night descended upon the landscape.
grammar: Literary style uses more descriptive, poetic language with longer constructions.

target: Skogen stod tyst och stilla på kvällen.
english: The forest stood quiet and still in the evening.
grammar: Literary Swedish often personifies nature — the forest "stands" as if alive.

target: En blek måne lyste genom molnen alltid.
english: A pale moon shone through the clouds always.
grammar: "Lysa" = shine. "Blek" = pale. Poetic vocabulary for nature writing.

target: Dimman lade sig som ett täcke dit.
english: The fog settled like a blanket there.
grammar: Similes with "som" (like/as): "som ett täcke" = like a blanket.

target: Tystnaden var nästan öronbedövande varje dag egentligen.
english: The silence was almost deafening every day actually.
grammar: "Öronbedövande" = ear-deafening. Swedish builds vivid compounds: noun + participle.

target: Han vandrade ensam genom den töckenhöljda dalen.
english: He walked alone through the mist-shrouded valley.
grammar: "Töckenhöljd" = mist-covered. Literary compound: töcken (mist) + höljd (covered).

target: Orden fastnade som taggar i minnet på kvällen.
english: The words stuck like thorns in memory in the evening.
grammar: "Fastna" (get stuck) — a vivid verb for things that linger. "Taggar" = thorns.

target: Hennes ögon avslöjade det hon inte sa.
english: Her eyes revealed what she didn't say.
grammar: "Avslöja" = reveal/betray. Literary usage: eyes revealing hidden emotions.

target: Långsamt vaknade staden till liv väldigt ofta.
english: Slowly the city awoke to life very often.
grammar: Adverb fronting in literary style creates atmosphere and rhythm.

target: Vintermörkret svepte in som ett svart skynke.
english: The winter darkness swept in like a black curtain.
grammar: "Svepa in" = sweep in. "Skynke" = cloth/shroud — poetic word, rare in everyday speech.

target: Aldrig hade känslan av ensamhet känts så starkt.
english: Never had the feeling of loneliness felt so strong.
grammar: Fronted "aldrig" + inverted word order = literary emphasis. "Kännas" = feel (s-verb).

target: I fjärran hördes ljudet av bjällror redan.
english: In the distance the sound of bells was heard already.
grammar: "I fjärran" = in the distance (literary). "Hördes" = was heard (s-passive).

target: Det var som om tiden stod stilla.
english: It was as if time stood still.
grammar: "Som om" = as if. Creates hypothetical comparison.

target: Löven föll sakta mot den frusna marken.
english: The leaves fell slowly toward the frozen ground.
grammar: "Frusen" = frozen. Past participle of "frysa" used as adjective.

target: Han bar med sig en hemlighet som tyngde.
english: He carried with him a secret that weighed heavy.
grammar: "Bära med sig" = carry with oneself. "Tynga" = weigh down — metaphorical usage.

target: Ljuset sipprade in genom de smutsiga fönstren.
english: Light seeped in through the dirty windows.
grammar: "Sippra" = seep/trickle. Literary verbs paint vivid pictures of slow movement.

target: Deras blickar möttes över det dukade bordet.
english: Their eyes met across the set table.
grammar: "Mötas" = meet (reciprocal s-verb). "Dukat bord" = set table. Romantic imagery.

target: Minnet av sommarens dagar värmde hennes hjärta.
english: The memory of summer days warmed her heart.
grammar: "Sommarens" = summer's (genitive -s). Possessive -s works like English apostrophe-s.

target: Klockorna i kyrktornent slog tolv under sommaren.
english: The bells in the church tower struck twelve during the summer.
grammar: "Slå" → "slog" (struck). "Kyrktorn" = church tower. Literary time-marking device.

target: Snön gnisslade under hans stövlar på morgonen.
english: The snow crunched under his boots in the morning.
grammar: "Gnissla" = crunch/squeak. Onomatopoeia — Swedish has many such expressive verbs.

target: Strömmen flöt sakta genom den sovande byn.
english: The stream flowed slowly through the sleeping village.
grammar: "Sovande" = sleeping (present participle). Personification of the village.

target: Hösten hade klätt landskapet i guld väl.
english: Autumn had dressed the landscape in gold I suppose.
grammar: "Klä" = dress/clothe. "Klä i" = dress in. Metaphor for autumn colors.

target: En känsla av vemod fyllde hennes bröst.
english: A feeling of melancholy filled her chest.
grammar: "Vemod" is a uniquely Scandinavian form of bittersweet sadness.

target: Han lutade sig mot stammen av den gamla eken.
english: He leaned against the trunk of the old oak.
grammar: "Luta sig" = lean. "Stam" = trunk. "Ek" = oak (en ek, eken).

target: Tidvattnet bar med sig vrakdelar från det förflutna.
english: The tide carried with it wreckage from the past.
grammar: "Det förflutna" = the past (literary). "Vrakdelar" = wreckage (compound).

target: Skuggorna dansade i ljuset av brasan väl.
english: The shadows danced in the light of the fire I suppose.

target: Det var en tid som aldrig skulle återvända.
english: It was a time that would never return.

target: Hennes röst bar spår av smärta redan.
english: Her voice carried traces of pain already.

target: Vinden viskade hemligheter genom björkarna ibland idag.
english: The wind whispered secrets through the birches sometimes today.

target: Den förbipasserande skogsduvan kutade genom dimman verkligen.
english: The passing wood pigeon cooed through the fog really.

target: Åren gick, men minnena bestod efter jobbet.
english: The years passed, but the memories endured after work.
grammar: "Bestå" = endure/persist. Literary vocabulary for permanence.

target: I mörkret sken stjärnorna som diamanter redan.
english: In the darkness the stars shone like diamonds already.

target: Han begrundade sitt öde under de tysta stjärnorna.
english: He pondered his fate beneath the silent stars.

target: Morgondaggen glittrade på grässtråna nästa vecka nu.
english: The morning dew glistened on the blades of grass next week now.

target: En ensam fågel sjöng sin sista visa.
english: A solitary bird sang its last song.
grammar: "Visa" = song (poetic). "Sång" is the everyday word.

target: Skymningen bredde ut sig som en mjuk filt.
english: Twilight spread out like a soft blanket.

target: Havets röst var en ständig följeslagare varje dag.
english: The voice of the sea was a constant companion every day.

target: Bergstoppen stod klar mot den blånande himlen.
english: The mountain peak stood clear against the blue sky.

target: Doften av nyslaget hö fyllde luften för alla.
english: The scent of freshly cut hay filled the air for everyone.

target: En väg, knappt synlig, ledde in bland träden.
english: A road, barely visible, led in among the trees.

target: Huset hade stått tomt sedan lång tid tillbaka.
english: The house had stood empty for a long time.

target: Skeppet gled tyst genom den spegelblanka fjorden.
english: The ship glided silently through the mirror-smooth fjord.

target: Den gamla mannens ögon berättade mer än ord.
english: The old man's eyes told more than words.

target: Sommarnattens ljus vägrade ge vika för mörkret.
english: The summer night's light refused to yield to darkness.

target: Inunder den lugna ytan doldes en storm.
english: Beneath the calm surface a storm was hidden.

target: Varje steg på den knarrande trappan ljöd.
english: Every step on the creaking staircase sounded.

target: I det avlägsna förflutna hade allt varit annorlunda.
english: In the distant past everything had been different.

target: Den tomma stolen vid bordet talade sitt tysta språk.
english: The empty chair at the table spoke its silent language.

target: Natten svalde de sista resterna av dagsljuset.
english: The night swallowed the last remnants of daylight.

target: Strandkanten kantades av frusna vågkammar väldigt ofta.
english: The shoreline was bordered by frozen wave crests very often.

target: Hästar betade fridfullt på ängen varje dag.
english: Horses grazed peacefully in the meadow every day.

target: Det gamla hjulet knarrade i vinden på helgerna.
english: The old wheel creaked in the wind on weekends.

target: Solnedgången målade himlen i alla nyanser av rött.
english: The sunset painted the sky in all shades of red.

target: Horisonten sträckte sig oändligt framför dem på morgonen.
english: The horizon stretched endlessly before them in the morning.

target: Isen knagrade under deras fötter under veckan.
english: The ice crackled under their feet during the week.

target: Fjällen reste sig majestätiskt mot skyarna förra året.
english: The mountains rose majestically toward the skies last year.

target: En dimslöja drog över sjön nästa vecka.
english: A veil of mist drifted across the lake next week.

target: Sorgen hade etsats in i hans anletsdrag.
english: Grief had been etched into his features.

target: Varje dröm bär fröet till sin egen fullbordan.
english: Every dream carries the seed of its own fulfillment.

target: Tidvattnets outtröttliga gång fortsatte på morgonen nästa år.
english: The tireless progress of the tide continued in the morning next year.

target: Skogens djup dolde hemligheter bortom fattning med familjen.
english: The depths of the forest hid secrets beyond comprehension with the family.

target: Med ens steg en gestalt fram ur skuggorna.
english: Suddenly a figure stepped out from the shadows.

target: Skönheten i det förgängliga fångade hans blick.
english: The beauty in the transient caught his eye.

target: Lövträden susade i aftonbrisen varje dag redan.
english: The deciduous trees rustled in the evening breeze every day already.

target: Deras öde var beseglat av det sagda.
english: Their fate was sealed by what was said.

target: Ljusets dans på vattenytan skapade rörliga mönster.
english: The dance of light on the water surface created moving patterns.

target: Den stormiga havsytan speglade hans inre oro.
english: The stormy sea surface mirrored his inner unrest.

target: Snöflingorna virvlade som dansande andar i helgen.
english: The snowflakes swirled like dancing spirits on the weekend.

target: I nattens stillhet hördes bara ugglans rop.
english: In the stillness of night, only the owl's call was heard.

target: Den urgamla sagan har berättats i generationer.
english: The ancient tale has been told for generations.

target: Enslingen hade valt skogens ensamhet varje dag.
english: The recluse had chosen the forest's solitude every day.

target: Våren anlände med löftets doft hela tiden.
english: Spring arrived with the scent of promise all the time.

target: I gryningens ljus tedde sig allt annorlunda.
english: In the light of dawn, everything appeared different.

target: Tystnaden efter stormen var nästan hörbar redan.
english: The silence after the storm was almost audible already.

target: Minnenas river rinner aldrig torr på kvällen.
english: The river of memories never runs dry in the evening.

target: Det bleka ljuset kastade långa skuggor till slut.
english: The pale light cast long shadows in the end.

target: Tidens tand hade nött på de gamla murarna.
