target: Alfred Nobel instiftade Nobelpriset nästa vecka här.
english: Alfred Nobel established the Nobel Prize next week here.

target: Gruvstaden Kiruna ska flyttas i helgen nog.
english: The mining town of Kiruna is being moved on the weekend probably.
grammar: Kiruna is literally being relocated because mining has destabilized the ground.

target: Gotland är en populär semesterö under sommaren.
english: Gotland is a popular vacation island during the summer.

target: Visby har en välbevarad medeltidsstad nästa vecka.
english: Visby has a well-preserved medieval town next week.

target: Lund är en av Sveriges äldsta universitetsstäder.
english: Lund is one of Sweden's oldest university cities.

target: Ishotellet i Jukkasjärvi byggs varje vinter nog.
english: The Ice Hotel in Jukkasjärvi is built every winter probably.

target: Kungsleden sträcker sig genom Lappland förra veckan.
english: The King's Trail stretches through Lapland last week.

target: Samer är urbefolkningen i norra Skandinavien alltid.
english: The Sami are the indigenous people of northern Scandinavia always.

target: Samisk kultur innefattar renskötsel och jojk gärna.
english: Sami culture includes reindeer herding and joik gladly.
grammar: Joik is a traditional Sami form of singing — deeply spiritual and cultural.

target: Ombudsman är ett svenskt ord som spridits.
english: Ombudsman is a Swedish word that has spread.
grammar: One of few Swedish words used internationally.

target: Den svenska modellen kombinerar marknad och välfärd.
english: The Swedish model combines market and welfare.

target: Fackförbund har stort inflytande i Sverige redan.
english: Labor unions have great influence in Sweden already.

target: Fikapausen är lagstadgad i arbetslivet under veckan.
english: The fika break is established in working life during the week.

target: Semesterlagen ger rätt till fem veckors semester.
english: The vacation law gives the right to five weeks' vacation.
grammar: By law, Swedish workers get 25 vacation days per year.

target: Barnkonventionen är svensk lag sedan 2020 nog.
english: The Convention on the Rights of the Child is Swedish law since 2020 probably.

target: Könsneutrala pronomen som hen används allt mer.
english: Gender-neutral pronouns like hen are increasingly used.
grammar: "Hen" was added to the Swedish dictionary in 2015.

target: Pappamånaden uppmuntrar pappor att vara hemma egentligen.
english: The daddy month encourages fathers to stay home actually.

target: Öppen förskola är gratis för alla redan.
english: Open preschool is free for everyone already.

target: BVC följer barnens utveckling i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: Child health centers follow children's development in the library every morning.
grammar: BVC (Barnavårdscentralen) provides free healthcare for all children.

target: SFI erbjuder gratis svenska för invandrare nästa år.
english: SFI offers free Swedish for immigrants next year.
grammar: Swedish for Immigrants — a comprehensive integration program.

target: Allemansrätten förbjuder nedskräpning i parken ibland för alla.
english: Freedom to roam prohibits littering in the park sometimes for everyone.

target: Naturreservaten skyddar unik natur i köket varje morgon.
english: Nature reserves protect unique nature in the kitchen every morning.

target: Vattenfall och andra myndigheter är statligt ägda.
english: Vattenfall and other agencies are state-owned.

target: Tidigt café-besök till julmarknaden under sommaren med familjen.
english: An early café visit to the Christmas market during the summer with the family.

target: Luciatåget i kyrkan rör många till tårar.
english: The Lucia procession in church moves many to tears.

target: Advent firas med ljusstakar i fönstren i skolan.
english: Advent is celebrated with candle holders in the windows at school.
grammar: Triangle-shaped electric candelabras (adventsljusstake) in every window — a winter tradition.

target: Nyårsfirandet inkluderar dikten Nyårsklockan under sommaren alltid.
english: New Year's celebration includes the poem Nyårsklockan during the summer always.
grammar: Tennyson's "Ring Out, Wild Bells" is read on Swedish TV every New Year's Eve.

target: Första maj firas med demonstrationer varje morgon.
english: May Day is celebrated with demonstrations every morning.

target: Nationaldagen firas den sjätte juni hela tiden.
english: National Day is celebrated on June 6th all the time.

target: Kanelbullens dag firas den fjärde oktober väl.
english: Cinnamon Bun Day is celebrated on October 4th I suppose.
grammar: Sweden has an official day for its beloved cinnamon bun.

target: Surströmmingspremiären sker i augusti på morgonen väl.
english: The surströmming premiere is in August in the morning I suppose.

target: Kåldolmar har blivit svensk husmanskost väldigt ofta.
english: Cabbage rolls have become Swedish home cooking very often.
grammar: Originally Turkish, brought to Sweden by Karl XII — now a classic Swedish dish.

target: Tunnbrödsrulle med varmkorv är en gatuklassiker väl.
english: A flatbread wrap with hot dog is a street classic I suppose.

target: Lördagsgodis är en tradition för barn redan.
english: Saturday candy is a tradition for children already.
grammar: Lördagsgodis: children only get candy on Saturdays — a dental health tradition.

target: Påskris dekoreras med fjädrar på kvällen efter jobbet.
english: Easter branches are decorated with feathers in the evening after work.

target: Påskkärringar går dörr till dörr hela tiden.
english: Easter witches go door to door all the time.
grammar: Swedish children dress as Easter witches and collect candy — like Halloween.

target: Vasaloppet är världens äldsta skidlopp ibland redan.
english: Vasaloppet is the world's oldest cross-country ski race sometimes already.

target: Melodifestivalen väljer Sveriges bidrag till Eurovision på morgonen.
english: Melodifestivalen selects Sweden's entry for Eurovision in the morning.
grammar: Melodifestivalen is one of the most-watched TV shows in Sweden.

target: Allemansrätten tillåter övernattning i naturen nästa vecka.
english: Freedom to roam allows overnight stays in nature next week.

target: Att inte störa och inte förstöra är grundprincipen.
english: Not to disturb and not to destroy is the basic principle.
grammar: The core rule of allemansrätten: don't disturb, don't destroy.

target: Kollektivavtal reglerar arbetsvillkoren förra veckan också.
english: Collective agreements regulate working conditions last week too.

target: Småprat är inte lika vanligt som i andra länder.
english: Small talk is not as common as in other countries.
grammar: Swedes are known for being reserved with strangers.

target: Svenskar respekterar personligt utrymme efter jobbet väl.
english: Swedes respect personal space after work I suppose.

target: Kösystemet är heligt under veckan alltid.
english: The queuing system is sacred during the week always.
grammar: Take a number, wait your turn — cutting in line is a serious social offense.

target: Nummerlapparna vid kassan följs strikt sedan länge.
english: Queue tickets at the counter are strictly followed for a long time.

target: Lagom beskriver den svenska mentaliteten i helgen.
english: Lagom describes the Swedish mentality on the weekend.

target: Förhandlingssamhället bygger på samförstånd på morgonen med vänner.
english: The negotiation society is built on consensus in the morning with friends.
grammar: Swedish society relies on consensus-building rather than confrontation.

target: Öppenheten kring föräldraledighet är stor varje dag.
english: The openness around parental leave is great every day.

target: Djurskyddslagen i Sverige är bland de strängaste.
english: Animal protection laws in Sweden are among the strictest.

target: Konflikträdslan är ett svenskt kulturellt drag redan.
english: Conflict avoidance is a Swedish cultural trait already.

target: Att vara lagom social är en konst.
english: Being moderately social is an art.

target: Återvinningsstationen är en del av vardagen väl.
english: The recycling station is part of everyday life I suppose.

target: Det jämställda hemmet är ett ideal väl.
english: The egalitarian home is an ideal I suppose.

target: Naturen betraktas som en rättighet, inte ett privilegium.
english: Nature is considered a right, not a privilege.

target: Hade jag vetat det då hade jag handlat annorlunda.
english: Had I known that then I would have acted differently.
grammar: Conditional perfect without "om": "Hade jag vetat" = If I had known.

target: Det lär dröja innan vi ser resultat.
english: It's likely to be a while before we see results.
grammar: "Lär" + infinitive = is likely to / will probably.

target: Inte nog med att det regnade, det blåste också.
english: Not only did it rain, it was also windy.
grammar: "Inte nog med att" = not only ... (emphatic pattern).

target: Ju förr desto bättre under sommaren i Sverige.
english: The sooner the better during the summer in Sweden.
grammar: "Ju ... desto" is the standard comparative correlation pattern in Swedish.

target: Vare sig han vill eller inte måste han komma.
english: Whether he wants to or not he must come.
grammar: "Vare sig ... eller" = whether ... or.

target: Desto mer jag tänker, desto mer förvirrad blir jag.
english: The more I think, the more confused I get.

target: Det var precis som om tiden hade stått helt stilla.
english: It was exactly as if time had stood completely still.
grammar: "Som om" = as if. Takes subordinate clause word order.

target: Man vet aldrig vad som kan hända.
english: You never know what might happen.
grammar: "Vad som" is needed when "what" is the subject: "vad som hände" vs "vad du sa."

target: Hur man än vänder och vrider på det.
english: No matter how you look at it.

target: Det oaktat fortskred arbetet just nu också.
english: Notwithstanding, the work continued right now too.
grammar: "Det oaktat" = notwithstanding. Highly formal written Swedish.

target: Givetvis ställer vi upp för varandra egentligen.
english: Of course we support each other actually.

target: I den mån det är möjligt hjälper vi till.
english: To the extent possible we help out.

target: Oavsett utfall är jag nöjd förra veckan.
english: Regardless of the outcome I'm satisfied last week.
grammar: "Oavsett" = regardless of. Takes noun or subordinate clause.

target: Han lät som om han menade allvar.
english: He sounded as if he was serious.

target: Det återstår att se just nu dit.
english: It remains to be seen right now there.
grammar: "Återstå" = remain. Very common phrase meaning the outcome is uncertain.

target: Därav följer att vi bör agera nu.
english: It therefore follows that we should act now.

target: Vi gör det frivilligt, inte för att vi måste.
english: We do it voluntarily, not because we have to.

target: Inte för att jag klagar, men det kunde vara bättre.
english: Not that I'm complaining, but it could be better.

target: Lika lite som jag förstod det första gången.
english: As little as I understood the first time.

target: Allt sedan dess har vi hållit kontakten.
english: Ever since then we have kept in touch.

target: Det finns dem som anser motsatsen här.
english: There are those who consider the opposite here.

target: Med all respekt, jag håller inte med.
english: With all respect, I disagree.

target: Saken lär inte vara avgjord ännu egentligen.
english: The matter is probably not decided yet actually.

target: Tids nog kommer sanningen fram under veckan.
english: In due time the truth will come out during the week.

target: Det går inte att bortse från problemen.
english: It's not possible to disregard the problems.

target: Så mycket mer borde vi uppskatta det.
english: All the more should we appreciate it.

target: I sista hand får vi acceptera resultatet.
english: As a last resort we must accept the result.

target: Inte desto mindre fortsätter vi varje morgon.
english: Nevertheless we continue every morning.

target: Såtillvida har han rätt hemma hos oss varje morgon.
english: To that extent he is right at our home every morning.

target: Det är ingalunda säkert varje dag nog.
english: It is by no means certain every day probably.
grammar: "Ingalunda" = by no means. Formal/literary.

target: Förvisso har hon en poäng under sommaren.
english: To be sure she has a point during the summer.

target: Skenbart var allt i sin ordning egentligen.
english: Apparently everything was in order actually.

target: Uppenbarligen hade det missförståtts sedan länge redan.
english: Obviously it had been misunderstood for a long time already.

target: Det är tveksamt huruvida det fungerar redan.
english: It's doubtful whether it works already.

target: Tillika var han en skicklig musiker redan.
english: He was also a skilled musician already.
grammar: "Tillika" = also/likewise. Formal.

target: Det låter sig inte göras just nu.
english: It cannot be done right now.
grammar: "Låta sig göras" = be doable/feasible. Very Swedish idiomatic construction.

target: Det tål att tänka på varje dag.
english: It's worth thinking about every day.
grammar: "Tåla att" = be worth doing / can withstand.

target: Lika fullt måste vi försöka under sommaren.
english: Nevertheless we must try during the summer.

target: De fick sig en rejäl överraskning till slut.
english: They got quite a surprise in the end.
grammar: "Få sig" + noun = get/receive (colloquial intensifier).

target: Det går inte att komma ifrån att.
english: There's no getting around the fact that.
grammar: "Komma ifrån" = get away from. Idiom: there's no denying that.

target: Vi har all anledning att vara försiktiga.
english: We have every reason to be careful.

target: Det ena ger det andra ibland på jobbet.
english: One thing leads to another sometimes at work.

target: Härifrån kan det bara bli bättre också.
english: From here it can only get better too.

target: Tvärtom anser jag att det är positivt.
english: On the contrary, I consider it positive.

target: Det förhåller sig nämligen så att hemma.
english: The thing is namely that at home.
grammar: "Det förhåller sig så att" = the fact of the matter is that.

target: Som det ser ut just nu egentligen.
english: As things stand right now actually.

target: I grund och botten handlar det om tillit.
english: Fundamentally it's about trust.

target: Sammantaget har det gått bra hela tiden.
english: All things considered it has gone well all the time.

target: Vi får inte underskatta svårigheterna ibland nästa år.
english: We must not underestimate the difficulties sometimes next year.

target: Det gäller att vara på sin vakt.
english: It's important to be on one's guard.

target: Saken har en annan sida också redan.
english: The matter has another side too already.

target: Allt som allt är jag nöjd nog.
english: All in all I'm satisfied probably.
grammar: "Allt som allt" = all in all. Very common summary expression.

target: Det finns skäl att anta det i Sverige.
english: There are reasons to assume so in Sweden.

target: Vi bör inte förhasta oss ibland nog.
english: We should not rush sometimes probably.

target: Det ankommer på oss att agera snart.
english: It falls to us to act soon.
grammar: "Det ankommer på" = it is incumbent upon. Very formal.

target: Med facit i hand hade vi rätt.
english: In hindsight we were right.
grammar: "Med facit i hand" = with the answer key in hand — in hindsight.

target: Det kan inte uteslutas just nu också.
english: It cannot be excluded right now too.

target: Med viss reservation kan vi godta det.
english: With some reservation we can accept it.

target: I klarspråk betyder det att vi förlorade.
english: In plain language it means we lost.

target: Vi har att förhålla oss till verkligheten.
english: We have to relate to reality.

target: Allt väl övervägt tar vi risken gärna.
english: All things considered we take the risk gladly.

target: Det låg i sakens natur på morgonen.
english: It was in the nature of things in the morning.

target: Det var inte utan att jag blev förvånad.
english: I was not a little surprised.
grammar: "Inte utan att" = not without (litotes) — understated way to say "quite."

target: Vi ska inte göra oss bättre än vi är.
english: We shouldn't pretend to be better than we are.

target: Så pass duktiga borde vi vara just nu.
english: That skilled we should be right now.

target: Det finns fog för oron just nu.
english: There are grounds for concern right now.
grammar: "Fog" = grounds/justification. Formal.

target: Med god vilja löser vi det här.
english: With good will we'll solve this.

target: I och för sig har du rätt.
english: In and of itself you're right.
grammar: "I och för sig" = in itself / admittedly — very common hedging phrase.

target: Så att säga har vi nått halvvägs.
english: So to speak we've reached halfway.

target: Det torde framgå av det sagda hemma.
english: It should be evident from what has been said at home.

target: Vi bör ha i åtanke att nog.
english: We should bear in mind that probably.

target: Ytterst handlar det om respekt varje morgon.
english: Ultimately it's about respect every morning.

target: Mig veterligen finns det inga undantag väl.
english: To my knowledge there are no exceptions I suppose.

target: Vi sitter alla i samma båt varje dag.
english: We're all in the same boat every day.

target: Ändamålet helgar inte medlen i helgen i Sverige.
english: The end doesn't justify the means on the weekend in Sweden.

target: Det är en avvägningsfråga väldigt ofta redan.
english: It's a matter of balance very often already.

target: Vi har långt kvar men vi är på rätt väg.
english: We have far to go but we're on the right track.

target: Förr eller senare kommer sanningen fram snart.
english: Sooner or later the truth comes out soon.

target: Det var på håret att vi missade tåget.
english: We almost missed the train.
grammar: "På håret" = by a hair — just barely.

target: Det vore önskvärt men inte nödvändigt nog.
english: It would be desirable but not necessary probably.

target: Med den kunskapen i ryggen kan vi gå vidare.
english: With that knowledge behind us we can move forward.

target: Det borde vara en självklarhet under veckan.
english: It should go without saying during the week.

target: Vi tar inte för givet att allt löser sig.
english: We don't take for granted that everything will work out.

target: Det ligger i var och ens intresse.
english: It is in everyone's interest.

target: Vi måste se bortom det uppenbara i Sverige.
english: We must look beyond the obvious in Sweden.

target: Rimligtvis borde vi ha fått besked vid det här laget.
english: Reasonably we should have gotten word by now.

target: Det förvånar mig inte det minsta ibland.
english: It doesn't surprise me in the least sometimes.

target: I det långa loppet kommer det att löna sig.
english: In the long run it will pay off.

target: Vi gör klokt i att vara ödmjuka.
english: We do well to be humble.

target: Det var nära ögat just nu nog.
english: It was a close call right now probably.
grammar: "Nära ögat" = close call. Literally "near the eye."

target: Det är en annan femma efter jobbet.
english: That's a different matter entirely after work.
grammar: "En annan femma" = a different five (coin) — a whole different story.

target: Ingen rök utan eld nästa vecka efter jobbet.
english: No smoke without fire next week after work.

target: Stilla vatten har djup botten sedan länge.
english: Still waters run deep for a long time.

target: Det som inte dödar härdar under sommaren.
english: What doesn't kill you makes you stronger during the summer.

target: Den som väntar på något gott väntar aldrig för länge.
english: Good things come to those who wait.
grammar: Sweden's beloved proverb — patience pays off.

target: Mycket väsen för ingenting i helgen på jobbet.
english: Much ado about nothing on the weekend at work.

target: Övning ger färdighet sedan länge väl.
english: Practice makes perfect for a long time I suppose.
grammar: The Swedish version of "practice makes perfect" — used constantly.

target: Det finns inget dåligt väder, bara dåliga kläder.
english: There's no bad weather, only bad clothes.
grammar: The quintessential Swedish philosophy about outdoor life.

target: Den som lever får se hela tiden.
english: He who lives will see all the time.

target: Vi korsar den bron när vi kommer till den.
english: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.

target: Kort och gott, det fungerade just nu.
english: In short, it worked right now.

target: Med lite tur klarar vi det på jobbet.
english: With a little luck we'll manage it at work.

target: Det var det hela hela tiden redan.
english: That was all all the time already.

target: Och där hade vi det sedan länge.
english: And there we had it for a long time.

target: Med de orden avslutar jag varje morgon.
english: With those words I conclude every morning.

target: Det resterande får framtiden utvisa under veckan.
english: The rest will be shown by the future during the week.

target: Vi stannar vid att det löste sig.
english: We'll leave it at: it worked out.

target: Härmed avslutas vår berättelse efter jobbet nog.
english: Hereby our story concludes after work probably.

target: Allt har sin tid, och allt har sin plats.
english: Everything has its time, and everything has its place.

target: Han levererar post i vårt område sex dagar i veckan.
english: He delivers mail in our area six days a week.
grammar: "Tvätta" is a Group 1 verb: tvätta → tvättar (present) → tvättade (past) → tvättat (supine).

target: Jag försöker äta mer grönsaker och mindre kött numera.
english: I try to eat more vegetables and less meat now.
grammar: "Skratta" follows Group 1: skrattar, skrattade, skrattat. All Group 1 verbs follow -ar/-ade/-at.

target: Vi sjunger julvisor i december efter jobbet.
english: We sing Christmas carols in December after work.
grammar: "Sjunga" is strong/irregular: sjunger, sjöng, sjungit. Vowel changes are unpredictable.

target: Hon älskar att läsa deckare och har väldigt många böcker.
english: She loves to read detective novels and has very many books.
grammar: "Springa" is strong: springer, sprang, sprungit. The vowel pattern i-a-u is common.

target: De äter köttbullar till lunch nästa vecka.
english: They eat meatballs for lunch next week.
grammar: "Äta" is strong: äter, åt, ätit. Many food-related verbs are irregular.

target: Klockan är fem i halv tre väl.
english: It is twenty-five past two I suppose.
grammar: "Fem i halv tre" = five to half-three = 2:25. Swedish time can be confusing!

target: Alla helgdagar infaller på fasta datum ute.
english: All holidays fall on fixed dates outside.

target: Jag räknar till hundra hela tiden under sommaren.
english: I count to a hundred all the time during summer.

target: Varje kvartal har tre månader under veckan.
english: Each quarter has three months during the week.

target: Jag tar en portion pytt i panna.
english: I'll have a portion of hash.
grammar: Pytt i panna is a classic Swedish dish — diced potatoes, meat, and onions fried together.

target: Kan jag få en doggy bag också?
english: Can I get a doggy bag too?
grammar: Taking leftovers home is becoming more accepted in Swedish restaurants.

target: Vi beställer in mat via en app.
english: We order food through an app.

target: Den svenska osten är berrömd sedan länge.
english: Swedish cheese is famous for a long time.

target: Vi dricker lättöl till maten ibland på morgonen.
english: We drink light beer with the food sometimes in the morning.
grammar: "Lättöl" (light beer under 2.25%) can be sold in supermarkets, unlike stronger beers.

target: Tunnbrödsrullen är en gatumatfavorit i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: The flatbread roll is a street food favorite in the library every morning.

target: Vi grillar korv vid lägerelden varje morgon.
english: We grill sausages by the campfire every morning.

target: Dillsåsen serveras till fisken efter jobbet just nu.
english: Dill sauce is served with the fish after work right now.
grammar: Dill is perhaps the most important herb in Swedish cooking.

target: En skärbräda med charkuterier på morgonen nog.
english: A cutting board with charcuterie in the morning probably.

target: Varmrätten är grillad lax på kvällen egentligen.
english: The hot dish is grilled salmon in the evening actually.

target: Vi njöt av varje stund väldigt ofta.
english: We enjoyed every moment very often.
grammar: "Njuta" → "njöt" in preteritum. Strong verb with vowel change.

target: Hon frös om fötterna just nu på jobbet.
english: Her feet were cold right now at work.

target: De slog sig ner vid bordet i Sverige.
english: They sat down at the table in Sweden.

target: Jag band fast cykeln ibland nog.
english: I locked up the bicycle sometimes probably.

target: Vi drog oss tillbaka tidigt nästa vecka.
english: We withdrew early next week.
grammar: "Dra" → "drog" in past tense. Very common strong verb.

target: Hon grät när hon hörde nyheten redan.
english: She cried when she heard the news already.

target: Jag bör plugga mer ibland nog.
english: I ought to study more sometimes probably.
grammar: "Bör" = ought to / should. Slightly softer obligation than "borde."

target: Man kan inte vara på två ställen samtidigt.
english: You can't be in two places at once.

target: Vi måste passa tåget under sommaren nu.
english: We must catch the train during the summer now.

target: Hon vill gärna stanna nästa vecka alltid.
english: She would gladly like to stay next week always.
grammar: "Gärna" with "vill" adds willingness: "would be happy to."

target: De ska besöka oss till helgen snart.
english: They're going to visit us this weekend soon.

target: Jag tvättar mig och klär på mig.
english: I wash up and get dressed.
grammar: Two reflexives in one sentence — each needs its own "mig."

target: Hon sminkar sig innan jobbet på morgonen.
english: She puts on makeup before work in the morning.

target: Vi rastar hunden tre gånger om dagen.
english: We walk the dog three times a day.

target: Han torkar sig med en handduk dit.
english: He dries himself with a towel there.

target: Jag gör min morgonrutin sedan länge väl.
english: I do my morning routine for a long time I suppose.

target: Hon förbereder sig mentalt just nu i skolan.
english: She prepares herself mentally right now at school.

target: Vi kopplar av med en bok efter jobbet.
english: We relax with a book after work.

target: Han byter om efter träningen väldigt ofta.
english: He changes after the workout very often.
grammar: "Byta om" = change clothes. A particle verb used daily.

target: Jag köper aldrig onödiga saker varje dag.
english: I never buy unnecessary things every day.
grammar: "Aldrig" follows the same placement as "inte" — after the verb in main clauses.

target: Hon har inte alls tid varje dag.
english: She has no time at all every day.
grammar: "Inte alls" = not at all — a common intensifier for negation.

target: Vi behöver ingenting nästa vecka idag.
english: We need nothing next week today.

target: Han röker inte längre ibland på jobbet.
english: He doesn't smoke anymore sometimes at work.
grammar: "Inte längre" = not anymore / no longer.

target: De har varken bil eller cykel väl.
english: They have neither a car nor a bicycle I suppose.

target: Jag har knappast sovit just nu redan.
english: I have hardly slept right now already.
grammar: "Knappast" = hardly / barely — a softer negation.

target: Vi fick inte ett enda svar egentligen.
english: We didn't get a single answer actually.

target: Hon sa ingenting om det under veckan.
english: She said nothing about it during the week.

target: Jag vill inte heller gå varje dag.
english: I don't want to go either every day.
grammar: "Inte heller" = not either / neither. "Inte heller jag" = me neither.

target: Vi har sällan tid att vila nog.
english: We rarely have time to rest probably.
grammar: "Sällan" = seldom/rarely. Placed like "inte" in main clauses.

target: Han har ingenstans att bo förra veckan.
english: He has nowhere to live last week.

target: Jag har nästan aldrig varit sjuk redan.
english: I have almost never been sick already.

target: De kom inte ens i tid till slut.
english: They didn't even come on time in the end.
grammar: "Inte ens" = not even — adds emphasis to the negation.

target: Vi jobbar på samma kontor sedan länge.
english: We work at the same office for a long time.
grammar: "På" for workplaces and offices is standard: "jobba på kontoret."

target: Jag bor i utkanten av staden just nu.
english: I live on the outskirts of the city right now.

target: Hon väntar vid busshållplatsen varje dag egentligen.
english: She waits at the bus stop every day actually.
grammar: "Vid" for stops, stations, and gathering points: "vid hållplatsen."

target: Vi åker genom tunneln nästa vecka dit.
english: We drive through the tunnel next week there.

target: Han går över gatan just nu dit.
english: He crosses the street right now there.
grammar: "Över" = over/across. "Gå över gatan" = cross the street.

target: Vi bor intill skolan i helgen i Sverige.
english: We live right next to the school on the weekend in Sweden.

target: Jag tittar ut över havet i helgen.
english: I look out over the sea on the weekend.

target: Hon springer mot mål varje dag redan.
english: She runs towards the goal every day already.

target: Vi samlas utanför biografen just nu gärna.
english: We gather outside the cinema right now gladly.

target: Han gömmer sig under sängen varje dag.
english: He hides under the bed every day.

target: Vi sitter mitt emot varandra väldigt ofta.
english: We sit opposite each other very often.

target: Jag klättrar uppåt nästa vecka på morgonen.
english: I climb upward next week in the morning.
grammar: "Uppåt" = upward. "Nedåt" = downward. Direction adverbs.

target: Hon rör sig framåt förra veckan alltid.
english: She moves forward last week always.

target: Det är det bästa jag har smakat.
english: It's the best I've tasted.
grammar: "Bra" → "bättre" → "bäst" — completely irregular superlative.

target: Han är den äldste i familjen nog.
english: He is the oldest in the family probably.
grammar: "Gammal" → "äldre" → "äldst" — irregular. "-e" ending for male definite.

target: Det var mycket varmare igår ibland egentligen.
english: It was much warmer yesterday sometimes actually.
grammar: "Mycket" can intensify comparatives: "mycket bättre," "mycket vackrare."

target: Det är mindre komplicerat än du tror.
english: It's less complicated than you think.
grammar: "Mindre" = less. "Mindre komplicerat" = less complicated.

target: Det mest intressanta är resultatet hela tiden.
english: The most interesting thing is the result all the time.
grammar: Long adjectives: "mest intressant," "mest fascinerande."

target: Ju längre norrut, desto kallare väldigt ofta.
english: The further north, the colder very often.

target: Jag har alltid älskat svensk natur nu.
english: I have always loved Swedish nature now.
grammar: "Älska" → "älskat" (Group 1 supine: -at). Time adverbs go between har and supine.

target: Hon har nyligen kommit tillbaka varje morgon.
english: She has recently come back every morning.
grammar: "Nyligen" = recently. Goes between "har" and the supine.

target: Vi har äntligen nått toppen ibland redan.
english: We have finally reached the top sometimes already.

target: De har helt förändrat planen varje morgon.
english: They have completely changed the plan every morning.

target: Jag har länge velat besöka Gotland nog.
english: I have long wanted to visit Gotland probably.

target: Hon har snart fyllt tjugo just nu.
english: She has soon turned twenty right now.

target: Vi har knappt hunnit äta just nu.
english: We have barely had time to eat right now.

target: Han har ofta besökt oss efter jobbet.
english: He has often visited us after work.

target: Jag behöver byta tåg hemma hos oss varje morgon.
english: I need to change trains at our home every morning.

target: Var är infarten till motorvägen sedan länge?
english: Where is the highway entrance for a long time?

target: Vi kör österut mot Gotland nästa vecka.
english: We drive east towards Gotland next week.
grammar: Compass directions: "norrut" (north), "söderut" (south), "österut" (east), "västerut" (west).

target: Biltrafiken är tät i rusningstid varje morgon.
english: Car traffic is heavy during rush hour every morning.

target: Cykelfältet är markerat på gatan på morgonen.
english: The bike lane is marked on the street in the morning.

target: Vi väntar vid vändplatsen hela tiden gärna.
english: We wait at the turning point all the time gladly.

target: Tåget passerar genom Sörmland förra veckan väl.
english: The train passes through Sörmland last week I suppose.

target: Vi har kommit till fel perrong till slut.
english: We've come to the wrong platform in the end.

target: Spåret har stängts av varje dag nog.
english: The track has been closed every day probably.

target: Vi tar omvägen runt sjön på kvällen.
english: We take the detour around the lake in the evening.

target: Jag tror att det kommer att gå bra.
english: I think it will go well.
grammar: "Att" clauses use BISATS word order: subject + inte/aldrig + verb.

target: Han sa att han inte hade hunnit.
english: He said he hadn't had time.
grammar: In subordinate clause: "att han INTE hade hunnit" — inte before verb.

target: Om jag hade vetat hade jag kommit.
english: If I had known I would have come.
grammar: Past conditional: "Om jag hade vetat" = if I had known.

target: Medan det regnade satt vi inne med familjen.
english: While it rained we sat inside with the family.

target: Så länge vi har varandra klarar vi det.
english: As long as we have each other we'll manage.

target: Ända sedan vi träffades har vi varit vänner.
english: Ever since we met we have been friends.

target: Även om det var dyrt köpte vi det.
english: Even though it was expensive we bought it.
grammar: "Även om" = even if/though. Triggers subordinate word order in the if-clause.

target: Det var bättre än vad jag hade trott.
english: It was better than what I had thought.

target: Hon lovade att hon aldrig skulle glömma.
english: She promised she would never forget.
grammar: In att-clause: "att hon ALDRIG skulle" — aldrig goes before the verb.

target: Vi antog att det inte spelade någon roll.
english: We assumed it didn't matter.

target: Eftersom det var helg var affären stängd.
english: Since it was a weekend the store was closed.

target: Trots att vi var trötta gick vi vidare.
english: Although we were tired we kept going.

target: Jag undrar när tåget kommer efter jobbet.
english: I wonder when the train comes after work.

target: Hon vet inte vad hon ska göra.
english: She doesn't know what she should do.

target: Vi diskuterade hur vi borde agera nog.
english: We discussed how we should act probably.

target: Han berättade vem som hade kommit redan.
english: He told who had come already.

target: Det beror på om vi har tid.
english: It depends on whether we have time.

target: Frågan var varför de inte hade kommit.
english: The question was why they hadn't come.

target: Den nya lägenheten är stor i helgen.
english: The new apartment is big on the weekend.
grammar: Double definite: "Den nya lägenheten" — article + adjective-a + noun-definite.

target: Det fina vädret lockade oss ut på kvällen.
english: The nice weather lured us outside in the evening.

target: De gamla husen i Gamla Stan med vänner.
english: The old houses in the Old Town with friends.

target: Den kalla vintern 2025 under veckan gärna.
english: The cold winter of 2025 during the week gladly.

target: Det goda kaffet på morgonen under sommaren.
english: The good coffee in the morning during the summer.
grammar: "God" → "goda" in definite: "det goda kaffet."

target: De små barnens skratt på morgonen till slut.
english: The small children's laughter in the morning in the end.
grammar: "Liten" → "små" (plural) → "de små barnen." Highly irregular.

target: Den unga kvinnans leende varje dag egentligen.
english: The young woman's smile every day actually.

target: Det skrivna ordet väger tungt ibland nu.
english: The written word carries weight sometimes now.

target: De gröna ängarna sträcker sig i helgen.
english: The green meadows stretch out on the weekend.

target: Den svenska midsommaren är unik på kvällen.
english: The Swedish midsummer is unique in the evening.

target: Det var allt som behövdes varje morgon.
english: That was all that was needed every morning.
grammar: "Som" after indefinite pronouns: "allt som," "något som," "ingenting som."

target: De som vill kan följa med snart.
english: Those who want to can come along soon.
grammar: "De som" = those who — a very common construction.

target: Gatan som vi bor på är lugn.
english: The street we live on is quiet.

target: Mannen vars hund sprang bort varje morgon.
english: The man whose dog ran away every morning.
grammar: "Vars" = whose. Less common than "som" but used in written Swedish.

target: Stugan där vi brukade bo varje morgon.
english: The cabin where we used to live every morning.
grammar: "Där" replaces "som" for locations: "stugan där vi bodde."

target: Året då allt förändrades just nu ibland.
english: The year when everything changed right now sometimes.
grammar: "Då" replaces "som" for time: "dagen då vi träffades."

target: Platsen dit vi reste på kvällen förra året.
english: The place we traveled to in the evening last year.
grammar: "Dit" = to where. "Platsen dit" = the place to which.

target: Allt som glittrar är inte guld på morgonen.
english: All that glitters is not gold in the morning.

target: Det var hon som hade rätt redan.
english: It was she who was right already.

target: Vem som helst kan lära sig nog.
english: Anyone can learn probably.
grammar: "Vem som helst" = anyone/whoever. "Vad som helst" = anything/whatever.

target: Var som helst på morgonen egentligen.
english: Anywhere in the morning actually.

target: Tvätten hängs ut att torka hela tiden.
english: The laundry is hung out to dry all the time.
grammar: S-passive in present: "hänga" → "hängs."

target: Julgranen pyntas med ljus förra veckan också.
english: The Christmas tree is decorated with lights last week too.
grammar: "Pynta" → "pyntas." Decorating the tree on December 23rd is traditional.

target: Bilen besiktigas varje år just nu redan.
english: The car is inspected every year right now already.

target: Pengarna överförs automatiskt just nu redan.
english: The money is transferred automatically right now already.

target: Boken lästes av alla i klassen förra året.
english: The book was read by everyone in the class last year.

target: Maten ska tillagas med omsorg varje dag.
english: The food should be prepared with care every day.

target: Dokumenten har granskats noga väldigt ofta också.
english: The documents have been carefully reviewed very often too.

target: Mötet hålls varje tisdag på kvällen redan.
english: The meeting is held every Tuesday in the evening already.

target: Priset sänktes med tjugo procent i helgen.
english: The price was reduced by twenty percent on the weekend.

target: Gatan stängdes av under paraden varje dag.
english: The street was closed during the parade every day.

target: Eleverna bedöms kontinuerligt väldigt ofta just nu.
english: Students are assessed continuously very often right now.

target: Ansökan bör lämnas in senast fredag gärna.
english: The application should be submitted by Friday at the latest gladly.

target: Bilen blev stulen igår natt ibland efter jobbet.
english: The car was stolen last night sometimes after work.
grammar: "Bli" + past participle for event-focused passive: "blev stulen" (got stolen).

target: Dörren blev stängd av misstag varje morgon.
english: The door was closed by mistake every morning.

target: Vi turas om att diska i helgen.
english: We take turns doing the dishes on the weekend.
grammar: "Turas om" is reciprocal deponent — the -s indicates mutual action.

target: De brottades med beslutet förra veckan alltid.
english: They wrestled with the decision last week always.

target: Vi enades om en kompromiss efter jobbet.
english: We agreed on a compromise after work.

target: Hon hoppas innerligt att det går bra.
english: She sincerely hopes it goes well.
grammar: "Hoppas" — despite ending in -s, it's active meaning: to hope.

target: Vi trivdes utmärkt i stugan förra veckan.
english: We really enjoyed ourselves at the cabin last week.

target: De möttes vid centralstationen på kvällen också.
english: They met at the central station in the evening too.

target: Han skämdes för sitt beteende väldigt ofta.
english: He was ashamed of his behavior very often.

target: Vi kramades och sa hej då nog.
english: We hugged and said goodbye probably.

target: Jag lyckas sällan med bakning hela tiden.
english: I rarely succeed at baking all the time.

target: De umgicks som gamla vänner under sommaren.
english: They socialized like old friends during the summer.

target: Vi hjälptes åt att bära varje morgon.
english: We helped each other carry every morning.
grammar: "Hjälpas åt" = help each other — reciprocal s-verb.

target: Barnen slogs om leksaken hela tiden nu.
english: The children fought over the toy all the time now.

target: Vi ska se till att allt blir klart.
english: We're going to make sure everything is ready.
grammar: "Ska" + se till att = going to make sure that.

target: Det kommer troligen att bli bra till slut.
english: It will probably be good in the end.

target: Jag skulle aldrig ha trott det förra året.
english: I would never have believed it last year.
grammar: "Skulle aldrig ha" + supine = would never have (done something).

target: Vi ska ha det bra tillsammans snart.
english: We're going to have a good time together soon.

target: Det kommer att kräva mod sedan länge.
english: It will require courage for a long time.

target: Jag skulle kunna tänka mig att bo här.
english: I could imagine living here.

target: Hon ska snart gå i pension också.
english: She is going to retire soon too.

target: Om jag hade kunnat skulle jag ha hjälpt.
english: If I could have, I would have helped.
grammar: Double conditional: "hade kunnat" + "skulle ha hjälpt" — the most complex conditional.

target: I synnerhet uppskattar jag ärligheten varje morgon.
english: In particular I appreciate the honesty every morning.
grammar: "I synnerhet" = in particular / especially. Formal connector.

target: Till yttermera visso bekräftar detta hela tiden.
english: Furthermore, this confirms all the time.

target: Å andra sidan kan man förstå väl.
english: On the other hand, one can understand I suppose.

target: Inte minst bör vi tacka personalen nog.
english: Not least we should thank the staff probably.

target: I allmänhet fungerar det bra nästa vecka.
english: In general it works well next week.
grammar: "I allmänhet" = in general / generally.

target: I synnerhet när det gäller barn väl.
english: In particular when it comes to children I suppose.

target: Såvitt jag vet har de rest redan.
english: As far as I know they have traveled already.

target: I avvaktan på beslut väntar vi gärna.
english: Pending the decision we wait gladly.

target: Jag vore ytterst tacksam i affären varje morgon.
english: I would be most grateful in the store every morning.
grammar: "Vore" is subjunctive — extremely polite. Formal letters/requests.

target: Var vänlig och sätt dig under sommaren.
english: Please sit down during the summer.
grammar: "Var vänlig" = please. More formal than "var snäll."

target: Med respekt vill jag invända sedan länge.
english: With respect I would like to object for a long time.

target: Jag tar mig friheten att fråga gärna.
english: I take the liberty of asking gladly.
grammar: "Ta sig friheten" = take the liberty — very polite/formal opener.

target: Najs, när man talar med en person man inte känner!
english: Nice, when speaking with a person you do not know!
grammar: English loanwords are extremely common in casual Swedish, especially among youth.

target: Det är soft hela tiden redan.
english: It's cool/easy all the time already.
grammar: "Soft" (from English) is slang for easy, relaxed, cool.

target: Vi reder ut missförståndet i helgen i skolan.
english: We clear up the misunderstanding on the weekend at school.
grammar: "Reda ut" = clear up / sort out.

target: Han kastar om ordningen sedan länge gärna.
english: He reverses the order for a long time gladly.
grammar: "Kasta om" = reverse / turn around.

target: Vi slår ihop avdelningarna efter jobbet gärna.
english: We merge the departments after work gladly.
grammar: "Slå ihop" = merge / combine.

target: Hon bryter sig in i huset i skolan.
english: She breaks into the house at school.

target: Vi tar oss igenom vintern i helgen.
english: We get through the winter on the weekend.
grammar: "Ta sig igenom" = get through / make it through.

target: Han river upp avtalet under veckan alltid.
english: He tears up the agreement during the week always.

target: Absolut ingenting kunde stoppa henne hela tiden.
english: Absolutely nothing could stop her all the time.

target: Mera sällan hör man om det i trädgården.
english: More rarely does one hear about it in the garden.

target: Lite visste vi om vad som väntade.
english: Little did we know about what awaited.

target: Så vackert det var på morgonen redan!
english: How beautiful it was in the morning already!
grammar: Exclamatory with "så": "Så + adjective + subject + verb!"

target: Inte heller detta fungerade i biblioteket varje morgon.
english: Neither did this work in the library every morning.

target: Så sa han det till slut med familjen.
english: So he said it in the end with the family.

target: Ut genom dörren sprang katten sedan länge.
english: Out through the door ran the cat for a long time.

target: Inte på en enda dag har solen visat sig.
english: Not for a single day has the sun shown itself.

target: Just därför borde vi agera sedan länge.
english: That's exactly why we should act for a long time.

target: Elcykeln har blivit allt vanligare förra veckan.
english: The electric bicycle has become increasingly common last week.
grammar: Sweden is a leader in sustainable transportation.

target: Friluftsliv är en del av läroplanen nog.
english: Outdoor life is part of the curriculum probably.
grammar: Swedish schools regularly take students outdoors for learning.

target: Sopsorteringsstationer finns överallt på kvällen här.
english: Waste sorting stations are everywhere in the evening here.

target: Den svenska skolan är avgiftsfri sedan länge.
english: The Swedish school is tuition-free for a long time.
grammar: All education including university is free in Sweden.

target: Tandvård subventioneras för unga förra veckan alltid.
english: Dental care is subsidized for young people last week always.

target: Hemester har blivit populärt i skogen varje morgon.
english: Staycation has become popular in the forest every morning.
grammar: "Hemester" = hem + semester. Vacationing at home — a Swedish concept.

target: Allas lika värde betonas tidigt väldigt ofta.
english: Everyone's equal worth is emphasized early very often.

target: Barnombudsmannen skyddar barns rättigheter hela tiden nu.
english: The Children's Ombudsman protects children's rights all the time now.

target: Samtal om känslor uppmuntras under sommaren hemma.
english: Conversations about feelings are encouraged during the summer at home.

target: Pappaledigheten är en självklarhet ibland nog.
english: Paternity leave is taken for granted sometimes probably.

target: Offentlighetsprincipen ger insyn på kvällen idag.
english: The principle of public access provides transparency in the evening today.
grammar: Sweden's transparency principle makes most government documents public.

target: Folkhemmet präglade nittonhundratalets politik efter jobbet i Sverige.
english: The People's Home shaped twentieth century politics after work in Sweden.
grammar: "Folkhemmet" is the social democratic vision that built modern Sweden.

target: Den svenska välfärdsmodellen beundras internationellt under veckan.
english: The Swedish welfare model is internationally admired during the week.

target: Med benäget bistånd löste vi krisen i Sverige.
english: With gracious assistance we resolved the crisis in Sweden.

target: Det borde i rimlighetens namn räcka här.
english: It should, in all fairness, be enough here.

target: I ett nötskal handlar det om förtroende.
english: In a nutshell, it's about trust.

target: Vi lade pussel med alla bitar gärna.
english: We put the puzzle together with all the pieces gladly.

target: Jag har hört talas om det nog.
english: I have heard about it probably.
grammar: "Höra talas om" = hear about. A set phrase — you can't say "hört om."

target: Det hade aldrig hänt förut på kvällen.
english: It had never happened before in the evening.
grammar: "Hända" → "hänt" in supine. Irregular Group 2 verb.

target: Vi hade just slagit oss ner redan.
english: We had just sat down already.

target: Hon har blivit bättre på svenska nästa år.
english: She has gotten better at Swedish next year.

target: Mötet som vi diskuterade sedan länge i trädgården.
english: The meeting that we discussed for a long time in the garden.
grammar: "Som" as object can be omitted: "Mötet vi diskuterade" is equally correct.

target: Allt som händer har en orsak väl.
english: Everything that happens has a cause I suppose.

target: Breven skickades via posten nästa vecka i skolan.
english: The letters were sent via mail next week at school.
grammar: "Via" is used in Swedish just like in English — borrowed from Latin.

target: Förslaget diskuterades ingående hemma hos oss varje morgon.
english: The proposal was discussed thoroughly at our home every morning.

target: Vi möttes av en vänlig receptionist också.
english: We were met by a friendly receptionist too.

target: De följdes åt genom stan nästa vecka.
english: They walked together through town next week.
grammar: "Följas åt" = accompany each other. A reciprocal s-verb.

target: Vi ska fixa det här sedan länge.
english: We're going to fix this for a long time.
grammar: "Fixa" is informal but very common: fixa mat (make food), fixa biljetter (get tickets).

target: Om vi hade vetat hade vi kommit.
english: If we had known we would have come.

target: Jag har alltid drömt om att bo i Sverige.
english: I have always dreamed of living in Sweden.

target: Så här års är det vackert väl.
english: This time of year it's beautiful I suppose.
grammar: "Så här års" = this time of year. An idiomatic time expression.

target: Nog för att det var kul men det räcker.
english: It was fun enough but that's enough.

target: Det kan inte stämma ibland väl.
english: That can't be right sometimes I suppose.
grammar: "Stämma" = be correct. "Det stämmer" = that's right. Extremely useful.

target: Jag svär, det är sant sedan länge!
english: I swear, it's true for a long time!

target: Vi ses vid halvtiden under sommaren på kvällen.
english: We'll meet at halftime during the summer in the evening.

target: Den tjugofemte december på morgonen också.
english: The twenty-fifth of December in the morning too.

target: Vi firar lucka i adventskalendern varje dag.
english: We open a door in the advent calendar every day.
grammar: Advent calendars are hugely popular — both chocolate ones and TV shows.

target: Tomten kommer på julafton ibland snart.
english: Santa comes on Christmas Eve sometimes soon.
grammar: Swedish Santa (tomten) delivers presents in person on Christmas Eve.

target: Kräftorna äts med dill och bröd också.
english: The crayfish are eaten with dill and bread too.
grammar: Kräftor are traditionally boiled with crown dill — the essential Swedish spice.

target: Prinsesstårtan är grön och god hela tiden.
english: The princess cake is green and delicious all the time.
grammar: Prinsesstårta (green marzipan-covered cake) is Sweden's national cake.

target: Det var precis vad jag behövde egentligen.
english: That was exactly what I needed actually.
